title: CodeHealth Predicts the Token Cost of Agentic Code Review: A Pre-Registered Study of 465 Agent-Authored Pull Requests
title_zh: CodeHealth 预测智能体代码审查的令牌成本：一项针对 465 个由智能体编写的拉取请求的预注册研究

paragraphs.en: Context: Organizations increasingly delegate code review to multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines billed per token. Low code quality raises human maintenance effort, but its effect on agent review cost has not been measured.
paragraphs.zh: 背景：各组织日益将代码审查工作委托给按 token 计费的多智能体大语言模型（LLM）流水线。 低代码质量会增加人工维护成本，但其对智能体审查成本的影响尚未被度量。

sents.en: Context: Organizations increasingly delegate code review to multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines billed per token.
sents.zh: 背景：各组织日益将代码审查工作委托给按 token 计费的多智能体大语言模型（LLM）流水线。

sents.en: Low code quality raises human maintenance effort, but its effect on agent review cost has not been measured.
sents.zh: 低代码质量会增加人工维护成本，但其对智能体审查成本的影响尚未被度量。

paragraphs.en: Objective: We test whether baseline CodeHealth predicts the token cost of agentic review and fix beyond pull request (PR) footprint.
paragraphs.zh: 目标：我们检验基线代码健康度（CodeHealth）能否在拉取请求（PR）规模之外，预测智能体式审查与修复的 token 成本。

paragraphs.en: Method: In a pre-registered observational study, we sampled 465 agent-authored PRs from 246 repositories in AIDev, jointly stratified by CodeHealth and footprint under repository caps. A frozen five-agent review-and-fix pipeline processed every PR with three different LLMs. Per LLM, we fitted a mixed model of log tokens on CodeHealth and log PR footprint, with a repository random intercept.
paragraphs.zh: 方法：在一项预先注册的观察性研究中，我们从 AIDev 的 246 个代码仓库中抽取了 465 个由智能体创建的 PR，按 CodeHealth 和足迹在仓库上限约束下进行联合分层抽样。 一条固定的五智能体审查与修复流水线使用三个不同的 LLM 处理每个 PR。 对于每个 LLM，我们以 CodeHealth 和 PR 足迹的对数为自变量，并以仓库作为随机截距，拟合了一个关于 log token 的混合效应模型。

sents.en: Method: In a pre-registered observational study, we sampled 465 agent-authored PRs from 246 repositories in AIDev, jointly stratified by CodeHealth and footprint under repository caps.
sents.zh: 方法：在一项预先注册的观察性研究中，我们从 AIDev 的 246 个代码仓库中抽取了 465 个由智能体创建的 PR，按 CodeHealth 和足迹在仓库上限约束下进行联合分层抽样。

sents.en: A frozen five-agent review-and-fix pipeline processed every PR with three different LLMs.
sents.zh: 一条固定的五智能体审查与修复流水线使用三个不同的 LLM 处理每个 PR。

sents.en: Per LLM, we fitted a mixed model of log tokens on CodeHealth and log PR footprint, with a repository random intercept.
sents.zh: 对于每个 LLM，我们以 CodeHealth 和 PR 足迹的对数为自变量，并以仓库作为随机截距，拟合了一个关于 log token 的混合效应模型。

paragraphs.en: Results: For all three LLMs the CodeHealth coefficient was negative, with 95% CI excluding zero; each CodeHealth point was associated with 3.5% to 6.1% lower token cost. CodeHealth was unrelated to PR footprint, so PR size does not explain the association. Two of three registered smells predicted fix cost; batch fixing left median CodeHealth unchanged. Exploratory analyses located the association in the review stage, where agents iterated more on unhealthy code without writing more comments. Adjusting for the size of the scored files absorbed the association, which we interpret as mediation by file size.
paragraphs.zh: 结果：对于所有三个大语言模型，CodeHealth 系数均为负值，95% 置信区间不包含零；CodeHealth 每提高 1 分，token 成本降低 3.5% 至 6.1%。 CodeHealth 与 PR 足迹无关，因此 PR 大小无法解释这一关联。 三个预注册代码异味中有两个能预测修复成本；批量修复使 CodeHealth 中位数保持不变。 探索性分析将这一关联定位于评审阶段：智能体在不健康代码上迭代更多，却没有撰写更多注释。 对被评分文件的大小进行调整后，该关联消失，我们将其解释为经由文件大小的中介作用。

sents.en: Results: For all three LLMs the CodeHealth coefficient was negative, with 95% CI excluding zero; each CodeHealth point was associated with 3.5% to 6.1% lower token cost.
sents.zh: 结果：对于所有三个大语言模型，CodeHealth 系数均为负值，95% 置信区间不包含零；CodeHealth 每提高 1 分，token 成本降低 3.5% 至 6.1%。

sents.en: CodeHealth was unrelated to PR footprint, so PR size does not explain the association.
sents.zh: CodeHealth 与 PR 足迹无关，因此 PR 大小无法解释这一关联。

sents.en: Two of three registered smells predicted fix cost; batch fixing left median CodeHealth unchanged.
sents.zh: 三个预注册代码异味中有两个能预测修复成本；批量修复使 CodeHealth 中位数保持不变。

sents.en: Exploratory analyses located the association in the review stage, where agents iterated more on unhealthy code without writing more comments.
sents.zh: 探索性分析将这一关联定位于评审阶段：智能体在不健康代码上迭代更多，却没有撰写更多注释。

sents.en: Adjusting for the size of the scored files absorbed the association, which we interpret as mediation by file size.
sents.zh: 对被评分文件的大小进行调整后，该关联消失，我们将其解释为经由文件大小的中介作用。

paragraphs.en: Conclusions: A quality metric calibrated against human maintainability also predicts the inference cost of multi-agent review and fix. The effect is modest per point and not carried by PR size, so the refactoring case extends to agent-reviewed code when it changes structure and file size, not only the score.
paragraphs.zh: 结论：以人类可维护性为基准校准的质量指标，也能预测多智能体审查与修复的推理成本。 该效应在单个点上较为温和，且不受 PR 大小影响，因此当重构改变结构和文件大小而不仅是分数时，重构案例可扩展到经智能体审查的代码。

sents.en: Conclusions: A quality metric calibrated against human maintainability also predicts the inference cost of multi-agent review and fix.
sents.zh: 结论：以人类可维护性为基准校准的质量指标，也能预测多智能体审查与修复的推理成本。

sents.en: The effect is modest per point and not carried by PR size, so the refactoring case extends to agent-reviewed code when it changes structure and file size, not only the score.

paragraphs.zh: 数据可用性：DOI:10.5281/zenodo.22127920

paragraphs.en: Technical debt research has linked low code quality to higher maintenance costs for over 30 years. Cunningham (1992) coined the term when he described shipping not-quite-right code as going into technical debt on which interest is paid in every subsequent change, and over time this metaphor has turned into a research field with its own systematic maps and syntheses ( Li et al. 2015 ; Ampatzoglou et al. 2015 ) . Researchers have also quantified the cost; for example, Besker et al. (2019) , replicating and extending an earlier study of developers’ own working time, found that developers waste on average 23% of their time on technical debt. Across this literature, the unit of cost is human: attention, working time, and the effort of rebuilding an understanding that the code itself fails to convey.
paragraphs.zh: 技术债务研究三十多年来一直将低代码质量与更高的维护成本联系在一起。 Cunningham (1992) 在将发布不完全正确的代码描述为背负技术债务、且每次后续变更都要为其支付利息时创造了这一术语，而随着时间推移，这一隐喻已发展成为一个拥有自身系统性图谱与综述的研究领域（Li et al. 2015；Ampatzoglou et al. 2015）。 研究人员还量化了这一成本；例如，Besker et al. (2019) 复制并扩展了一项早前针对开发者自身工作时间的研究，发现开发者平均将 23% 的时间浪费在技术债务上。 纵观这些文献，成本的计量单位是人：注意力、工作时间，以及重建代码本身未能传达的理解所需的努力。

paragraphs.en: That unit of cost is changing as organizations route code review through multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines to absorb rising pull request (PR) volumes. He et al. (2026) report that in one enterprise where AI tool adoption roughly doubled per-engineer PR throughput, automated review overtook human code review, while the load on each remaining human reviewer roughly doubled. When the reviewer is an agent, its cost stops being time, attention, and effort and instead becomes metered token cost, which has not yet been related to the quality of the code under review. Storey (2026) argues that generative AI does not remove debt so much as redistribute it, separating technical debt in the code from cognitive debt in a team’s shared understanding and intent debt in its externalized rationale. She observes that agents working against poor context may “use more tokens and time than expected” . The observation is plausible and, to our knowledge, untested. If it is right, the long-standing case for refactoring extends into workflows with no human reviewer in them; if it is wrong, teams that budget refactoring and maintenance on the strength of human-effort evidence have to justify that spend on other grounds for automated pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: 随着组织将代码审查路由到多智能体大语言模型（LLM）流水线中以消化不断增长的拉取请求（PR）数量，这种成本单位正在发生变化。He 等人 （2026）报告称，在一家企业中，AI 工具的采用使每位工程师的 PR 吞吐量大约翻倍，自动化审查取代了人工代码审查，而每位剩余人工审查者的负担大约翻倍。 当审查者是一个智能体时，其成本不再是时间、注意力和精力，而是变成按量计费的 token 成本，而这一成本尚未与被审查代码的质量关联起来。 Storey（2026）认为，生成式 AI 与其说消除了债务，不如说重新分配了债务，它将代码中的技术债务与团队共享理解中的认知债务以及外化决策依据中的意图债务分离开来。 她观察到，在糟糕的上下文中工作的智能体可能会「使用比预期更多的 token 和时间」。 这一观察是合理的，且据我们所知，尚未经过验证。 如果这一观察是正确的，那么重构的长期依据将延伸到没有任何人工审查者的工作流中；如果它是错误的，那么基于人工投入证据来为重构和维护做预算的团队，就必须以其他理由来为自动化流水线的这笔开支辩护。

paragraphs.en: CodeHealth™ (CH) is a composite, deterministic score between 1 1 and 10 10 that aggregates several source-level quality signals into a single file-level measure. Beyond its links to human maintenance effort, it has been shown to predict how AI tooling behaves on the code: Borg et al. (2026a) report significantly lower break rates when AI refactors healthy code. This study asks whether the same metric predicts the token cost of multi-agent review and fix of a PR. The question cannot be asked without separating quality from size. Token consumption scales mechanically with the size of a diff, which presents more input tokens, more lines to read, and more edits to make, so if unhealthy code tends to arrive in larger PRs, an apparent relationship between CH and token cost may simply reflect PR footprint.
paragraphs.zh: CodeHealth™（CH）是一个介于 1 1 到 10 10 之间的复合确定性分数，它将多个源代码级质量信号聚合为单一文件级度量。 除了与人工维护成本的关联之外，已有研究表明它能预测 AI 工具在代码上的行为表现：Borg 等人 （2026a）报告指出，当 AI 重构健康的代码时，破坏率显著更低。 本研究探讨的是，该指标是否能预测多个智能体对 PR 进行审查与修复的 token 成本。 若不将质量与规模区分开来，这个问题便无从谈起。 Token 消耗会随 diff 的规模机械地增长，因为 diff 会带来更多输入 token、更多需要阅读的行以及更多需要做出的修改，因此如果质量差的代码往往出现在更大的 PR 中，那么 CH 与 token 成本之间表面上的关系可能只是反映了 PR 的体量而已。

paragraphs.en: To study this relationship, we conducted a pre-registered observational study investigating whether baseline CodeHealth predicts agentic review and fix costs beyond what PR footprint explains. We treat PR footprint as a mediator candidate, not a covariate, and we designed the study under equipoise so that either outcome is informative. If baseline CH predicts the cost of agentic review and fix after controlling for footprint, the case for refactoring extends to agentic review workflows. If the effect of CH on token cost is instead fully mediated by PR size, the economic argument shifts toward keeping PRs small, possibly at some expense of code quality.
paragraphs.zh: 为研究这一关系，我们开展了一项预注册的观察性研究，考察基线代码健康度（CodeHealth）能否在 PR 足迹所能解释的范围之外，预测智能体审查与修复的成本。 我们将 PR 足迹视为候选中介变量而非协变量，并在均势假设下设计该研究，使得任何一种结果都具有信息价值。 如果在控制足迹之后，基线 CH 仍能预测智能体审查与修复的成本，那么重构的理由便延伸到了智能体审查工作流。 如果 CH 对 token 成本的影响完全由 PR 规模中介，那么经济上的论证就转向保持较小的 PR，这可能以牺牲一定的代码质量为代价。

paragraphs.en: We investigate four pre-registered 1 1 1 OSF DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/FBJCT research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们调查了四个预先注册的 1 1 1 OSF DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/FBJCT 研究问题：

paragraphs.en: Does baseline CodeHealth predict the token cost of agentic review and fix, controlling for PR footprint, language, and repository?
paragraphs.zh: 基准 CodeHealth 是否能在控制 PR 影响范围、编程语言和仓库的前提下，预测智能体审查与修复的 token 成本？

paragraphs.en: Is any such relationship direct, or is it mediated by the size of the PR that unhealthy code attracts?
paragraphs.zh: 这种关系是直接的，还是由不健康代码所吸引的 PR 规模所中介的？

paragraphs.en: Do specific code smells, rather than the aggregate CodeHealth score, predict the cost of the fix stage in particular?
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，是特定的代码坏味道（而非总体 CodeHealth 分数）能够预测修复阶段的成本吗？

paragraphs.en: What happens to CodeHealth itself when a batch fix agent applies a full set of review comments in a single pass?
paragraphs.zh: 当批量修复智能体一次性应用整套审查意见时，CodeHealth 本身会发生什么变化？

paragraphs.en: The registered analysis supports the direct-CodeHealth-effect branch of this equipoise. Fitted separately for each of the three LLMs on the achieved 465-PR sample, the coefficient on baseline CH is negative, with a 95% confidence interval excluding zero, for all three LLMs. This satisfies RQ 1 ’s pre-registered conjunctive criterion. One additional CH point is associated with an estimated 3.5% to 6.1% reduction in total review-and-fix tokens, holding footprint, language, and repository constant (Fig. 1(a) ). Footprint itself is essentially unrelated to baseline CodeHealth in this sample (at most + 0.014 +0.014 in log \log footprint per CH point, with every interval spanning zero), so the effect is direct with respect to PR footprint and not an artifact of unhealthy code attracting larger PRs (Fig. 1(b) ). A quality metric calibrated against human maintainability therefore also shows an association with metered agent inference cost. Even if this is not established as a causal relationship, the result suggests that the code properties the metric penalizes also raise what an agent spends. In an exploratory analysis, the association concentrates in the review stage: agents reviewing unhealthy code take more turns and consume more context without raising more comments. A second exploratory refit shows that the association cannot be separated from the size of the files the agents read, which we interpret as file size, unlike PR footprint, mediating the effect (Section 5.2 ). Keeping PRs small therefore does not substitute for code quality, and the case for refactoring extends to agent-reviewed code in the form that changes the structure and size of the files an agent reads through, not only the score (Section 5.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该注册分析支持这一均势假设中的「直接 CodeHealth 效应」分支。 分别对三个 LLM 在实际完成的 465 个 PR 样本上进行拟合，三个 LLM 的基线 CH 系数均为负，且 95% 置信区间均不包含零。 这满足了 RQ 1 的预注册合取标准。 在保持足迹、语言和代码仓库不变的情况下，CodeHealth 每提高 1 点，估计可使「评审加修复」的总 token 数减少 3.5% 至 6.1%（图 1(a)）。 在该样本中，足迹本身与基线 CodeHealth 基本无关（CH 每提高 1 点，log log 足迹至多变化 +0.014，且所有区间均包含零），因此该效应相对于 PR 足迹是直接的，而非不健康代码吸引更大 PR 所致的假象（图 1(b)）。 一个经过人类可维护性校准的质量指标，因此也与智能体推理的计费成本相关联。 即使这尚未被确立为因果关系，该结果也表明该指标所惩罚的代码属性同样会增加智能体的开销。 在一项探索性分析中，该关联集中在评审阶段：评审不健康代码的智能体需要更多轮次并消耗更多上下文，却并未提出更多评论。 第二项探索性重新拟合表明，该关联无法与智能体所读文件的大小分离开来，我们将其解释为：与 PR 足迹不同，文件大小在其中起中介作用（第 5.2 节）。 因此，保持 PR 精简并不能替代代码质量；重构的意义不仅在于改变得分，更在于改变智能体通读的文件的结构和大小，从而扩展到经智能体评审的代码（第 5.5 节）。

sents.en: The registered analysis supports the direct-CodeHealth-effect branch of this equipoise.
sents.zh: 该注册分析支持这一均势假设中的「直接 CodeHealth 效应」分支。

sents.en: Fitted separately for each of the three LLMs on the achieved 465-PR sample, the coefficient on baseline CH is negative, with a 95% confidence interval excluding zero, for all three LLMs.
sents.zh: 分别对三个 LLM 在实际完成的 465 个 PR 样本上进行拟合，三个 LLM 的基线 CH 系数均为负，且 95% 置信区间均不包含零。

sents.en: This satisfies RQ 1 ’s pre-registered conjunctive criterion.
sents.zh: 这满足了 RQ 1 的预注册合取标准。

sents.en: One additional CH point is associated with an estimated 3.5% to 6.1% reduction in total review-and-fix tokens, holding footprint, language, and repository constant (Fig. 1(a) ).
sents.zh: 在保持足迹、语言和代码仓库不变的情况下，CodeHealth 每提高 1 点，估计可使「评审加修复」的总 token 数减少 3.5% 至 6.1%（图 1(a)）。

sents.en: Footprint itself is essentially unrelated to baseline CodeHealth in this sample (at most + 0.014 +0.014 in log \log footprint per CH point, with every interval spanning zero), so the effect is direct with respect to PR footprint and not an artifact of unhealthy code attracting larger PRs (Fig. 1(b) ).

paragraphs.en: In addressing these questions, we make four contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 在回答这些问题的过程中，我们做出了四点贡献：

paragraphs.en: A pre-registered, multi-LLM mixed-effects observational study across three independently served LLMs, evaluated with a conjunctive direction-consistency criterion.
paragraphs.zh: 一项预注册的、跨三个独立部署的大语言模型（LLM）的多LLM混合效应观察性研究，采用合取式方向一致性标准进行评估。

paragraphs.en: A frozen, reproducible review-and-fix harness of four review agents and one fix agent grounded in the ISO/IEC 25010 product quality model ( ISO/IEC 2023 ) , with all agent prompts hashed and registered, and unchanged across the whole collection.
paragraphs.zh: 一个冻结且可复现的评审与修复框架，包含四个评审智能体和一个修复智能体，基于 ISO/IEC 25010 产品质量模型（ISO/IEC 2023），所有智能体提示词均经过哈希并注册，且在整个语料集中保持不变。

paragraphs.en: A jointly stratified CodeHealth-by-footprint, repository-capped sample of 465 agent-authored PRs drawn from 246 distinct repositories in the AIDev dataset ( Li et al. 2026 ) , accompanied by an audit of its achieved balance.
paragraphs.zh: 按 CodeHealth 与足迹（footprint）联合分层、以仓库为上限抽样得到的 465 个智能体创建的 PR 样本，这些样本来自 AIDev 数据集（ Li et al. 2026 ）中 246 个不同的仓库，并附有对其所达成平衡情况的审计。

paragraphs.en: A documented account of two sampling failure modes specific to AIDev and one pooling artifact in multi-LLM PR studies, together with the decomposition checklist that detected them (Section 3.3 and Section 6.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一份记录了 AIDev 特有的两种采样失效模式以及多 LLM PR 研究中一种汇总伪影的文档化说明，同时附带了检测出这些问题的分解清单（第 3.3 节和第 6.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Code review has been studied since Fagan introduced formal inspections as a defect-removal technique ( Fagan 1976 ) , with tool support since ICICLE offered network-distributed inspections in 1990 ( Brothers et al. 1990 ) . Bacchelli and Bird (2013) showed that its lighter, tool-based contemporary form, modern code review , also delivers benefits beyond defect finding, such as knowledge transfer, team awareness, and alternative solutions to problems. Work in industrial ( Sadowski et al. 2018 ; MacLeod et al. 2018 ) and open-source settings ( McIntosh et al. 2016 ; Kononenko et al. 2016 ; Baysal et al. 2016 ) studied the practice in situ and documented its variability ( Baum et al. 2017 ) and challenges ( Söderberg et al. 2022 ) , with both its benefits and its costs measured in human units.
paragraphs.zh: 自从 Fagan 将正式审查作为一种缺陷消除技术提出以来（Fagan 1976），代码评审一直受到研究，并且自 ICICLE 在 1990 年提供网络分布式审查以来（Brothers et al. 1990），一直有工具支持。 Bacchelli 和 Bird（2013）表明，其更轻量的、基于工具的当代形式——现代代码评审，也带来了缺陷发现之外的收益，例如知识传递、团队感知以及问题的替代解决方案。 针对工业界（Sadowski et al. 2018; MacLeod et al. 2018）和开源环境（McIntosh et al. 2016; Kononenko et al. 2016; Baysal et al. 2016）的研究对这一实践进行了实地考察，记录了其变异性（Baum et al. 2017）与挑战（Söderberg et al. 2022），其收益和成本都是以人工单位来度量的。

paragraphs.en: Cost has been a persistent theme in this literature, although most often measured indirectly. Gonçalves et al. (2022) framed review as an expensive process and studied whether explicit review strategies could improve effectiveness and efficiency. Kudrjavets et al. (2022) quantified the delay between acceptance and merge as a component of a team’s code velocity. Dorner et al. (2025) estimated the upper bound of information diffusion achievable through review as a communication network. Yang et al. (2026) , in a recent roadmap, described manual inspection of increasingly complex systems as cognitively demanding and resource-intensive, and identified the resulting workflow bottleneck as a primary motivation for automation. Across all of these, the unit of cost is human: attention, time, or effort. Our own prior work takes the same human-centered stance, modeling review as a decision-making process driven by the questions reviewers ask ( Gullstrand Heander et al. 2026 ) and arguing for AI that supports rather than replaces the reviewer ( Heander et al. 2025 ) , a position shared by the Copenhagen Manifesto on human-centered generative AI in software engineering ( Russo et al. 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 成本一直是这一文献中反复出现的主题，尽管大多以间接方式衡量。Gonçalves 等人 （2022）将评审视为一个昂贵的过程，并研究了显式的评审策略能否提升有效性与效率。Kudrjavets 等人 （2022）将「接受到合并」之间的延迟量化为团队代码流速的一个组成部分。Dorner 等人 （2025）将评审作为一种通信网络，估算了通过评审可实现的信息传播上限。Yang 等人 （2026）在近期的一份路线图中指出，对日益复杂的系统进行人工检查在认知上要求高且消耗资源，并将由此产生的工作流瓶颈确定为自动化的主要动机。 在上述所有研究中，成本的衡量单位都是人：注意力、时间或精力。 我们自身先前的工作也采取同样以人为中心的立场，将评审建模为一个由评审者提出的问题所驱动的决策过程（Gullstrand Heander 等人 2026），并主张人工智能应当支持而非取代评审者（Heander 等人 2025），这一立场也与软件工程领域以人为中心的生成式人工智能的《哥本哈根宣言》一致（Russo 等人 2024）。

paragraphs.en: CodeHealth™ (CH) is an aggregate, file-level static-analysis score in the range 1 to 10, calculated by CodeScene 2 2 2 https://codescene.com/ from a catalog of source-level code smells such as complex methods, deeply nested conditionals, and duplicated logic ( CodeScene 2026a ) . CodeScene divides this scale into three levels, called red, yellow, and green code on its product pages ( CodeScene 2026a ) and unhealthy, problematic, and healthy in its scale definition ( CodeScene 2026b ) : below 4, from 4 up to 9, and at 9 and above. We adopt the same thresholds and use the second set of names, unhealthy , problematic , and healthy , throughout this paper. Unlike a single structural metric, CH is designed as a measurable proxy for maintainability and has been evaluated against organizational outcomes. Tornhill and Borg (2022) analyzed 39 proprietary production codebases and reported that files with low CH scores took considerably longer in development and contained more defects than files with higher scores. Borg et al. (2024b) subsequently found that the benefit of raising CH holds even when the score is already high, that is, the returns do not flatten out at the top of the scale. Borg et al. (2023) found that low CH slows issue resolution, particularly for developers with marginal ownership of the code. CodeHealth has also been benchmarked against human judgment: Borg et al. (2024a) compared maintainability metrics and machine-learning predictions against human assessments and reported where the automated measures agree and diverge (Section 6.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: CodeHealth™（CH）是 CodeScene 2 2 2 https://codescene.com/ 计算的一个聚合的、文件级静态分析评分，取值范围为 1 到 10，其依据是一组源代码级别的代码坏味道，例如复杂方法、深层嵌套的条件语句和重复的逻辑（CodeScene 2026a）。 CodeScene 将这一量级划分为三个等级，在其产品页面上称为红、黄、绿代码（CodeScene 2026a），而在其量级定义中称为不健康、有问题和健康（CodeScene 2026b）：低于 4、从 4 到 9 以下、以及 9 及以上。 我们采用相同的阈值，并在全文中使用第二组名称：不健康、有问题和健康。 与单一的结构性度量不同，CH 被设计为可维护性的可度量代理指标，并且已针对组织层面的结果进行了评估。 Tornhill 和 Borg（2022）分析了 39 个专有的生产代码库，报告指出 CH 评分较低的文件在开发中耗时明显更长，且缺陷多于评分较高的文件。Borg 等人 （2024b）随后发现，即使评分已经很高，提升 CH 的收益依然存在，也就是说，其回报并不会在量级顶端趋于平缓。Borg 等人 （2023）发现，低 CH 会拖慢问题的解决速度，尤其是对代码仅拥有少量归属权的开发者而言。 CodeHealth 也已与人类判断进行了基准对比：Borg 等人 （2024a）将可维护性指标和机器学习预测与人类评估进行了比较，并报告了自动化度量在哪些方面与人类评估一致、在哪些方面存在分歧（第 6.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Recent work connects CodeHealth to AI-assisted development. In a two-phase pre-registered controlled experiment methodologically close to the present study, Borg et al. (2026b) found no significant difference in CH when manually evolving code that was either co-developed with AI or originally human-only. Borg et al. (2026a) reported that low CH predicts a higher risk that AI coding tools introduce new defects, and reframed the metric as a potential predictor of AI-friendliness as well as of human maintainability. Most recently, Wirdemann et al. (2026) applied the same reframing to a different task, single-shot LLM-generated unit tests over a competitive-programming corpus. Their study reported both that CH correlates with generated-test effectiveness and, more relevant here, that source code files with lower CH require more input tokens, an association that persisted after controlling for source lines of code in Java and C++ but largely disappeared in the smaller, healthier Python subset. Outside CodeScene, Ramirez and Ekler (2025) related a different composite, the Maintainability Index, to agent issue resolution on SWE-bench Lite and found correlations that varied across LLMs. That the association survives a change of task, corpus, and outcome variable suggests that CodeHealth may predict, more generally, how much work an LLM needs to reason about code. If so, it should also predict how many tokens an LLM spends reviewing and repairing that code. This inference is plausible but untested, and it is the premise of the present study. Our registered model adjusts for the number of changed lines, not for the size of the files the agents read; we report a size-adjusted refit as an exploratory analysis (Section 4.6.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 近期研究将代码健康度与 AI 辅助开发联系起来。 在一项与本研究在方法上相近的两阶段预注册对照实验中，Borg 等人 （2026b）发现，在人工演化代码时，无论该代码是与 AI 共同开发还是最初仅由人类开发，代码健康度均无显著差异。Borg 等人 （2026a）报告称，较低的代码健康度预示着 AI 编程工具引入新缺陷的风险更高，并将该指标重新定义为 AI 友好度以及人类可维护性的潜在预测因子。 最近，Wirdemann 等人 （2026）将同样的重新框架应用于另一项任务，即在一个竞赛编程语料库上生成的单次 LLM 单元测试。 他们的研究既报告了代码健康度与生成测试的有效性相关，也报告了与此更相关的发现：代码健康度较低的源代码文件需要更多的输入 token，这一关联在控制了 Java 和 C++ 的源代码行数后仍然存在，但在更小、更健康的 Python 子集中基本消失。 在 CodeScene 之外，Ramirez 和 Ekler（2025）将另一个复合指标——可维护性指数——与智能体在 SWE-bench Lite 上的问题解决能力联系起来，发现其相关性在不同 LLM 之间存在差异。 这种关联在任务、语料库和结果变量改变后仍然存在，这表明代码健康度或许能更普遍地预测 LLM 在对代码进行推理时所需的工作量。 如果真是这样，它也应该能预测 LLM 在审查和修复该代码时花费的 token 数量。 这一推断合理但未经检验，而这正是本研究的前提。 我们的注册模型对变更行数进行了调整，但没有对智能体所读取文件的大小进行调整；我们报告一个按大小调整后的重新拟合作为探索性分析（第 4.6.4 节）。

sents.en: Recent work connects CodeHealth to AI-assisted development.
sents.zh: 近期研究将代码健康度与 AI 辅助开发联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Automated review has moved from single-model comment generation ( Tufano et al. 2022 ) to multi-agent architectures in which specialized agents examine a PR from different angles and a supervisory component aggregates their findings, as in CodeAgent ( Tang et al. 2024 ) , ChatDev ( Qian et al. 2024 ) , and AutoCodeRover ( Zhang et al. 2024 ) , which He et al. (2025) describe as a pivotal evolution in LLM-based software engineering. Deployed systems follow the same pattern, from BitsAI-CR, which pairs a rule-based detector with an LLM filter stage and reports 75% precision at ByteDance ( Sun et al. 2025 ) , to the system of Laiq et al. (2026) at Ericsson, in which four agents each cover one quality dimension and developers rated 96% of 206 generated findings correct and 69% of those important enough to fix.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化代码审查已经从单模型的评论生成（Tufano et al. 2022）发展到多智能体架构，其中专门的智能体从不同角度审查拉取请求（PR），并由一个监督组件汇总它们的发现，例如 CodeAgent（Tang et al. 2024）、ChatDev（Qian et al. 2024）和 AutoCodeRover（Zhang et al. 2024），He 等人 （2025）将其描述为基于大语言模型的软件工程的一次关键演进。 已部署的系统遵循同样的模式，从 BitsAI-CR——它将基于规则的检测器与大语言模型过滤阶段相结合，并在字节跳动报告了 75% 的精确率（Sun et al. 2025）——到 Laiq 等人 （2026）在爱立信部署的系统，其中四个智能体各自负责一个质量维度，开发者认为 206 条生成的发现中有 96% 是正确的，其中 69% 足够重要、值得修复。

paragraphs.en: What this literature predominantly reports is quality and adoption: precision of generated comments, F1 on comment classification, developer-rated correctness and importance ( Laiq et al. 2026 ) , developer adoption rate, and PR cycle time. Inference cost as a function of the properties of the code under review is not among the reported outcomes. The closest work we are aware of is the PR triage proposal of Madeyski (2026) , which suggests using CodeHealth as a routing signal for assigning software engineering tasks to the cheapest sufficient LLM tier, based on a hypothesized tier-dependent asymmetry in which mid-capability LLMs benefit from clean code while frontier (flagship-tier) LLMs do not. The routing design uses SWE-bench Lite as an evaluation benchmark and concerns task solving instead of review. It presupposes a measured association between CH and inference cost on real PRs, which has not yet been reported.
paragraphs.zh: 这批文献主要报告的是质量与采用情况：生成注释的精确率、注释分类的 F1 值、开发者评定的正确性与重要性（Laiq et al. 2026）、开发者采用率以及 PR 周转时间。 推理成本作为被审代码属性的函数，并不在已报告的结果之列。 我们所知最接近的工作是 Madeyski（2026）提出的 PR 分流方案，该方案建议将 CodeHealth 用作路由信号，以便把软件工程任务分配给“足够胜任的最便宜”LLM 档位，其依据是一个假设的、与档位相关的不对称性：中等能力的 LLM 会从整洁代码中受益，而前沿（旗舰级）LLM 则不然。 该路由设计以 SWE-bench Lite 作为评估基准，关注的是任务求解而非评审。 它预设了 CH 与真实 PR 上推理成本之间存在已被测得的关联，而这一点尚未有报道。

paragraphs.en: To our knowledge, no study has related CodeHealth to the cost of automated code review. In one enterprise that adopted AI coding tools, automated review overtook human review while per-reviewer load roughly doubled ( He et al. 2026 ) , yet what that automation costs, and what in the code drives the cost, is not reported. Teams that justify refactoring budgets by human maintenance effort therefore have no evidence on whether the same code quality also governs the metered cost of the agents now reviewing their code. CH has been validated as a predictor of human maintenance effort ( Tornhill and Borg 2022 ; Borg et al. 2024b ) and of AI defect-injection risk and generated-test effectiveness ( Borg et al. 2026a ; Wirdemann et al. 2026 ) , but not of the cost of automated code review, and the agentic review studies above report precision and adoption, but not cost. This study estimates that relationship. Answering the question requires separating CodeHealth from PR footprint, since token cost is mechanically coupled to diff size, yet footprint cannot simply be adjusted away: if unhealthy code forces larger PRs for comparable tasks, adjusting for size would erase part of the effect of interest. Section 3 therefore specifies footprint as a mediator candidate and reports the decomposition.
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，尚无研究将代码健康度与自动化代码审查的成本联系起来。 在一家采用了 AI 编程工具的企业中，自动化审查超越了人工审查，同时每位审查者的负载大约翻了一番（He et al. 2026），然而这种自动化的成本是多少，以及代码中的哪些因素驱动了该成本，均未见报道。 因此，那些以人工维护工作量来论证重构预算合理性的团队，无法得知同样的代码质量是否也决定了如今审查其代码的智能体所产生的计量成本。 CH 已被验证为人工维护工作量的预测指标（Tornhill and Borg 2022；Borg et al. 2024b），也被验证为 AI 缺陷注入风险和生成测试有效性的预测指标（Borg et al. 2026a；Wirdemann et al. 2026），但尚未被验证为自动化代码审查成本的预测指标，而且上述智能体审查研究报告了精确度和采用率，却未报告成本。 本研究旨在估计这一关系。 回答该问题需要将代码健康度与 PR 足迹分离开来，因为 token 成本与 diff 大小在机制上相互耦合，但足迹不能被简单地调整掉：如果不健康的代码在完成同等任务时迫使产生更大的 PR，那么按大小进行调整将会抹去部分所关注效应。 因此，第 3 节将足迹设定为一个中介候选变量，并报告其分解结果。

paragraphs.en: This is a non-randomized, observational study of a fixed measurement instrument applied to a stratified sample of PRs. It was pre-registered 2026-08-20 on the Open Science Framework (OSF; DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/FBJCT ), and the protocol described here is the registered protocol. Fig. 2 summarizes the four phases of the procedure (pilots, sampling, collection, and analysis), together with the milestones within them. The pre-registration falls inside the collection phase, after the review agents had started and before the fix agent ran, with the chronology given in Section 3.12 .
paragraphs.zh: 这是一项非随机化的观察性研究，采用固定的测量工具，应用于一个分层抽样的 PR 样本。 该研究已于 2026 年 8 月 20 日在开放科学框架（Open Science Framework, OSF；DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/FBJCT）上预注册，此处描述的方案即为已注册的方案。 图 2 概括了该流程的四个阶段（试点、抽样、收集和分析），以及其中包含的各个里程碑。 预注册位于收集阶段之内，即在评审智能体（review agents）已经开始工作之后、修复智能体（fix agent）运行之前，具体时间顺序见第 3.12 节。

sents.en: This is a non-randomized, observational study of a fixed measurement instrument applied to a stratified sample of PRs.
sents.zh: 这是一项非随机化的观察性研究，采用固定的测量工具，应用于一个分层抽样的 PR 样本。

sents.en: It was pre-registered 2026-08-20 on the Open Science Framework (OSF; DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/FBJCT ), and the protocol described here is the registered protocol.
sents.zh: 该研究已于 2026 年 8 月 20 日在开放科学框架（Open Science Framework, OSF；DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/FBJCT）上预注册，此处描述的方案即为已注册的方案。

sents.en: Fig. 2 summarizes the four phases of the procedure (pilots, sampling, collection, and analysis), together with the milestones within them.
sents.zh: 图 2 概括了该流程的四个阶段（试点、抽样、收集和分析），以及其中包含的各个里程碑。

sents.en: The pre-registration falls inside the collection phase, after the review agents had started and before the fix agent ran, with the chronology given in Section 3.12 .
sents.zh: 预注册位于收集阶段之内，即在评审智能体（review agents）已经开始工作之后、修复智能体（fix agent）运行之前，具体时间顺序见第 3.12 节。

paragraphs.en: The unit of analysis is the PR. For each PR, a fixed pipeline of four review agents and one fix agent is run against the repository with the PR’s changes applied, and the token cost of that run is recorded. Nothing about the pipeline is manipulated and no condition is randomized; the pipeline is a measurement instrument held constant across all 465 observations. What varies between observations is the code the instrument is applied to.
paragraphs.zh: 分析单位是PR。 对于每个PR，在应用了该PR更改的仓库上运行一条固定的流水线，其中包含四个评审智能体和一个修复智能体，并记录该次运行的token成本。 流水线的任何部分都未被操纵，也没有随机化任何条件；该流水线是一个在全部465个观测中保持不变的测量工具。 在各观测之间变化的，是该测量工具所应用于的代码。

sents.en: The unit of analysis is the PR.
sents.zh: 分析单位是PR。

sents.en: For each PR, a fixed pipeline of four review agents and one fix agent is run against the repository with the PR’s changes applied, and the token cost of that run is recorded.
sents.zh: 对于每个PR，在应用了该PR更改的仓库上运行一条固定的流水线，其中包含四个评审智能体和一个修复智能体，并记录该次运行的token成本。

sents.en: Nothing about the pipeline is manipulated and no condition is randomized; the pipeline is a measurement instrument held constant across all 465 observations.
sents.zh: 流水线的任何部分都未被操纵，也没有随机化任何条件；该流水线是一个在全部465个观测中保持不变的测量工具。

sents.en: What varies between observations is the code the instrument is applied to.
sents.zh: 在各观测之间变化的，是该测量工具所应用于的代码。

paragraphs.en: The predictor of interest is the code’s baseline CodeHealth, aggregated over the files the PR touches and weighted by the number of lines the PR changes in each of them (Section 3.8 ). Four properties of this choice govern the interpretation of the resulting estimate. First, the measurement is taken on the PR’s head commit, so it scores exactly the code the review agents are pointed at, and it is taken before any agent of ours has run, so it cannot be an effect of the pipeline. Second, and consequently, it includes the PR’s own contribution instead of measuring only the code the PR landed on: the analysis tool scores whole files, not line ranges, so on a PR that edits established files the score comes largely from pre-existing content, while on a PR that introduces new files it is a property of the submitted patch itself. In our sample, the former case dominates and the distribution is quantified in Section 6.3 . We call the predictor baseline in the sense of before review, not before the PR. Third, it is scoped to the changed files instead of the whole repository, so the predictor characterizes the files in which the review and fix work happens and excludes code that is unaffected. Fourth, the line weighting means that baseline CH and PR footprint are two measurements over the same set of files, correlated by construction, and separating them is the subject of RQ 2 . Taken together, we treat CH as a property of the code a review agent is handed, which a maintainer influences both through the standing state of the repository and through what is allowed into it, and we ask how many tokens one point of CodeHealth is associated with.
paragraphs.zh: 我们关注的预测变量是代码的基线 CodeHealth，在 PR 所触及的文件上聚合，并按 PR 在每个文件中更改的行数加权（第 3.8 节）。 这一选择的四个特性决定了对所得估计值的解释。 第一，该度量是在 PR 的头提交上获取的，因此它评定的正是评审智能体所指向的代码，并且它在我们任何智能体运行之前获取，因此不可能是该流水线造成的结果。 第二，因而它包含 PR 自身的贡献，而不是只度量 PR 所落在其上的代码：该分析工具对整个文件评分，而不是对行区间评分，因此在编辑既有文件的 PR 上，得分主要来自先前存在的内容，而在引入新文件的 PR 上，得分则是所提交补丁本身的属性。 在我们的样本中，前一种情况占主导，其分布在第 6.3 节中量化。 我们把该预测变量称为基线，指的是评审之前，而不是 PR 之前。 第三，它限定在更改的文件而非整个仓库范围内，因此该预测变量刻画的是评审和修复工作所在的文件，并排除了不受影响的代码。 第四，按行加权意味着基线 CH 与 PR 足迹是对同一组文件进行的两项度量，在构造上相关，而将二者分离是 RQ 2 的主题。 综合起来，我们把 CH 视为评审智能体所接手的代码的一种属性，维护者既通过仓库的常设状态、也通过允许进入仓库的内容来影响它，我们则问一个点的 CodeHealth 关联着多少 token。

sents.en: The predictor of interest is the code’s baseline CodeHealth, aggregated over the files the PR touches and weighted by the number of lines the PR changes in each of them (Section 3.8 ).
sents.zh: 我们关注的预测变量是代码的基线 CodeHealth，在 PR 所触及的文件上聚合，并按 PR 在每个文件中更改的行数加权（第 3.8 节）。

sents.en: Four properties of this choice govern the interpretation of the resulting estimate.
sents.zh: 这一选择的四个特性决定了对所得估计值的解释。

sents.en: First, the measurement is taken on the PR’s head commit, so it scores exactly the code the review agents are pointed at, and it is taken before any agent of ours has run, so it cannot be an effect of the pipeline.
sents.zh: 第一，该度量是在 PR 的头提交上获取的，因此它评定的正是评审智能体所指向的代码，并且它在我们任何智能体运行之前获取，因此不可能是该流水线造成的结果。

sents.en: Second, and consequently, it includes the PR’s own contribution instead of measuring only the code the PR landed on: the analysis tool scores whole files, not line ranges, so on a PR that edits established files the score comes largely from pre-existing content, while on a PR that introduces new files it is a property of the submitted patch itself.
sents.zh: 第二，因而它包含 PR 自身的贡献，而不是只度量 PR 所落在其上的代码：该分析工具对整个文件评分，而不是对行区间评分，因此在编辑既有文件的 PR 上，得分主要来自先前存在的内容，而在引入新文件的 PR 上，得分则是所提交补丁本身的属性。

sents.en: In our sample, the former case dominates and the distribution is quantified in Section 6.3 .
sents.zh: 在我们的样本中，前一种情况占主导，其分布在第 6.3 节中量化。

sents.zh: 我们把该预测变量称为基线，指的是评审之前，而不是 PR 之前。

sents.en: Third, it is scoped to the changed files instead of the whole repository, so the predictor characterizes the files in which the review and fix work happens and excludes code that is unaffected.
sents.zh: 第三，它限定在更改的文件而非整个仓库范围内，因此该预测变量刻画的是评审和修复工作所在的文件，并排除了不受影响的代码。

sents.en: Fourth, the line weighting means that baseline CH and PR footprint are two measurements over the same set of files, correlated by construction, and separating them is the subject of RQ 2 .
sents.zh: 第四，按行加权意味着基线 CH 与 PR 足迹是对同一组文件进行的两项度量，在构造上相关，而将二者分离是 RQ 2 的主题。

sents.en: Taken together, we treat CH as a property of the code a review agent is handed, which a maintainer influences both through the standing state of the repository and through what is allowed into it, and we ask how many tokens one point of CodeHealth is associated with.
sents.zh: 综合起来，我们把 CH 视为评审智能体所接手的代码的一种属性，维护者既通过仓库的常设状态、也通过允许进入仓库的内容来影响它，我们则问一个点的 CodeHealth 关联着多少 token。

paragraphs.en: Because CodeHealth is directly observed, the estimate is associational, not causal. Unhealthy code is not distributed at random across repositories, languages, or problem domains. The design absorbs two confounding factors, repository identity as a random intercept and primary language as a fixed factor, leaving the remainder as a threat described in more detail in Section 6.1 . The same 465 PRs are processed independently by three different LLMs, producing three correlated replications of the same estimate rather than one estimate on three times as much data, an important distinction for the analysis plan in Section 3.9 .
paragraphs.zh: 由于代码健康度（CodeHealth）是直接观测得到的，该估计是关联性的，而非因果性的。 不健康的代码并非在仓库、编程语言或问题域之间随机分布。 该设计吸收了两个混杂因素——将仓库身份作为随机截距，将主要语言作为固定因子——其余部分则作为威胁在第 6.1 节中更详细地描述。 相同的 465 个 PR 由三个不同的 LLM 独立处理，产生的是同一估计的三个相关联的重复，而不是在三倍数据量上的一个估计，这对第 3.9 节的分析计划而言是一个重要区别。

sents.en: Because CodeHealth is directly observed, the estimate is associational, not causal.
sents.zh: 由于代码健康度（CodeHealth）是直接观测得到的，该估计是关联性的，而非因果性的。

paragraphs.en: The quantity estimated by the study is β ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ \beta_{\mathit{health}} , the coefficient on baseline CodeHealth in the primary model below. The outcome ( 𝑡𝑜𝑘𝑒𝑛𝑠 ​ _ ​ 𝑡𝑜𝑡𝑎𝑙 \mathit{tokens\_total} ) enters that model as a natural logarithm while the predictor enters untransformed, so β ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ \beta_{\mathit{health}} is the expected change in log \log total tokens associated with a one-point increase in baseline CH, holding footprint, language, and repository fixed. Exponentiating it, 100 ​ ( e β ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ − 1 ) 100(e^{\beta_{\mathit{health}}}-1) , re-expresses the same quantity as a percentage change in predicted token cost per CH point, which is the form a practitioner weighing a refactoring investment can act on. A negative β ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ \beta_{\mathit{health}} therefore means that healthier code is cheaper for an agent to review and repair at a given PR size, and its magnitude is the effect of one CH point measured in tokens. Because CodeHealth is bounded on a 1 to 10 scale, the coefficient also scales to a contrast between tiers. In the achieved sample, the median unhealthy-tier PR scores 2.8 and the median healthy-tier PR scores 9.7, so 6.9 ​ β ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ 6.9\beta_{\mathit{health}} is the difference between a typical unhealthy and a typical healthy PR. Throughout, we interpret β ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ \beta_{\mathit{health}} as an association within the fitted model, not as a causal effect.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究估计的量是 β_ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ，即下文主模型中基线 CodeHealth 的系数。 结果变量（𝑡𝑜𝑘𝑒𝑛𝑠\_𝑡𝑜𝑡𝑎𝑙）以自然对数形式进入该模型，而预测变量未经变换进入，因此在保持占用足迹、语言和仓库不变的情况下，β_ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ 表示基线 CH 每增加一点时总 token 数对数值的预期变化。 对其取指数，100(e^{\beta_{\mathit{health}}}-1)，将同一量重新表述为每个 CH 点对应的预测 token 成本的百分比变化，这一形式可供权衡重构投资的实践者直接使用。 因此，负的 β_ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ 意味着在给定 PR 规模下，更健康的代码对智能体进行审查和修复的成本更低，其大小即以 token 衡量的一个 CH 点的效应。 由于 CodeHealth 的取值范围限定在 1 到 10 的量表上，该系数也可以按层级间的对比进行缩放。 在实际获得的样本中，不健康层级 PR 的中位得分为 2.8，健康层级 PR 的中位得分为 9.7，因此 6.9β_ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ 就是典型不健康 PR 与典型健康 PR 之间的差异。 在全文中，我们将 β_ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ 解释为所拟合模型内的一种关联，而非因果效应。

sents.zh: 该研究估计的量是 β_ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ，即下文主模型中基线 CodeHealth 的系数。

sents.en: The outcome ( 𝑡𝑜𝑘𝑒𝑛𝑠 ​ _ ​ 𝑡𝑜𝑡𝑎𝑙 \mathit{tokens\_total} ) enters that model as a natural logarithm while the predictor enters untransformed, so β ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ \beta_{\mathit{health}} is the expected change in log \log total tokens associated with a one-point increase in baseline CH, holding footprint, language, and repository fixed.
sents.zh: 结果变量（𝑡𝑜𝑘𝑒𝑛𝑠\_𝑡𝑜𝑡𝑎𝑙）以自然对数形式进入该模型，而预测变量未经变换进入，因此在保持占用足迹、语言和仓库不变的情况下，β_ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ 表示基线 CH 每增加一点时总 token 数对数值的预期变化。

sents.en: A negative β ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ \beta_{\mathit{health}} therefore means that healthier code is cheaper for an agent to review and repair at a given PR size, and its magnitude is the effect of one CH point measured in tokens.
sents.zh: 因此，负的 β_ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ 意味着在给定 PR 规模下，更健康的代码对智能体进行审查和修复的成本更低，其大小即以 token 衡量的一个 CH 点的效应。

sents.en: Because CodeHealth is bounded on a 1 to 10 scale, the coefficient also scales to a contrast between tiers.
sents.zh: 由于 CodeHealth 的取值范围限定在 1 到 10 的量表上，该系数也可以按层级间的对比进行缩放。

sents.en: In the achieved sample, the median unhealthy-tier PR scores 2.8 and the median healthy-tier PR scores 9.7, so 6.9 ​ β ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ 6.9\beta_{\mathit{health}} is the difference between a typical unhealthy and a typical healthy PR.
sents.zh: 在实际获得的样本中，不健康层级 PR 的中位得分为 2.8，健康层级 PR 的中位得分为 9.7，因此 6.9β_ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ 就是典型不健康 PR 与典型健康 PR 之间的差异。

sents.en: Throughout, we interpret β ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ \beta_{\mathit{health}} as an association within the fitted model, not as a causal effect.

paragraphs.en: The confirmatory hypothesis, registered verbatim, is the following.
paragraphs.zh: 预先注册的验证性假设原文如下。

paragraphs.en: H1 : In log ⁡ ( 𝑡𝑜𝑘𝑒𝑛𝑠 ​ _ ​ 𝑡𝑜𝑡𝑎𝑙 ) ∼ ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ + log ⁡ ( 𝑓𝑜𝑜𝑡𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑛𝑡 ) + 𝑙𝑎𝑛𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑔𝑒 + ( 1 | 𝑟𝑒𝑝𝑜 ) \log(\mathit{tokens\_total})\sim\mathit{health}+\log(\mathit{footprint})+\mathit{language}+(1|\mathit{repo}) , fitted separately for each of the three LLMs on the same 465 PRs, the coefficient on baseline CodeHealth is negative.
paragraphs.zh: H1：在同一批 465 个 PR 上分别为三个大语言模型单独拟合 \log(\mathit{tokens\_total})\sim\mathit{health}+\log(\mathit{footprint})+\mathit{language}+(1|\mathit{repo})，基线 CodeHealth 的系数为负。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 3 shows the variables of the primary model and the roles they play in it. The success criterion was pre-stated and is conjunctive. H1 is supported if and only if all three per-LLM estimates of β ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ \beta_{\mathit{health}} are negative and at least two of the three 95% confidence intervals exclude zero. If all three estimates are negative but at most one confidence interval excludes zero, the result is reported as direction consistent but individually underpowered, and no confirmatory claim is made. If the estimates disagree in sign, H1 is not supported and the study reports cost as footprint-mediated. RQ 2 through RQ 4 are registered as a mediation decomposition, a three-hypothesis smell family, and a descriptive distribution respectively (Section 3.9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 图 3 展示了初级模型中的变量及其在模型中所扮演的角色。 成功判据是预先声明且为合取式的。 当且仅当 β ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ \beta_{\mathit{health}} 的三个逐 LLM 估计值均为负，且三个 95% 置信区间中至少有两个不包含零时，H1 才算得到支持。 如果三个估计值均为负，但至多只有一个置信区间不包含零，则结果被报告为方向一致但个体统计功效不足，且不作任何验证性声明。 如果估计值符号不一致，则 H1 不成立，研究将成本报告为经由足迹中介的。 RQ 2 至 RQ 4 分别注册为中介分解、一个包含三个假设的坏味道家族，以及一个描述性分布（第 3.9 节）。

paragraphs.en: We draw PRs from AIDev, a dataset of PRs authored by AI coding agents on GitHub ( Li et al. 2026 ) . AIDev provides a full tier of 932,791 PRs and a curated tier restricted to repositories with at least 100 GitHub stars, comprising 33,596 PRs across 2,807 repositories. We use the curated tier, because it is the only tier that includes the diffs and commit details needed to reconstruct a reviewable PR. The five originating agents recorded in the dataset are OpenAI Codex, Devin, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Claude Code. The dataset is revision-locked and SHA-256-validated at download time (revision 68ed5f4b , SHA-256 ec75e016 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 AIDev 数据集抽取 PR，该数据集收录了由 AI 编程智能体在 GitHub 上创建的 PR（Li 等，2026）。 AIDev 提供一个包含 932,791 个 PR 的完整层级，以及一个仅限于拥有至少 100 个 GitHub star 的仓库的精选层级，后者涵盖 2,807 个仓库中的 33,596 个 PR。 我们使用精选层级，因为它是唯一包含重建可审查 PR 所需的 diff 和提交详情的层级。 数据集中记录的五个来源智能体为 OpenAI Codex、Devin、GitHub Copilot、Cursor 和 Claude Code。 该数据集在下载时进行了版本锁定并通过 SHA-256 校验（版本号 68ed5f4b，SHA-256 ec75e016）。

sents.en: We draw PRs from AIDev, a dataset of PRs authored by AI coding agents on GitHub ( Li et al. 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 我们从 AIDev 数据集抽取 PR，该数据集收录了由 AI 编程智能体在 GitHub 上创建的 PR（Li 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: AIDev is large enough to support a jointly stratified design, and its curated tier removes the abandoned and single-author repositories that would otherwise populate the unhealthy stratum with code that nobody maintains and whose review cost nobody pays. Its PRs were authored by contemporary coding agents, not humans, which matches the setting the study is about; agentic review is increasingly applied to agent-written code, and He et al. (2026) report that in repositories adopting these agents, automated review has already overtaken human review. For the same reason, a repository that routinely merges agent-authored PRs has already made the configuration and process decisions that agent-driven development requires, so the sample is drawn from projects in which the practice is already established. The corresponding limitation, that the findings speak to agent-authored PRs in relatively popular open-source projects and not to human-authored, private, or legacy code, is stated in Section 6.2 .
paragraphs.zh: AIDev 规模足够大，可以支持联合分层设计，其精选层剔除了那些被放弃的以及单一作者的仓库，否则这些仓库会用无人维护、且无人承担其审查成本的代码填充不健康层。 其 PR 由当代编码智能体而非人类撰写，这与研究所针对的场景相符；智能体审查正日益被应用于智能体编写的代码，He 等人 （2026）报告指出，在采用这些智能体的仓库中，自动化审查已经超过了人类审查。 出于同样的原因，常规合并智能体撰写 PR 的仓库已经做出了智能体驱动开发所需的配置和流程决策，因此样本取自那些该实践已经确立的项目。 相应的局限性，即研究结果针对的是相对流行的开源项目中智能体撰写的 PR，而非人类撰写的、私有的或遗留代码，已在 6.2 节中说明。

sents.en: For the same reason, a repository that routinely merges agent-authored PRs has already made the configuration and process decisions that agent-driven development requires, so the sample is drawn from projects in which the practice is already established.

paragraphs.en: Two filters are applied in order: PR state must be merged , so that a well-defined base commit exists; and the repository’s primary language must be one of the five most represented in the curated subset, namely TypeScript, Python, Go, C#, and JavaScript, fixed in advance to avoid language-specific bias. The resulting candidate pool contains 19,403 PRs from 1,164 distinct repositories. A third requirement, that the PR has file-level patches available, is checked for each PR when it is measured during sampling, and a PR without them is never sampled. The pool is concentrated: a single repository, mochilang/mochi , supplies 39.3% of it, the two largest repositories together supply 57.5%, and 474 repositories (41%) contribute exactly one PR. This concentration is the motivation for the sampling design below.
paragraphs.zh: 依次应用两个过滤条件：PR 状态必须为已合并，以确保存在明确定义的基准提交；并且仓库的主要语言必须是精选子集中占比最高的五种语言之一，即 TypeScript、Python、Go、C# 和 JavaScript，这些语言是事先固定的，以避免特定语言的偏差。 由此得到的候选池包含来自 1,164 个不同仓库的 19,403 个 PR。 第三个要求是 PR 必须有可用的文件级补丁，该条件在采样过程中对每个被度量的 PR 进行检查，没有补丁的 PR 永远不会被采样到。 该候选池高度集中：单个仓库 mochilang/mochi 提供了其中的 39.3%，最大的两个仓库合计提供了 57.5%，而有 474 个仓库（41%）各只贡献了一个 PR。 这种集中性正是下文采样设计的动因。

paragraphs.en: The design described in this section is the fourth data collection of the study. Here, we describe the three pilot exercises that preceded it, because the sampling design of Section 3.4 , the random intercept for repository, and several reporting conventions are direct responses to the ways in which the first two pilots failed. Table 1 summarizes all four collections. The pilots used disjoint PRs, all three are disclosed in the registration, and all 103 of their PR identifiers are permanently excluded from the main sample.
paragraphs.zh: 本节所述设计是该研究的第四次数据收集。 在此，我们描述其之前的三次试点工作，因为 3.4 节的抽样设计、针对仓库的随机截距以及若干报告惯例，都是对前两次试点失败方式的直接回应。 表 1 汇总了全部四次数据收集。 这些试点使用了互不重叠的 PR，三次试点均在注册中披露，且其全部 103 个 PR 标识符被永久排除在主样本之外。

sents.en: Here, we describe the three pilot exercises that preceded it, because the sampling design of Section 3.4 , the random intercept for repository, and several reporting conventions are direct responses to the ways in which the first two pilots failed.

sents.en: The pilots used disjoint PRs, all three are disclosed in the registration, and all 103 of their PR identifiers are permanently excluded from the main sample.
sents.zh: 这些试点使用了互不重叠的 PR，三次试点均在注册中披露，且其全部 103 个 PR 标识符被永久排除在主样本之外。

paragraphs.en: Pilots 1 and 2 were run under an earlier design of this study, which asked whether agentic review and fix degrades CodeHealth, and which compared the batch fix pass used here against a second, CodeHealth-guided fix condition. Both pilots ran only the batch fix condition, with a single locally served LLM ( qwen3-6 , at that time on a serving stack without prefix caching), and both drew PRs stratified on CH tier alone, in candidate order and without any cap on how many PRs one repository could contribute. Both produced results that did not survive the decomposition checklist, and we believe the two failure modes could generalize to other studies that sample from agent-authored PR datasets. Pilot 1 reported a strong negative correlation between baseline CH and reviewer tokens ( r = − .68 r=-.68 , p < .001 p<.001 ), but CH tier and PR size were fully aliased in that sample, since its healthy tier consisted of small PRs with a median of about 40 changed lines, so the CH variable was effectively a size variable. Pilot 2 broke the aliasing on the healthy side and the correlation vanished, but its unhealthy tier was 12 of 13 PRs (92%) from the single repository mochilang/mochi , so it measured the properties of one codebase and not of CodeHealth in general. That concentration was close to inevitable, since the same repository supplies 39.3% of the candidate pool (Section 3.2 ). Neither the apparent effect of pilot 1 nor the apparent null of pilot 2 therefore generalizes, and both are retained only as diagnostic exhibits.
paragraphs.zh: 试点1和试点2是在本研究早期设计下运行的，该设计询问智能体式的审查和修复是否会降低代码健康度，并将此处使用的批量修复方式与第二种由代码健康度引导的修复条件进行比较。 两个试点都只运行了批量修复条件，使用单个本地部署的大语言模型（qwen3-6，当时运行在没有前缀缓存的推理服务栈上），并且都仅按代码健康度层级分层抽取PR，按候选顺序进行，且对单个仓库可贡献的PR数量没有设置任何上限。 两者产生的结果都未能通过分解核查清单，我们认为这两种失效模式可能推广到其他从智能体撰写PR数据集中抽样的研究。 试点1报告了基线代码健康度与审查者token之间的强负相关（r=−.68，p<.001），但在该样本中代码健康度层级与PR大小完全混淆，因为其健康层级由中位数约40行变更的小PR组成，因此代码健康度变量实际上是一个大小变量。 试点2在健康侧打破了这种混淆，相关性随之消失，但其不健康层级中有12个PR（92%）来自单一仓库mochilang/mochi（13个中有12个），因此它测量的是单个代码库的属性，而非代码健康度的普遍属性。 这种集中几乎不可避免，因为同一个仓库占候选池的39.3%（第3.2节）。 因此，试点1的表观效应和试点2的表观零结果都不具推广性，两者仅作为诊断性展示予以保留。

paragraphs.en: Pilot 2 also changed the question. In 26 of its 37 PRs (70%), CodeHealth after the batch fix was exactly equal to CH before it, so a study of degradation under batch fix would have had almost no effective sample, and the CodeHealth-guided condition tested a treatment that conflates the change under review with unrelated refactoring. We therefore dropped the second condition, turned the batch fix pass into the fixed instrument of Section 3.6 , made cost the primary outcome, and retained Δ \Delta CodeHealth as the descriptive RQ 4 . The two sampling failures produced four further changes: joint stratification on CH and footprint, to break the aliasing of pilot 1; hard repository caps, to break the concentration of pilot 2 (Section 3.4 ); a random intercept for repository in the primary model (Section 3.9 ); and a standing decomposition checklist applied before any aggregate is trusted. The checklist consists of a comparison of means against medians, a footprint-adjusted cost per changed line, an outlier check for whether any single PR accounts for more than 20% of a stratum’s sum, a rank correlation and a Mann-Whitney contrast on the continuous predictor, and an audit of the repository-by-cell matrix. We tested it against the false results of pilots 1 and 2 and verified that it raises warnings in both cases.
paragraphs.zh: 试点 2 也改变了研究问题。 在其 37 个 PR 中有 26 个（70%）在批量修复后 CodeHealth 与修复前完全相等，因此针对批量修复下退化的研究几乎不会有有效样本，而且以 CodeHealth 为导向的条件所检验的处理方式将待评审的变更与无关的重构混在了一起。 因此，我们放弃了第二个条件，将批量修复环节转化为第 3.6 节中的固定工具，把成本作为主要结局指标，并将 Δ \Delta CodeHealth 保留为描述性的 RQ 4。 这两次抽样失败带来了四项进一步的改变：对 CH 和足迹进行联合分层，以打破试点 1 中的混叠；设置仓库硬性上限，以打破试点 2 中的集中现象（第 3.4 节）；在主模型中为仓库加入随机截距（第 3.9 节）；以及在信任任何聚合结果之前应用一套固定的分解检查清单。 该检查清单包括：均值与中位数的对比、按足迹调整后的每行变更代码成本、检查是否有单个 PR 占某一层总和 20% 以上的离群值检验、对连续预测变量的秩相关和 Mann-Whitney 对比，以及对仓库-单元格矩阵的审计。 我们用试点 1 和试点 2 的错误结果对该检查清单进行了检验，并验证它在两种情况下都会发出警告。

paragraphs.en: Pilot 3 implemented the final study design at a smaller scale. It drew five PRs per cell of the same 3 × 3 3\times 3 grid, 45 in total, under tight repository caps of one PR per repository per cell and three overall, which yielded 38 distinct repositories and a baseline CodeHealth that is orthogonal to footprint in the sample ( ρ = .015 \rho=.015 ). It ran the full instrument with all three LLMs of the main collection: deepseek-v4-flash and sonnet-5 on 2026-07-13 and 2026-07-14, and qwen3-6 , re-run after its move to the final serving stack of Section 3.7 , on 2026-08-18 and 2026-08-19. Pilot 3 is the disclosed, hypothesis-generating basis of the registration. It supplied the expected direction of H1 and the sample-size rationale (Section 3.12 ), the three confirmatory code smells of RQ 3 , and the decision to fit the model separately per LLM instead of pooling the LLMs’ data (Section 3.9 ). It is not counted as confirmatory evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 试点 3 以更小的规模实施了最终的研究设计。 它在同一个 3 × 3 3\times 3 网格的每个单元格中抽取五次 PR，共 45 个，并施加严格的仓库上限（每个单元格内每个仓库一个 PR，总计三个），由此得到 38 个不同的仓库，以及一个与样本中足迹正交的基线 CodeHealth（ρ = .015 \rho=.015）。 它使用主采集中的全部三个 LLM 运行了完整的测量工具：deepseek-v4-flash 和 sonnet-5 于 2026-07-13 和 2026-07-14 运行，qwen3-6 在迁移至第 3.7 节所述的最终服务栈之后，于 2026-08-18 和 2026-08-19 重新运行。 试点 3 是该项预注册所披露的、用于生成假设的基础。 它提供了 H1 的预期方向和样本量依据（第 3.12 节）、RQ 3 的三个验证性代码坏味道，以及按每个 LLM 分别拟合模型而非合并各 LLM 数据的决策（第 3.9 节）。 它不计入验证性证据。

sents.en: It supplied the expected direction of H1 and the sample-size rationale (Section 3.12 ), the three confirmatory code smells of RQ 3 , and the decision to fit the model separately per LLM instead of pooling the LLMs’ data (Section 3.9 ).
sents.zh: 它提供了 H1 的预期方向和样本量依据（第 3.12 节）、RQ 3 的三个验证性代码坏味道，以及按每个 LLM 分别拟合模型而非合并各 LLM 数据的决策（第 3.9 节）。

sents.en: It is not counted as confirmatory evidence.
sents.zh: 它不计入验证性证据。

paragraphs.en: The main collection repeats the setup of pilot 3, with two differences. The first is scale. Sampling streamed the entire candidate pool instead of stopping at five PRs per cell, and the repository caps were relaxed to the values in Section 3.4 , because the tight caps of pilot 3 left mostly single-PR repositories and therefore little within-repository variation from which the random intercept could separate repository from CodeHealth. The second is the harness. The main collection uses the same agent prompts, LLMs, serving stack, and review and fix workflow as pilot 3. To avoid a failure mode with spiraling token costs that could inflate the effect size, character caps on tool output were implemented on 2026-08-21 and filed as an amendment to the registration (Section 3.12 ).
paragraphs.zh: 主收集重复了试点3的设置，但有两处不同。第一处是规模。 抽样改为流式处理整个候选池，而不是在每个单元格五个PR处停止，并且仓库上限放宽至第3.4节中的数值，因为试点3的严格上限导致仓库大多是只有单个PR的，因此仓库内变异很少，随机截距无法借此将仓库与CodeHealth区分开来。 第二处是测试框架。 主收集使用与试点3相同的智能体提示词、大语言模型、服务栈以及审查和修复工作流。 为避免token成本螺旋式上升从而夸大效应量的失败模式，于2026年8月21日对工具输出实施了字符上限，并作为注册的修订提交备案（第3.12节）。

sents.zh: 主收集重复了试点3的设置，但有两处不同。第一处是规模。

sents.zh: 主收集使用与试点3相同的智能体提示词、大语言模型、服务栈以及审查和修复工作流。

sents.zh: 为避免token成本螺旋式上升从而夸大效应量的失败模式，于2026年8月21日对工具输出实施了字符上限，并作为注册的修订提交备案（第3.12节）。

paragraphs.en: We sample on a 3 × 3 3\times 3 grid formed by crossing three CodeHealth tiers with three PR-footprint terciles. The CH tiers, introduced in Section 2.1 , are the strata published by the tool vendor ( CodeScene 2026a ) : unhealthy below 4, problematic from 4 up to 9, and healthy at 9 and above. The footprint terciles are log-scale cut points on changed lines, computed from the entire filtered candidate pool and reused unchanged for every sampling run. Small PRs have 59 changed lines or fewer, medium PRs 60–177 lines, and large PRs 178 lines or more.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个由三个 CodeHealth 等级与三个 PR 规模（footprint）三分位数交叉形成的 3 × 3 3\times 3 网格上进行抽样。 第 2.1 节引入的 CH 等级是工具厂商（CodeScene 2026a）公布的分层：低于 4 为不健康，4 至 9 为有问题，9 及以上为健康。 规模三分位数是基于变更行数的对数尺度切点，由整个过滤后的候选池计算得出，并在每次抽样运行中保持不变地重复使用。 小型 PR 的变更行数不超过 59 行，中型 PR 为 60–177 行，大型 PR 为 178 行及以上。

sents.zh: 我们在一个由三个 CodeHealth 等级与三个 PR 规模（footprint）三分位数交叉形成的 3 × 3 3\times 3 网格上进行抽样。

sents.en: Small PRs have 59 changed lines or fewer, medium PRs 60–177 lines, and large PRs 178 lines or more.
sents.zh: 小型 PR 的变更行数不超过 59 行，中型 PR 为 60–177 行，大型 PR 为 178 行及以上。

paragraphs.en: Two independent repository caps are enforced during sampling: at most two PRs from any one repository within a single cell, and at most nine PRs from any one repository across the whole sample. These caps are a design requirement because the primary model estimates the CodeHealth effect partly from within-repository contrasts, which it cannot do if a single repository dominates a stratum. Sampling proceeds under a fixed seed with per-PR checkpoints, so that interrupting and re-running reproduces the same sample. We streamed the entire candidate pool to exhaustion and collected the largest dataset possible under these constraints. All 103 PRs previously included in any of the pilot runs were excluded.
paragraphs.zh: 在抽样过程中执行两项独立的仓库上限：在单个单元内，来自任一仓库的 PR 最多两个；在整个样本中，来自任一仓库的 PR 最多九个。 这些上限是设计上的要求，因为主模型部分依赖仓库内的对比来估计 CodeHealth 效应，如果单一仓库在某个层中占主导地位，它就无法做到这一点。 抽样在固定种子和按 PR 保存检查点的机制下进行，因此中断并重新运行可以复现相同的样本。 我们将整个候选池抽取至耗尽，并在这些约束条件下收集了尽可能大的数据集。 所有曾在任何试点运行中被纳入过的 103 个 PR 均被排除。

paragraphs.en: The achieved sample contains 465 PRs from 246 distinct repositories, at a mean of 1.89 PRs per repository. Table 2 shows the fill per cell against the nominal per-cell target of 56.
paragraphs.zh: 最终获得的样本包含来自 246 个不同代码仓库的 465 个 PR，平均每个代码仓库 1.89 个 PR。 表 2 展示了每个单元格的填充数量与每单元格名义目标 56 的对比。

sents.en: The achieved sample contains 465 PRs from 246 distinct repositories, at a mean of 1.89 PRs per repository.
sents.zh: 最终获得的样本包含来自 246 个不同代码仓库的 465 个 PR，平均每个代码仓库 1.89 个 PR。

sents.en: Table 2 shows the fill per cell against the nominal per-cell target of 56.
sents.zh: 表 2 展示了每个单元格的填充数量与每单元格名义目标 56 的对比。

paragraphs.en: As Table 2 shows, only unhealthy-medium (33 of 56) and unhealthy-large (40 of 56) fell short. The sampler streamed all 19,403 candidates and the short cells are caused by low-CodeHealth PRs being scarce among merged PRs in repositories with at least 100 stars, and scarcer still as diff size grows. The unhealthy tier, not the total PR count, is the limiting constraint on sample size.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 2 所示，只有 unhealthy-medium（56 个中的 33 个）和 unhealthy-large（56 个中的 40 个）未达标。采样器流式处理了全部 19,403 个候选，短少的单元格是由于在拥有至少 100 颗星的仓库中，已合并的 PR 里低 CodeHealth 的 PR 稀少，且随着 diff 规模的增大而更加稀少。限制样本量的是 unhealthy 层级的数量，而非 PR 总数。

paragraphs.en: As designed, no repository contributes more than two PRs to any single cell. Four repositories reach the overall cap of nine, and 160 repositories (65%) contribute exactly one PR. Of the 246 repositories, 55 (22%) span at least two CodeHealth tiers, and these are the repositories from which the random intercept model estimates the within-repository CH effect. Baseline CH has a median of 8.14 and a mean of 6.95; changed lines have a median of 93 and a mean of 832, with a maximum of 91,128. The heavy-tailed shape is the rationale for reporting medians over means in Section 3.9 . The language distribution is TypeScript 174, Python 134, C# 71, Go 51, and JavaScript 35. The originating coding agent is OpenAI Codex for 229 PRs (49%), GitHub Copilot for 103 (22%), Devin for 75 (16%), Cursor for 43 (9%), and Claude Code for 15 (3%); sampling was not stratified on implementation language or originating agent, so this distribution is descriptive only.
paragraphs.zh: 按照设计，任何单一单元中来自同一仓库的 PR 不超过两个。 有四个仓库达到了九个的上限，而 160 个仓库（65%）恰好贡献一个 PR。 在 246 个仓库中，有 55 个（22%）跨越至少两个代码健康度（CodeHealth）层级，随机截距模型正是基于这些仓库来估计仓库内的 CH 效应。 基线 CH 的中位数为 8.14，均值为 6.95；变更行的中位数为 93，均值为 832，最大值为 91,128。 这种重尾分布的形态是第 3.9 节采用中位数而非均值进行报告的原因。 语言分布为：TypeScript 174 个、Python 134 个、C# 71 个、Go 51 个、JavaScript 35 个。 发起编码的智能体中，OpenAI Codex 负责 229 个 PR（49%），GitHub Copilot 负责 103 个（22%），Devin 负责 75 个（16%），Cursor 负责 43 个（9%），Claude Code 负责 15 个（3%）；抽样并未按实现语言或发起智能体进行分层，因此该分布仅具描述性。

sents.zh: 发起编码的智能体中，OpenAI Codex 负责 229 个 PR（49%），GitHub Copilot 负责 103 个（22%），Devin 负责 75 个（16%），Cursor 负责 43 个（9%），Claude Code 负责 15 个（3%）；抽样并未按实现语言或发起智能体进行分层，因此该分布仅具描述性。

paragraphs.en: The instrument is a fixed four-agent review pass followed by a single batch fix pass, run once per PR per LLM. Fig. 4 traces three concrete PRs, one from each CodeHealth tier, through its stages. For each PR, the repository is cloned into a shared bare-clone cache and a dedicated git worktree is created at the PR’s head commit with a detached HEAD, which isolates concurrent PR runs from one another and presents the agents with the repository in the state a human reviewer would open it in, with the PR applied. Baseline CH is measured on that worktree, over the PR’s changed files, before any agent runs. Each of the four review agents then examines the diff in a single pass and emits structured comments, each with a file, a line, an issue description, a severity, and an impact statement. One fix agent receives all comments from all four reviewers, constructs fixes for the issues, and applies them in a single batch pass. CH is measured a second time on the resulting worktree, and the worktree is removed.
paragraphs.zh: 该工具是一个由四个智能体组成的固定评审流程，随后是单次批量修复流程，每个 LLM 对每个 PR 运行一次。 图 4 追踪了三个具体的 PR（分别来自每个 CodeHealth 层级）经过其各个阶段的过程。 对于每个 PR，仓库会被克隆到一个共享的裸克隆缓存中，并在 PR 的头提交处以分离 HEAD 的方式创建一个专用的 git worktree，这使得并发的 PR 运行相互隔离，并向智能体呈现出人类评审者在应用 PR 后打开仓库时所看到的状态。 在任何智能体运行之前，先在该 worktree 上针对 PR 变更的文件测量基线 CH。 然后，四个评审智能体各自在单次流程中检查 diff 并发出结构化评论，每条评论包含文件、行号、问题描述、严重程度和影响说明。 一个修复智能体接收来自全部四个评审者的所有评论，为这些问题构建修复方案，并在单次批量流程中应用它们。 在产生的 worktree 上再次测量 CH，然后移除该 worktree。

sents.en: The instrument is a fixed four-agent review pass followed by a single batch fix pass, run once per PR per LLM.
sents.zh: 该工具是一个由四个智能体组成的固定评审流程，随后是单次批量修复流程，每个 LLM 对每个 PR 运行一次。

sents.en: Fig. 4 traces three concrete PRs, one from each CodeHealth tier, through its stages.
sents.zh: 图 4 追踪了三个具体的 PR（分别来自每个 CodeHealth 层级）经过其各个阶段的过程。

paragraphs.en: Each agent runs a plain multi-turn tool loop. The LLM is called with a system prompt, the diff, and a set of tool definitions; any tool calls it emits are executed against the PR worktree and the results appended to the message history, until the LLM returns a final answer or a guard terminates it. The tool set exposes the working tree at the PR’s head commit for reading, searching, and editing, and mirrors the read and search tools against the base commit, so that an agent can ask what a file, a hunk, or a match looked like before the PR without the worktree ever leaving the head state. The file-reading tools return at most 500 lines per call, prefixed with the file’s total line count, so an agent pages through a long file in several calls. The editing tools are available only to the fix agent, so that a review agent cannot modify any file. A single adapter layer absorbs provider differences, so the same loop, the same tools, and the same prompts run against every LLM. Every LLM call in every agent loop is issued at temperature 0. Prompting is zero-shot throughout; no examples are included in any agent prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体运行一个简单的多轮工具循环。 调用 LLM 时会传入系统提示词、diff 以及一组工具定义；它发出的任何工具调用都会在 PR 工作树上执行，并把结果追加到消息历史中，直到 LLM 返回最终答案或某个保护机制将其终止。 这套工具集将 PR 头提交（head commit）处的工作树暴露出来，供读取、搜索和编辑之用，并针对基础提交（base commit）提供对应的读取和搜索工具，从而让智能体无需离开头状态的工作树，就能查询某个文件、某个代码块（hunk）或某个匹配项在 PR 之前的样子。 文件读取工具每次调用最多返回 500 行，并带有文件总行数的前缀，因此智能体可以通过多次调用分页浏览一个长文件。 编辑工具仅对修复智能体可用，因此审查智能体无法修改任何文件。 单一适配器层吸收了各家提供商的差异，因此同一套循环、同一套工具和同一套提示词可以适用于每个 LLM。 每个智能体循环中的每次 LLM 调用都以温度 0（temperature 0）发出。 提示词全程采用零样本（zero-shot）方式；任何智能体提示词中都不包含示例。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 lists the four roles, partitioned along the ISO/IEC 25010 taxonomy ( ISO/IEC 2023 ) . Every review agent prompt restricts findings to issues introduced or exposed by the PR under review and excludes unchanged code from the review scope, so the review is bounded to the diff even though the tools give each agent access to the whole worktree at both the head and the base commit. The design excluded two scopes that other review sets include: a dedicated test reviewer and an intent-alignment reviewer. A dedicated test reviewer predominantly produces coverage-gap findings on files outside the diff, which have no baseline CodeHealth score and are therefore inert with respect to the measurement window. Intent alignment, meaning whether the patch implements what the PR description states, cannot be acted on by a fix agent without specifying the missing functionality; PR intent is instead passed to the fix agent as context, so that its edits do not contradict the rationale of the PR.
paragraphs.zh: 表3列出了四种角色，按照 ISO/IEC 25010 分类法（ISO/IEC 2023）进行划分。 每个审查智能体的提示词都将发现的问题限制在被审查 PR 引入或暴露的问题上，并将未更改的代码排除在审查范围之外，因此审查仅限于 diff，即使工具让每个智能体都能访问 head 和 base 提交处的整个工作树。 该设计排除了其他审查集合包含的两个范围：专门的测试审查者和意图对齐审查者。 专门的测试审查者主要在 diff 之外的文件上产生覆盖缺口类发现，这些文件没有基线 CodeHealth 分数，因此相对于测量窗口而言是无效的。 意图对齐（即补丁是否实现了 PR 描述所述内容）无法在不指明缺失功能的情况下由修复智能体采取行动；PR 意图改为作为上下文传递给修复智能体，使其编辑不会与 PR 的理由相矛盾。

paragraphs.en: Each agent prompt was hashed with SHA-256 and the hashes were filed in the OSF pre-registration. The prompts, the orchestration logic, and the LLM identities are frozen; any change after the filing requires an OSF amendment, even for defects discovered during execution. One such defect was found during the main collection, in the tool layer, and Section 3.12 reports the required OSF amendment.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体的提示词均使用 SHA-256 进行了哈希处理，哈希值已归档在 OSF 预注册中。 提示词、编排逻辑以及大语言模型（LLM）的身份均已冻结；归档后的任何变更都需要提交 OSF 修正案，即使是在执行过程中发现的缺陷也不例外。 在主要数据收集过程中，在工具层发现了一个此类缺陷，第 3.12 节报告了所需的 OSF 修正案。

paragraphs.en: Three LLMs, listed in Table 4 , were used in the study. They were chosen to span deployment regimes plausible in real agentic code review: one inexpensive hosted API LLM, one open-weight LLM served locally on our own hardware, and one current-generation hosted commercial LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究使用了表4中列出的三个大语言模型。 选择这三个模型是为了覆盖真实智能体代码审查中可能出现的部署场景：一个廉价托管API大语言模型、一个在我们自有硬件上本地部署的开源权重大语言模型，以及一个当前一代的托管商业大语言模型。

sents.zh: 本研究使用了表4中列出的三个大语言模型。

sents.zh: 选择这三个模型是为了覆盖真实智能体代码审查中可能出现的部署场景：一个廉价托管API大语言模型、一个在我们自有硬件上本地部署的开源权重大语言模型，以及一个当前一代的托管商业大语言模型。

paragraphs.en: The locally served LLM, qwen3-6 , is pinned to a specific revision and its serving environment is pinned with a hash-checked lock file covering all 196 packages. Reasoning is enabled with a reasoning-token budget of 4,000 tokens and a maximum context length of 262,144 tokens. The main collection was executed between 2026-08-19 and 2026-08-24. Review sessions for two of the LLMs began one day before the registration was filed; Section 3.12 gives the chronology. The two hosted LLMs are versioned by their providers, so their pinning is provider-side and we cannot verify weight-level stability across the collection window.
paragraphs.zh: 本地部署的LLM qwen3-6 固定在特定修订版本，其服务环境通过经哈希校验的锁文件固定，涵盖全部196个软件包。 推理功能已启用，推理token预算为4,000个token，最大上下文长度为262,144个token。 主采集在2026年8月19日至2026年8月24日期间进行。 其中两个LLM的评审会话在注册提交前一天开始；第3.12节给出了时间线。 两个托管LLM由其提供商管理版本，因此其固定属于提供商侧，我们无法验证采集窗口内权重层面的稳定性。

paragraphs.en: Prefix caching counts repeated context across agent-loop iterations differently for the three LLMs (Table 4 , rightmost column). This means that total tokens are not comparable across LLMs. Our own pilot data shows the size of the effect. When the local LLM moved from a serving stack with no prefix caching to one where 80.6% of its input tokens were served from cache, its footprint-to-cost rank correlation on an identical set of 45 pilot PRs fell from ρ = .50 \rho=.50 to ρ = .27 \rho=.27 , with no change to the LLM, the prompts, or the sample. We therefore register no cross-LLM inferential comparison of token totals, pre-specify two cache-neutral secondary outcomes for the review stage (review iterations, and uncached input plus output tokens), and note that the within-LLM slopes H1 tests are unaffected, because each LLM’s cache regime is constant across its own 465 PRs.
paragraphs.zh: 前缀缓存对三个大语言模型在智能体循环各次迭代中重复上下文的统计方式不同（表4，最右列）。 这意味着总 token 数在不同大语言模型之间不可直接比较。 我们自己的试点数据显示了这一效应的大小。 当本地大语言模型从无前缀缓存的服务栈迁移到 80.6% 输入 token 由缓存提供的服务栈时，在完全相同的 45 个试点 PR 集合上，其足迹与成本的秩相关从 ρ = .50 \rho=.50 降至 ρ = .27 \rho=.27，而大语言模型、提示词和样本均未改变。 因此，我们不注册跨大语言模型的 token 总量推断性比较，预先指定两个对缓存中立的次要结局供评审阶段使用（评审迭代次数，以及未缓存输入加输出 token），并指出 H1 检验的组内大语言模型斜率不受影响，因为每个大语言模型的缓存机制在其自身的 465 个 PR 中保持恒定。

paragraphs.en: Baseline CodeHealth is the mean of the per-file CH scores over the files the PR changes, taken at the PR’s head commit before the review-and-fix pipeline runs and weighted by the number of lines the PR changes in each file. It is measured using CodeScene’s Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool locked to version 1.4.0 . Because of the weighting, a file with two changed lines does not move a PR’s score as much as a file with two hundred. The three tiers are used as a stratifier for building the cell matrix, while the analysis model uses the continuous score. CH is a deterministic static analysis metric, so the relevant stability risk is version drift only. This is mitigated by locking the version for the duration of the experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 基线 CodeHealth 是 PR 所变更各文件在审阅与修复流水线运行前、以 PR 头提交为准的每文件 CH 得分的均值，并按 PR 在每个文件中变更的行数加权。 该度量使用锁定为 1.4.0 版本的 CodeScene 的模型上下文协议（MCP）工具进行测量。 由于这种加权方式，一个只变更两行的文件对 PR 得分的影响不及变更两百行的文件。 这三个层级被用作构建单元格矩阵的分层依据，而分析模型则使用连续得分。 CH 是确定性的静态分析指标，因此相关的稳定性风险仅在于版本漂移。 通过在实验期间锁定版本来缓解该风险。

paragraphs.en: Total tokens per PR, defined as the sum of input and output tokens across the four review agents and the fix agent. Cached tokens are a reported subset of input tokens in this accounting, not an additional pool, and are recorded separately for cost weighting.

paragraphs.en: Review iterations, fix iterations, comment count per reviewer role, and Δ \Delta CodeHealth, defined as the post-fix score minus the baseline score. Where the post-fix measurement returns no file scores, Δ \Delta CodeHealth is recorded as missing, not as zero, and excluded pairwise, since the scale starts at 1.0 and an invalid score can only indicate measurement failure.

paragraphs.en: We treat PR footprint ( log \log changed lines) as a mediator candidate rather than a covariate. Repository language is treated as a fixed factor, and repository identity as a random intercept.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 PR 足迹（\log \log 变更行数）视为中介变量候选，而非协变量。 仓库语言被视为固定因子，仓库身份被视为随机截距。

sents.en: We treat PR footprint ( log \log changed lines) as a mediator candidate rather than a covariate.
sents.zh: 我们将 PR 足迹（\log \log 变更行数）视为中介变量候选，而非协变量。

sents.en: Repository language is treated as a fixed factor, and repository identity as a random intercept.
sents.zh: 仓库语言被视为固定因子，仓库身份被视为随机截距。

paragraphs.en: The primary model is a linear mixed model with a random intercept for repository,
paragraphs.zh: 主模型是一个以仓库为随机截距的线性混合模型，

paragraphs.en: log ⁡ ( 𝑡𝑜𝑘𝑒𝑛𝑠 ​ _ ​ 𝑡𝑜𝑡𝑎𝑙 ) ∼ ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ + log ⁡ ( 𝑓𝑜𝑜𝑡𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑛𝑡 ) + 𝑙𝑎𝑛𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑔𝑒 + ( 1 | 𝑟𝑒𝑝𝑜 ) , \displaystyle\log(\mathit{tokens\_total})\sim\mathit{health}+\log(\mathit{footprint})+\mathit{language}+(1|\mathit{repo}),
paragraphs.zh: log ⁡ ( 𝑡𝑜𝑘𝑒𝑛𝑠 ​ _ ​ 𝑡𝑜𝑡𝑎𝑙 ) ∼ ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ + log ⁡ ( 𝑓𝑜𝑜𝑡𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑛𝑡 ) + 𝑙𝑎𝑛𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑔𝑒 + ( 1 | 𝑟𝑒𝑝𝑜 ) , \displaystyle\log(\mathit{tokens\_total})\sim\mathit{health}+\log(\mathit{footprint})+\mathit{language}+(1|\mathit{repo}),

paragraphs.en: fitted with restricted maximum likelihood in statsmodels 0.14.6 ( Seabold and Perktold 2010 ) under Python 3.12, with language entered as a fixed factor using the most frequent language as reference, and two-sided α = .05 \alpha=.05 throughout. No random slopes are fitted, because 246 repositories at a mean of 1.89 PRs each cannot support them.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Python 3.12 环境下使用 statsmodels 0.14.6（Seabold 和 Perktold 2010）以限制性最大似然法拟合，将语言作为固定因子纳入模型并以出现频次最高的语言作为参照组，全文采用双侧 α = .05 \alpha=.05。 未拟合随机斜率，因为 246 个仓库（平均每个仅 1.89 个 PR）无法支持随机斜率的估计。

sents.zh: 未拟合随机斜率，因为 246 个仓库（平均每个仅 1.89 个 PR）无法支持随机斜率的估计。

paragraphs.en: The model is fitted separately for each of the three LLMs. The three fits share the same 465 PRs, and a PR that is intrinsically expensive to review is expensive for every LLM that reviews it: on pilot data, the within-PR residual intraclass correlation was .581, a design effect of 2.16, meaning pooled rows provide less than half their apparent information. Naive pooling would have turned a non-significant CodeHealth effect into an apparently significant one (Section 6.4 ). A CH by LLM interaction term was rejected on interpretability grounds: the three LLMs differ simultaneously in provider, quantization, serving stack, cache regime, and loop behavior, so a significant interaction term would establish only that three heterogeneously served instruments behaved differently. The conjunctive success criterion for H1 follows from this design. Requiring that all three estimates agree in sign and that at least two confidence intervals exclude zero is a replication criterion, so no multiplicity correction is applied to it.
paragraphs.zh: 该模型针对三个大语言模型分别进行拟合。 三次拟合使用相同的 465 个 PR，而一个本质上审查成本高的 PR 对每一个审查它的 LLM 来说成本都高：在试点数据中，PR 内残差的组内相关系数为 .581，设计效应为 2.16，意味着合并后的行所提供的信息不到其表面信息的一半。 朴素的合并曾把一个不显著的 CodeHealth 效应变成了看似显著的效应（第 6.4 节）。 基于可解释性的考虑，我们拒绝了 CH 与 LLM 的交互项：这三个 LLM 在提供商、量化、服务栈、缓存机制和循环行为上同时存在差异，因此显著的交互项只能说明三个服务方式各异的工具表现不同。 H1 的合取式成功标准源于这一设计。 要求三个估计值符号一致且至少两个置信区间不包含零，这是一项复制标准，因此不对其实施多重性校正。

sents.en: The model is fitted separately for each of the three LLMs.
sents.zh: 该模型针对三个大语言模型分别进行拟合。

sents.en: The three fits share the same 465 PRs, and a PR that is intrinsically expensive to review is expensive for every LLM that reviews it: on pilot data, the within-PR residual intraclass correlation was .581, a design effect of 2.16, meaning pooled rows provide less than half their apparent information.
sents.zh: 三次拟合使用相同的 465 个 PR，而一个本质上审查成本高的 PR 对每一个审查它的 LLM 来说成本都高：在试点数据中，PR 内残差的组内相关系数为 .581，设计效应为 2.16，意味着合并后的行所提供的信息不到其表面信息的一半。

sents.zh: 朴素的合并曾把一个不显著的 CodeHealth 效应变成了看似显著的效应（第 6.4 节）。

sents.en: A CH by LLM interaction term was rejected on interpretability grounds: the three LLMs differ simultaneously in provider, quantization, serving stack, cache regime, and loop behavior, so a significant interaction term would establish only that three heterogeneously served instruments behaved differently.
sents.zh: 基于可解释性的考虑，我们拒绝了 CH 与 LLM 的交互项：这三个 LLM 在提供商、量化、服务栈、缓存机制和循环行为上同时存在差异，因此显著的交互项只能说明三个服务方式各异的工具表现不同。

sents.zh: H1 的合取式成功标准源于这一设计。

sents.en: Requiring that all three estimates agree in sign and that at least two confidence intervals exclude zero is a replication criterion, so no multiplicity correction is applied to it.

paragraphs.en: RQ 2 is answered by a three-path decomposition on the same model family: the association from CodeHealth to log \log footprint, the association from log \log footprint to cost, and the direct CH-to-cost path conditional on footprint, which is the coefficient in the primary model. The decomposition is associational; because tasks are not matched across CH levels, the analysis cannot establish whether unhealthy code causes larger PRs.
paragraphs.zh: RQ 2 通过对同一模型家族进行三段路径分解来回答：CodeHealth 与日志 \log 占用之间的关联、日志 \log 占用与成本之间的关联，以及在控制日志占用条件下的 CH 到成本的直接路径，即主模型中的系数。 该分解仅为关联性分析；由于各任务未在不同 CH 水平之间进行匹配，该分析无法确定不健康的代码是否会导致更大的 PR。

paragraphs.en: RQ 3 tests three code smell categories, selected from pilot data by a deterministic rule that was fixed before the main collection ran: retain a smell only if it is present in at least 10 of the 45 pilot PRs, only if all three LLMs agree on the sign of its partial correlation after controlling for log \log changed lines, and only if the mean adjusted | ρ | |\rho| across the three LLMs is at least .20; then rank the survivors and take the top three. The full list of code smells with their correlations on the pilot PRs is available in the pre-registration package. Table 5 shows the result. Each smell was registered together with a one-sentence mechanism. For Complex Method, tangled control flow forces the fix agent to trace several execution paths before it can safely edit any one of them. For Code Duplication, a fix must be located and reconciled across several call sites. For Complex Conditional, the agent must reason through each branch’s interaction with the PR. RQ 3 targets the fix stage because that is where the agent edits code, and prior work found that AI edits break unhealthy code more often ( Borg et al. 2026a ) ; complex and duplicated code were expected to require edits in more places or more reasoning per edit, while the review stage is covered by RQ 1 . Each smell is tested as a partial Spearman correlation against log 1 ​ p \log_{1p} fix-agent tokens, controlling for log \log changed lines, and Holm-corrected within this three-hypothesis family.
paragraphs.zh: RQ 3 测试三个代码坏味道类别，它们是从试点数据中通过一条确定性规则选出的，该规则在主数据收集开始前就已固定：仅当某个坏味道出现在 45 个试点 PR 中至少 10 个里、且三个 LLM 在控制 log \log 变更行数后对其偏相关系数的符号判断一致、且三个 LLM 的平均校正 | ρ | |\rho| 至少为 .20 时，才保留该坏味道；然后对幸存者排序并取前三名。 完整的代码坏味道列表及其在试点 PR 上的相关性见预注册包。 表 5 展示了结果。 每个坏味道在注册时都附有一句机制的描述。 对于复杂方法，纠缠的控制流迫使修复智能体在能够安全地编辑任何一条执行路径之前，先追踪多条执行路径。 对于代码重复，修复必须在多个调用点处定位并协调一致。 对于复杂条件，智能体必须推理每个分支与 PR 的交互。 RQ 3 针对修复阶段，因为这是智能体编辑代码的地方，且先前的工作发现 AI 编辑更常破坏不健康的代码（Borg et al. 2026a）；预计复杂和重复的代码需要在更多地方进行编辑或每次编辑需要更多推理，而评审阶段由 RQ 1 涵盖。 每个坏味道都被测试为与 log 1 ​ p \log_{1p} 修复智能体 token 数的偏 Spearman 相关，控制 log \log 变更行数，并在这三个假设族内进行 Holm 校正。

paragraphs.en: Exclusion criteria were specified in advance. A PR is excluded from a given LLM’s fit only if its repository is no longer clonable or its base or head commit no longer resolvable, if the analysis tool cannot score any changed file, or if no completed fix record exists for that LLM after the documented retry path. An excluded PR is reported as attrition for its cell and LLM and is not replaced. In total, 28 runs out of 1,395 are excluded, an average attrition of 2 % 2\% . Every one of the 28 is a fix session that a loop guard stopped before it completed, 12 for deepseek-v4-flash , 4 for qwen3-6 , and 12 for sonnet-5 ; none is an infrastructure failure.
paragraphs.zh: 排除标准是预先设定的。 仅在以下情况下，某个 PR 才会被排除出给定 LLM 的拟合范围：其仓库已无法克隆，或其基线提交或头部提交已无法解析；分析工具无法对任何已更改的文件进行评分；或者在经过文档中记录的重试路径后，该 LLM 仍不存在已完成的修复记录。 被排除的 PR 会被记为其所属单元格和 LLM 的损耗，且不予替换。 总计 1,395 次运行中有 28 次被排除，平均损耗率为 2% 2\%。 这 28 个全部是修复会话被循环保护机制在完成前中止的情况，其中 deepseek-v4-flash 有 12 个，qwen3-6 有 4 个，sonnet-5 有 12 个；没有任何一个是基础设施故障。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 shows how non-complete agent sessions are treated. Guard-stopped review sessions, in which a loop guard terminated a review agent after partial output, are kept: an agent that spirals on a difficult diff has incurred real cost, and filtering that cost out would understate what reviewing that diff actually takes. Pilot data motivated this choice at registration. In pilot 3, reviewer sessions terminated by truncation were statistically indistinguishable from the rest of the sample on baseline CodeHealth (Mann-Whitney p = .61 p=.61 ), and excluding them strengthened the CH slope for that LLM, from β = − 0.089 \beta=-0.089 to β = − 0.110 \beta=-0.110 , so exclusion would have favored H1. The main collection does not reproduce that independence, as Section 4.2 reports. As registered, the primary fit is repeated for every LLM without the PRs that contain a non-complete agent session. In the retained main-collection sample, 103 qwen3-6 PRs contain at least one guard-stopped review session, 120 sessions in total; the corresponding count is zero for the other two LLMs, whose sensitivity fits are identical to their primary fits.
paragraphs.zh: 表6展示了如何处理不完整的智能体会话。 由防护停止的评审会话（即循环防护在评审智能体输出部分内容后将其终止）被保留下来：一个在困难差异上陷入循环的智能体已经产生了真实成本，过滤掉该成本会低估评审该差异的实际代价。 试点数据在预注册时支持了这一选择。 在试点3中，因截断而终止的评审者会话在基线CodeHealth上与样本其余部分在统计上无显著差异（Mann-Whitney p = .61 p=.61），而排除它们会增强该LLM的CH斜率，从 β = − 0.089 \beta=-0.089 提高到 β = − 0.110 \beta=-0.110，因此排除将有利于H1。 如第4.2节所述，主数据收集并未重现这种独立性。 按照预注册，对每个LLM重复主拟合，但剔除包含非完整智能体会话的PR。 在保留的主数据收集样本中，103个qwen3-6 PR包含至少一个由防护停止的评审会话，共计120个会话；另外两个LLM的对应计数为零，其敏感性拟合与它们的主拟合相同。

paragraphs.en: The pipeline is run once per PR per LLM, so the main collection cannot separate the part of a PR’s measured cost that is a stable property of the diff from run-to-run variation in the agents themselves. Temperature 0 does not make a served LLM deterministic, and an agentic tool loop amplifies whatever variation reaches it, because a single divergent tool call redirects the remainder of the trajectory and therefore the token count.
paragraphs.zh: 该流水线对每个 PR 和每个大语言模型各运行一次，因此主数据集无法将某次 PR 实测成本中作为 diff 稳定属性的部分，与智能体自身的运行间波动区分开来。 温度设为 0 并不能使已部署的大语言模型具有确定性，而智能体式的工具循环会放大任何传入的波动，因为一次偏离的工具调用会改变后续整条轨迹，从而改变 token 数量。
