sents.en: Temperature 0 does not make a served LLM deterministic, and an agentic tool loop amplifies whatever variation reaches it, because a single divergent tool call redirects the remainder of the trajectory and therefore the token count.

paragraphs.en: To measure that variation, we draw 27 PRs from the 465-PR sample, three per cell of the 3 × 3 3\times 3 grid, under a fixed seed and a cap of one PR per repository, and run the full pipeline on them twice more with every LLM. Together with the main collection this gives three runs per PR per LLM. The instrument is unchanged across replicates. Selection uses predictors only and never conditions on an observed outcome: drawing the subsample from PRs already seen to spiral or truncate would estimate the variance of the tail rather than of the instrument. The subsample spans 27 distinct repositories, all five languages, all five originating coding agents, the full range of baseline CodeHealth, and footprints from 1 to 5,474 changed lines.
paragraphs.zh: 为测量该变异，我们从465个PR的样本中抽取27个PR，在3×3网格的每个单元格中各抽3个，采用固定随机种子并限制每个仓库最多1个PR，然后用每个大语言模型对它们再完整运行两次流水线。 加上主采集，这使每个PR在每个大语言模型下共有三次运行。 测量工具在各次重复中保持不变。 选择仅使用预测变量，绝不以观测到的结果为条件：若从已被发现会失控或截断的PR中抽取子样本，估计的将是尾部的方差而非测量工具的方差。 该子样本覆盖27个不同的仓库、全部五种语言、全部五个来源编程智能体、基线CodeHealth的完整取值范围，以及从1到5,474行变更的代码足迹。

paragraphs.en: The replicates are analyzed by fitting an intercept-only mixed model with a random intercept per PR, separately for each LLM, which partitions the residual into a between-PR component and a run-to-run component. We report their ratio, λ \lambda , and the implied reliability of a single run, ICC( k = 1 k=1 ), in Section 4.6.5 . This analysis is exploratory: it is not part of the registration, and the replicates are not averaged into the confirmatory estimates, which remain based on a single run per PR per LLM as registered.
paragraphs.zh: 通过对每个 PR 拟合仅含截距的混合模型（每个 PR 有一个随机截距），并分别针对每个智能体（LLM）进行拟合来分析重复实验，从而将残差分解为 PR 间成分和逐次运行成分。 我们在第 4.6.5 节中报告二者的比值 λ \lambda，以及单次运行的隐含信度 ICC( k = 1 k=1 )。 该分析是探索性的：它不属于预注册内容，且重复实验的结果不会平均到验证性估计中；验证性估计仍按预注册所述，基于每个 PR 在每个智能体上的单次运行结果。

paragraphs.en: The registration was made after the predictors had been measured and audited for balance. To use our hardware execution window, we started the review agents on 2026-08-19, while the registration was being written, and froze the registration on 2026-08-20 at 14:14. By then, deepseek-v4-flash had completed review sessions for 241 PRs and qwen3-6 for 84, and these sessions remain in the analyzed corpus. Their token, iteration, and comment counts were stored on our cluster before the filing but were never read. The fix stage, which every analyzable row requires, started only after the filing: the earliest fix session in the collection began on 2026-08-20 at 18:23. No post-fix CodeHealth score, and therefore no complete row for any PR, existed when the registration was filed. The agent prompts were last changed on 2026-07-11, so every session, before and after the filing, ran the prompts whose hashes the registration records. The no-peeking constraint therefore depends on procedure for the review-stage sessions that predate the filing, and on construction for everything else. The filed registration stated that the pipeline had not yet been run on the sample; we corrected that statement in a transparency note filed on 2026-09-24 as an update to the registration, which records the chronology above and changes no hypothesis, design decision, or analysis. OSF keeps each update as a version of the same record, so the original filing, the amendment described below, and the note are all reachable through the registration DOI ( DOI:10.17605/OSF.IO/FBJCT ).
paragraphs.zh: 注册是在预测指标已完成测量并经平衡性审计之后进行的。 为了利用我们的硬件执行窗口，我们在 2026-08-19 启动了评审智能体，当时注册文件正在撰写中，并于 2026-08-20 14:14 冻结了注册文件。 截至那时，deepseek-v4-flash 已完成 241 个 PR 的评审会话，qwen3-6 已完成 84 个 PR 的评审会话，这些会话均保留在分析语料库中。 它们的 token、迭代和评论计数在提交注册之前已存储在我们的集群上，但从未被读取过。 修复阶段（每个可分析行都需要经历该阶段）仅在提交注册之后才开始：数据集中最早的修复会话始于 2026-08-20 18:23。 提交注册时，不存在任何修复后的 CodeHealth 分数，因此也不存在任何 PR 的完整行。 智能体提示词最后修改于 2026-07-11，因此无论是提交注册之前还是之后的每一个会话，运行的提示词哈希值都与注册文件中记录的一致。 因此，“不偷看”约束对于早于提交时间的评审阶段会话依赖于流程保证，对于其余所有内容则依赖于构造保证。 提交的注册文件中声明该流水线尚未在样本上运行过；我们在 2026-09-24 提交的一份透明度说明中更正了这一陈述，该说明作为注册文件的更新提交，记录了上述时间线，且未更改任何假设、设计决策或分析。 OSF 将每次更新保存为同一记录的一个版本，因此原始提交、下文所述的修正案以及该说明均可通过注册 DOI（ DOI:10.17605/OSF.IO/FBJCT ）访问。

paragraphs.en: One amendment to the registration was filed on 2026-08-22, while the main collection was running. The review and fix agents read and search the worktree through the small tool surface of Section 3.6 , and two of those tools bounded their result by number of lines and not by number of characters, while the tool returning a diff was not bounded at all. A single line of a minified bundle, a generated source file, or a committed build artifact can be megabytes long, so one tool call could return an arbitrarily large result: in the part of the collection completed when the defect was found, 47 agent sessions across 27 PRs contained at least one call returning 100,000 characters or more, and the largest single result was 11.3 million characters. When an oversized result pushes the next LLM call past the context window, the session terminates as an error; we confirmed four such sessions. When a retry of the same role instead avoids the fatal call, the session completes normally, and the oversized results it did absorb are recorded as ordinary cost: one such DesignReviewer session completed with 1.8 million input tokens, two to three orders of magnitude above a normal session on a comparable diff, with nothing in its record to distinguish it from unaffected data.
paragraphs.zh: 2026-08-22，即在主数据收集运行期间，提交了一项注册修正。 审查和修复智能体通过第 3.6 节的小型工具面读取和检索工作树，其中两个工具以行数而非字符数来限制返回结果，而返回 diff 的工具则完全没有限制。 压缩打包文件、生成的源文件或已提交的构建产物中的单行可能长达数兆字节，因此一次工具调用可能返回任意大的结果：在发现该缺陷时已完成收集的部分中，27 个 PR 的 47 个智能体会话至少包含一次返回 100,000 字符或更多的调用，且最大的单个结果达 1130 万字符。 当过大的结果使下一次 LLM 调用超出上下文窗口时，该会话会以错误终止；我们确认了四个这样的会话。 当同一角色的重试避免了致命调用时，会话正常完成，其已吸收的过大结果被记录为普通成本：一个这样的 DesignReviewer 会话以 180 万输入 token 完成，比处理可比 diff 的普通会话高出两到三个数量级，且其记录中没有任何内容能将其与未受影响的数据区分开。

paragraphs.en: The fix caps the searching and file-reading tools at 2,000 characters per line and replaces any longer line with a fixed marker. The threshold was set by measurement: across 283,829 source lines sampled from 55 repositories in the study’s own clone cache it blanks 0.022% of lines, and it is about 150 times shorter than the shortest pathological line confirmed in our data, at 310,647 characters. The diff tool is treated differently and is not capped at all. Its output is written to a session-scoped file inside the worktree and served through the already paginated file-reading tool, so nothing is discarded. We chose a lossless mechanism for the diff tool because PRs that trigger large diff reads skew toward the large-footprint tercile, at 50.0% against 32.7% in the full sample, and footprint is both a term and a mediator candidate in the primary model, so truncating at that tool would have introduced an artifact correlated with a predictor of interest.

paragraphs.en: The amendment changed no agent prompt, no LLM, no sampling decision, and no part of the analysis plan; the prompt hashes filed with the registration are unchanged, and the amendment records the commit at which the corrected instrument was re-frozen. Collection was stopped when the defect was found and resumed only after the amendment had been filed. Of the 465 PRs, 67 had data collected under at least one pre-fix tool, 28 of them showing the oversized-output signature directly; all 67 were archived byte for byte and then collected again from scratch under the corrected instrument, so every estimate in Section 4 is based on data from the corrected tools and the achieved sample is unchanged. Had the defect gone unnoticed, those PRs would have entered the primary regression with token counts inflated by up to three orders of magnitude, and that inflation is not distributed at random: it occurs when a changed repository happens to contain a large generated or minified file, which depends on the repository and not on the CodeHealth of the files the PR changes, and it concentrates in the largest footprint tercile. We cannot say which way such rows would have moved β ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ \beta_{\mathit{health}} . Because they would have sat unmarked in the tail of the primary outcome, we removed the defect at the instrument instead of correcting for it in the analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 该修订未改动任何智能体提示词、任何大语言模型、任何抽样决策，也未改动分析计划的任何部分；随注册提交的提示词哈希保持不变，且该修订记录了修正后的工具被重新冻结时所对应的提交（commit）。 在发现该缺陷时即停止了数据收集，仅在修订提交之后才恢复收集。 在这465个PR中，有67个PR的部分数据是由至少一个含缺陷的工具采集的，其中28个直接显示出输出过大的特征；这67个PR全部被逐字节存档，随后使用修正后的工具从零重新采集，因此第4节中的每一项估计都基于修正后工具的数据，且实际达成的样本保持不变。 如果该缺陷未被发现，这些PR将以膨胀至多三个数量级的token计数进入主回归，且这种膨胀并非随机分布：它发生在被修改的仓库恰好包含某个较大的生成文件或压缩文件之时，这取决于仓库本身而不取决于PR所修改文件的CodeHealth，并且它集中在足迹最大的那个三分位组中。 我们无法说明这些数据行会使 β_health 朝哪个方向移动。 由于这些数据行会不加标记地落入主要结果分布的尾部，我们在工具层面消除了该缺陷，而不是在分析中对其加以校正。

paragraphs.en: Each PR’s structured session record, comprising per-agent token counts, iteration counts, tool-call counts, termination reasons, emitted comments, the applied patch, and CodeHealth before and after, is included for every run the paper reports, as is the raw transcript of every agent session behind those records: the prompts as sent, every tool invocation in order, the LLM’s reasoning and output at each turn, and the guard decision that ended the loop. Transcripts record the size of each tool result, not its content; because the review agents’ tools are deterministic functions of the repository state and the logged arguments, and the tool implementation, the repository, and the exact commit are all published, what an agent was shown can be reconstructed by replaying its logged call sequence, with the recorded result sizes as the check. The fix agent is the exception: its edit payloads are elided and its working tree changes as edits are applied, so its intermediate states are bounded by the head commit and the applied patch but cannot be reproduced byte for byte.
paragraphs.zh: 每个PR的结构化会话记录——包括各智能体的token计数、迭代次数、工具调用次数、终止原因、发出的评论、应用的补丁以及前后的CodeHealth——都包含在论文报告的每次运行中；这些记录背后的每个智能体会话的原始转录记录也一并包含：按原样发送的提示词、按顺序的每次工具调用、LLM在每一轮的推理和输出，以及结束循环的守卫判定。 转录记录记载的是每个工具结果的大小，而非其内容；由于评审智能体的工具是仓库状态和所记录参数的确定性函数，且工具实现、仓库和确切提交均已公开，因此可以通过重放智能体所记录的调用序列来重建其看到的内容，并以记录的结果大小作为校验。 修复智能体是例外：其编辑载荷被省略，且随着编辑的应用其工作树会发生变化，因此其中间状态只能由头提交和已应用的补丁来界定，而无法逐字节复现。

paragraphs.en: The study uses the guidelines for empirical software engineering studies involving large language models of Baltes et al. (2025) , which organize such work into seven study types and specify eight guidelines with requirements and recommendations. Under that taxonomy, the four review agents and the fix agent constitute a new software engineering tool built from LLMs. The applicable requirements concern declaration of LLM usage, LLM version and configuration, system and prompt design, session traces, and the inclusion of an open-weight baseline. The paragraph above declares the LLM usage outside the instrument. Section 3.7 reports each LLM’s identifier, version, serving stack, and generation parameters, with the locally served LLM pinned to an exact revision and a hash-checked environment. Section 3.6 describes the agent roles, the control loop, and the tool surface. Every prompt was hashed before registration and is published in full. Section 3.13 describes the per-PR session records and the raw transcript of every agent session. The locally served open-weight LLM is present alongside the two commercial LLMs, as the guidelines recommend for reproducibility.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究遵循 Baltes 等人（2025）提出的针对涉及大语言模型的实证软件工程研究的指南。 该指南将此类工作归纳为七种研究类型，并规定了八条包含要求与建议的指南。 在该分类体系下，四个审查智能体和修复智能体构成了一个由大语言模型构建的全新软件工程工具。 适用的要求涉及声明大语言模型的使用情况、大语言模型的版本与配置、系统与提示设计、会话轨迹，以及包含一个开放权重基线。 上一段在工具之外声明了大语言模型的使用情况。 第 3.7 节报告了每个大语言模型的标识符、版本、服务栈和生成参数，其中本地服务的大语言模型被固定到确切版本，并使用经过哈希校验的环境。 第 3.6 节描述了智能体角色、控制循环和工具接口。 每个提示词在注册前都经过哈希处理，并全文公开发布。 第 3.13 节描述了逐 PR 的会话记录以及每个智能体会话的原始记录。 出于指南对可复现性的建议，本地服务的开放权重大语言模型与两个商业大语言模型并列存在。

paragraphs.en: Two recommendations are met only in part. Baltes et al. (2025) recommend repeating experiments to characterize LLM non-determinism. For cost and environmental impact reasons, the repetition is limited to the 27-PR subsample of Section 3.11 . They further recommend validating LLM outputs against human judgment where the quality of the generated artifacts bears on the conclusions; we do not assess whether the review comments are correct or the fixes are good. Both gaps are discussed as threats, under reliability of treatment implementation (Section 6.4 ) and mono-method bias (Section 6.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 两项建议仅部分得到满足。Baltes 等人 （2025）建议重复实验以刻画 LLM 的非确定性。 出于成本和环境影响的考虑，重复仅限于第 3.11 节的 27 个 PR 子样本。 他们进一步建议，在生成工件的质量会影响结论时，将 LLM 输出与人类判断进行对照验证；我们并未评估评审意见是否正确或修复是否良好。 这两个缺口均作为威胁加以讨论，分别对应处理实施的可靠性（第 6.4 节）和单一方法偏差（第 6.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: We first apply the decomposition checklist from Section 3.3 to every LLM. The repository-by-cell audit was clean: the largest single-repository share of any tier’s PRs was 4.1%. The single-PR outlier check likewise cleared, with no single PR accounting for more than 8.2% of any tier’s token sum, well under the 20% alarm threshold. Footprint-adjusted cost (median tokens per changed line) decreased monotonically from the unhealthy to the healthy tier for every LLM, so the tier gradient survived normalizing for PR size. One flag did surface: the mean-to-median ratio for sonnet-5 exceeded the 1.5 skew threshold in all three tiers, so we report sonnet-5 using medians only and treat its mean token total as uninformative.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先将第 3.3 节的分解检查清单应用于每一个大语言模型。 按仓库逐项审计结果良好：任一层级的 PR 中，单一仓库的最大占比仅为 4.1%。 单一 PR 的异常值检查同样通过，没有任何单个 PR 占任一层级令牌总数的 8.2% 以上，远低于 20% 的警报阈值。 足迹调整后的成本（每变更行的令牌数中位数）在所有大语言模型中均从不健康层级到健康层级单调递减，因此在对 PR 规模进行归一化后，层级梯度依然存在。 确实出现了一个警示：sonnet-5 的均值与中位数之比在全部三个层级中都超过了 1.5 的偏斜阈值，因此我们仅使用中位数来报告 sonnet-5，并将其均值令牌总数视为无参考价值。

paragraphs.en: Table 8 and Fig. 5 report the primary fit. All three coefficients were negative with 95% confidence intervals that excluded zero, so H1 is supported. The registered criterion required all three estimates to be negative and at least two of the three intervals to exclude zero; the result exceeded that threshold, since all three excluded it. One additional CH point was associated with an estimated 6.1% reduction in total tokens for deepseek-v4-flash (95% CI [3.4, 8.6]%), 4.8% for qwen3-6 (95% CI [1.4, 8.1]%), and 3.5% for sonnet-5 (95% CI [0.1, 6.8]%), holding footprint, language, and repository constant. sonnet-5 ’s interval came closest to zero, which we return to under conclusion validity (Section 6.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 表8和图5报告了主要拟合结果。 三个系数均为负值，且其95%置信区间均不包含零，因此H1得到支持。 预注册的判定标准要求三个估计值均为负值，且三个区间中至少有两个不包含零；而本结果超出了该阈值，因为三个区间均不包含零。 在保持足迹、语言和仓库不变的情况下，每增加一个CH点，deepseek-v4-flash的总令牌数估计减少6.1%（95% CI [3.4, 8.6]%），qwen3-6减少4.8%（95% CI [1.4, 8.1]%），sonnet-5减少3.5%（95% CI [0.1, 6.8]%）。sonnet-5的区间最接近零，我们将在结论效度部分（第6.4节）再回到这一点进行讨论。

paragraphs.en: The median unhealthy-tier PR scores CH 2.8 and the median healthy-tier PR CH 9.7, a difference of 6.9 CH points. We chose to compare the difference between typical PRs for each tier, rather than between the extremes of the 1–10 scale. This gives an aggregated reduction in token cost going from a typical unhealthy-tier PR to an equivalently sized healthy-tier one of 35.0% for deepseek-v4-flash , 28.9% for qwen3-6 , and 21.8% for sonnet-5 . These figures are algebraic transforms of the fitted point estimate β ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ \beta_{\mathit{health}} , not medians or means of the per-PR token totals.

paragraphs.en: The registered sensitivity analysis refits the primary model without the PRs that contain a non-complete agent session (Section 3.10 ). For deepseek-v4-flash and sonnet-5 , no retained PR contains one, so their sensitivity fits coincide with Table 8 . For qwen3-6 , excluding the 103 affected PRs attenuated the coefficient from β = − 0.049 \beta=-0.049 (95% CI [ − 0.085 , − 0.014 ] [-0.085,-0.014] ) to β = − 0.026 \beta=-0.026 (95% CI [ − 0.068 , 0.016 ] [-0.068,0.016] , p = .23 p=.23 , n = 358 n=358 across 203 repositories). The excluded PRs were not a random subset of the sample: their median baseline CodeHealth was 6.9 against 8.4 for the retained PRs, their median footprint was 134 changed lines against 87, and their median token total was 2.6 times higher. All but one of their 120 guard-stopped sessions ended as a spiral , whereas the pilot evidence in Section 3.10 concerned truncated sessions. Excluding these PRs therefore removes the low-CH, high-cost end of the distribution, i.e., it conditions the sample on a consequence of the outcome, so an attenuated slope is expected. H1 remains supported under the sensitivity fits, with all three coefficients negative and two of three intervals excluding zero. However, qwen3-6 ’s own interval excludes zero only with these sessions retained, so that LLM’s individual result depends on the registered decision to count a spiraling review as cost rather than as noise.
paragraphs.zh: 注册的敏感性分析会剔除包含非完整智能体会话的 PR 后重新拟合主模型（第 3.10 节）。 对于 deepseek-v4-flash 和 sonnet-5，没有保留的 PR 包含此类会话，因此它们的敏感性分析拟合结果与表 8 一致。 对于 qwen3-6，剔除 103 个受影响的 PR 后，系数从 β = −0.049（95% CI [−0.085, −0.014]）减弱为 β = −0.026（95% CI [−0.068, 0.016]，p = .23，n = 358，涉及 203 个代码仓库）。 被剔除的 PR 并非样本的随机子集：它们的中位基线 CodeHealth 为 6.9，而保留的 PR 为 8.4；它们的中位足迹为 134 行改动，而保留的 PR 为 87 行；它们的中位 token 总量高出 2.6 倍。 其 120 个被护栏中止的会话中，除一个外全部以螺旋（spiral）告终，而第 3.10 节的先导证据涉及的是被截断的会话。 因此，剔除这些 PR 去除了分布中低 CodeHealth、高成本的一端，也就是说，这使样本以结果的一个后果为条件，因此斜率减弱是预期之中的。 在敏感性分析拟合下，H1 仍然得到支持，三个系数均为负值，且三个区间中有两个不包含零。 然而，qwen3-6 自身的区间只有在保留这些会话时才不包含零，因此该 LLM 的单独结果取决于注册决策中把螺旋式评审计为成本而非噪声这一选择。

paragraphs.en: RQ 1 : Does baseline CodeHealth predict the token cost of agentic review and fix, controlling for PR footprint, language, and repository? Yes. One CH point is associated with an estimated 3.5% to 6.1% fewer total tokens (Table 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: RQ 1：在控制 PR 影响范围、编程语言和代码库的前提下，基线 CodeHealth 能否预测智能体式审查与修复的 token 成本？答案是肯定的。 CodeHealth 每提高 1 分，估计可减少 3.5% 至 6.1% 的总 token 数（表 8）。

paragraphs.en: RQ 2 asks whether the association in Section 4.2 is direct or whether it runs through the size of the PR that unhealthy code attracts. Table 9 reports all three paths of the registered decomposition (Section 3.9 ). Two of them are coefficients of the primary fit in Table 8 ; the CodeHealth-to-footprint path is one further fit per LLM, log ⁡ ( 𝑓𝑜𝑜𝑡𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑛𝑡 ) ∼ ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ + 𝑙𝑎𝑛𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑔𝑒 + ( 1 | 𝑟𝑒𝑝𝑜 ) \log(\mathit{footprint})\sim\mathit{health}+\mathit{language}+(1|\mathit{repo}) , which keeps the registered right-hand side except for log ⁡ ( 𝑓𝑜𝑜𝑡𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑛𝑡 ) \log(\mathit{footprint}) itself, because it is the outcome there.
paragraphs.zh: 研究问题 2（RQ 2）探讨 4.2 节中的关联是直接的，还是通过不健康代码所吸引的 PR 的规模而起作用。 表 9 报告了注册分解（见 3.9 节）的全部三条路径。 其中两个是表 8 中主拟合的系数；从 CodeHealth 到足迹（footprint）的路径则是每个 LLM 的再一次拟合，即 log(footprint) ∼ health + language + (1|repo)，除 log(footprint) 本身外保留了注册的右侧项，因为它在那里是结果变量。

paragraphs.en: The CodeHealth-to-footprint path was indistinguishable from zero for every LLM ( β \beta between + 0.007 +0.007 and + 0.014 +0.014 , every interval spanning zero, p ≥ .657 p\geq.657 ), so unhealthy PRs in this sample were not systematically larger ones. The joint stratification in Section 3.4 was designed to make this path observable, and the data show no such association. The footprint-to-cost path was the strongest association anywhere in the study ( β = + 0.325 \beta=+0.325 to + 0.595 +0.595 per unit of log \log footprint, all p < .001 p<.001 ), confirming that diff size is the dominant driver of token cost. The direct CH-to-cost path, conditional on footprint, is the coefficient already reported in Table 8 , negative with an interval excluding zero for all three LLMs. The CH effect is therefore direct with respect to PR footprint, which does not mediate it: unhealthy code was not measurably associated with larger PRs in this sample, and its extra cost persisted after footprint was held constant.

paragraphs.en: Table 11 reports Δ \Delta CodeHealth, the post-fix score minus the baseline score, per LLM. As registered, no hypothesis test is attached to this research question; it is reported as a description.
paragraphs.zh: 表 11 报告了每个大语言模型的 Δ \Delta CodeHealth，即修复后得分减去基线得分。 如预注册所述，该研究问题不附带你任何假设检验；仅作描述性报告。

sents.en: Table 11 reports Δ \Delta CodeHealth, the post-fix score minus the baseline score, per LLM.
sents.zh: 表 11 报告了每个大语言模型的 Δ \Delta CodeHealth，即修复后得分减去基线得分。

sents.en: As registered, no hypothesis test is attached to this research question; it is reported as a description.
sents.zh: 如预注册所述，该研究问题不附带你任何假设检验；仅作描述性报告。

paragraphs.en: The median Δ \Delta CodeHealth was exactly zero for every LLM, and the means were small and negative. Fig. 6 shows the per-LLM distributions behind those medians. A zero median does not mean that the fix pass leaves files untouched: the score was unchanged for 44.4%, 44.7%, and 49.0% of retained PRs, and among those that did move, degradations outnumbered improvements for every LLM, by 158 to 94, 168 to 87, and 136 to 95. Post-fix measurement succeeded for every retained PR, so no Δ \Delta CodeHealth value is missing. The zero median also held within each baseline tier, for every LLM, as Fig. 6 shows. Two limits on interpreting it follow from the descriptive form. First, a zero median shows only that no systematic shift is visible. It does not show that the batch fix pass neither repairs nor degrades CodeHealth, since no power analysis was made for Δ \Delta CodeHealth, and a description cannot exclude a small systematic effect in either direction. Second, the excess of degradations over improvements is untested for the same reason, and its consistency across the three LLMs is weaker support than it appears, since all three LLMs act on the same diffs (Section 3.9 ); we do not interpret it as a finding, as it may be a coincidence of this sample.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个大语言模型，Δ \Delta CodeHealth 的中位数恰好为零，均值较小且为负。 图 6 展示了这些中位数背后各模型的分布情况。 中位数为零并不意味着修复环节未改动文件：在保留的 PR 中，分数未变的比例分别为 44.4%、44.7% 和 49.0%，而在分数发生变化的文件中，每个模型的退化数量都多于改进数量，分别为 158 比 94、168 比 87 和 136 比 95。 所有保留的 PR 在修复后均成功完成测量，因此没有缺失的 Δ \Delta CodeHealth 值。 如图 6 所示，在每个基线层级内，该零中位数对所有大语言模型均成立。 由于其描述性性质，对其解读存在两点限制。 首先，零中位数仅表明未见系统性偏移。 它并不能表明批量修复环节既未修复也未损害 CodeHealth，因为我们未对 Δ \Delta CodeHealth 进行统计功效分析，而描述性结果无法排除任一方向上存在较小的系统性效应。 其次，基于同样的原因，退化多于改进这一现象未经检验，且其在三个大语言模型之间的一致性所提供的支持比看起来要弱，因为这三个大语言模型作用于相同的 diff（见 3.9 节）；我们不将其视为一项发现，因为它可能只是本样本的巧合。

paragraphs.en: We apply the Benjamini-Hochberg correction once, over a single family consisting of the 42 exploratory hypothesis tests reported in this subsection: the 30 stage and review-stage refits behind Table 12 and Table 13 , including the matched-subsample refits quoted in the text and the two registered cache-neutral secondary outcomes, the 6 coefficients of Table 14 , the 3 size-adjusted CodeHealth coefficients of Table 15 , and 3 zero-comment selection checks. The family is pooled across the three LLMs, since it counts the exploratory claims the paper makes, not the rows of any one LLM’s fit. The registration places every analysis that is not confirmatory under this correction, so the registered secondary outcomes are counted here and are not reported uncorrected. Two sets of tests belong outside it: the confirmatory fits of Section 4.2 and Section 4.3 , which the registration governs, and the nine RQ 3 smell hypotheses, which are Holm-corrected within each LLM’s own registered three-hypothesis family. Every table below reports the unadjusted p p next to the adjusted q BH q_{\mathrm{BH}} , and we call an exploratory result significant only at q BH < .05 q_{\mathrm{BH}}<.05 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们对单一族进行一次 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正，该族由本小节报告的 42 项探索性假设检验构成：表 12 和表 13 背后的 30 项阶段与评审阶段重拟合，包括文中引用的匹配子样本重拟合以及两项预注册的缓存中性次要结果；表 14 的 6 个系数；表 15 的 3 个经规模调整的 CodeHealth 系数；以及 3 项零评论选择检验。 该族在三个 LLM 之间合并计数，因为它统计的是论文提出的探索性主张，而不是任何一个 LLM 拟合的行数。 预注册将所有非验证性分析都置于该校正之下，因此预注册的次要结果计入此处，且不会以未校正的形式报告。 两组检验不属于该族：第 4.2 节和第 4.3 节的验证性拟合由预注册管辖；以及 RQ 3 的九项代码坏味假设，它们在各 LLM 自身预注册的三假设族内进行 Holm 校正。 下面的每张表都在调整后的 q_{\mathrm{BH}} 旁边报告未调整的 p 值，且我们仅当 q_{\mathrm{BH}}<.05 时才称某项探索性结果显著。

paragraphs.en: We decompose the RQ 1 effect by pipeline stage to find where in the code review and fix process the CodeHealth association is strongest. The registered outcome, 𝑡𝑜𝑘𝑒𝑛𝑠 ​ _ ​ 𝑡𝑜𝑡𝑎𝑙 \mathit{tokens\_total} , sums two stages that behave differently: a review stage that runs unconditionally on every PR, and a fix stage that runs only when the reviewer agents produced comments to act on. The analysis in this subsection refits the registered model form, log ⁡ ( 𝑜𝑢𝑡𝑐𝑜𝑚𝑒 ) ∼ ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ + log ⁡ ( 𝑓𝑜𝑜𝑡𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑛𝑡 ) + 𝑙𝑎𝑛𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑔𝑒 + ( 1 | 𝑟𝑒𝑝𝑜 ) \log(\mathit{outcome})\sim\mathit{health}+\log(\mathit{footprint})+\mathit{language}+(1|\mathit{repo}) , on each stage separately.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按流水线阶段分解研究问题 1 的效应，以找出代码审查与修复过程中代码健康度关联最强的环节。 预注册的结局指标 tokens_total 将两个行为不同的阶段相加：一个是在每个 PR 上无条件运行的审查阶段，另一个是仅在审阅智能体产生了需要处理的评论时才运行的修复阶段。 本小节的分析在各阶段上分别重新拟合预注册的模型形式 log(outcome) ∼ health + log(footprint) + language + (1|repo)。

sents.en: We decompose the RQ 1 effect by pipeline stage to find where in the code review and fix process the CodeHealth association is strongest.
sents.zh: 我们按流水线阶段分解研究问题 1 的效应，以找出代码审查与修复过程中代码健康度关联最强的环节。

sents.en: The registered outcome, 𝑡𝑜𝑘𝑒𝑛𝑠 ​ _ ​ 𝑡𝑜𝑡𝑎𝑙 \mathit{tokens\_total} , sums two stages that behave differently: a review stage that runs unconditionally on every PR, and a fix stage that runs only when the reviewer agents produced comments to act on.
sents.zh: 预注册的结局指标 tokens_total 将两个行为不同的阶段相加：一个是在每个 PR 上无条件运行的审查阶段，另一个是仅在审阅智能体产生了需要处理的评论时才运行的修复阶段。

sents.en: The analysis in this subsection refits the registered model form, log ⁡ ( 𝑜𝑢𝑡𝑐𝑜𝑚𝑒 ) ∼ ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ + log ⁡ ( 𝑓𝑜𝑜𝑡𝑝𝑟𝑖𝑛𝑡 ) + 𝑙𝑎𝑛𝑔𝑢𝑎𝑔𝑒 + ( 1 | 𝑟𝑒𝑝𝑜 ) \log(\mathit{outcome})\sim\mathit{health}+\log(\mathit{footprint})+\mathit{language}+(1|\mathit{repo}) , on each stage separately.

paragraphs.en: Table 12 reports the result. Removing the fix stage strengthened the CodeHealth effect. The review-only coefficient was more negative than the total-token coefficient for all three LLMs, moving from − 0.062 -0.062 to − 0.069 -0.069 for deepseek-v4-flash , from − 0.049 -0.049 to − 0.059 -0.059 for qwen3-6 , and from − 0.036 -0.036 to − 0.039 -0.039 for sonnet-5 . All three review-only intervals exclude zero and all three survive the correction, so the conjunctive criterion registered for RQ 1 would also be satisfied on a review-only outcome, with slightly more margin than the registered outcome provides. The ratio of coefficient to standard error rises for every LLM as well, from 4.46 to 4.84, from 2.75 to 3.06, and from 2.04 to 2.33, respectively, so the review-only outcome contains the same signal with less noise.
paragraphs.zh: 表 12 报告了结果。 去除修复阶段后，CodeHealth 效应得到增强。 对于全部三个 LLM，仅评审系数都比总 token 系数更为负向：deepseek-v4-flash 从 −0.062 变为 −0.069，qwen3-6 从 −0.049 变为 −0.059，sonnet-5 从 −0.036 变为 −0.039。 三个仅评审区间均不包含零，且三个均在校正后存活，因此针对 RQ 1 预注册的合取标准在仅评审结果上同样会被满足，且比预注册结果提供的余量略大。 每个 LLM 的系数与标准误之比也都上升，分别从 4.46 升至 4.84、从 2.75 升至 3.06、从 2.04 升至 2.33，因此仅评审结果以更少的噪声包含同样的信号。

paragraphs.en: The reason is visible in how the two stages divide the token usage. The review stage accounts for a median of 84.7%, 86.2%, and 85.8% of per-PR tokens for the three LLMs, so the fix stage contributes about one token in seven to the registered outcome. That minority share is also the higher-variance one. The fix stage does not run at all when reviews produced no comments, which is the case for 6.4% of deepseek-v4-flash PRs, 17.8% of qwen3-6 PRs, and 18.5% of sonnet-5 PRs, and its size is then driven by how many comments were raised rather than by how hard the code was to reason about. The CodeHealth coefficient on fix-stage tokens is the weaker of the two for two of the three LLMs, and it is the one row of Table 12 that the correction demotes, since deepseek-v4-flash ’s fix-stage coefficient moves from p = .041 p=.041 to q BH = .064 q_{\mathrm{BH}}=.064 and qwen3-6 ’s was never significant to begin with. For the third LLM, sonnet-5 , the two stages cannot be separated: its review and fix coefficients, − 0.039 -0.039 [ − 0.073 , − 0.006 ] [-0.073,-0.006] against − 0.054 -0.054 [ − 0.094 , − 0.015 ] [-0.094,-0.015] , have intervals that overlap across most of their ranges.
paragraphs.zh: 原因可以从两个阶段划分 token 用量的方式中看出。 复审阶段占三个 LLM 每个 PR token 用量的中位数分别为 84.7%、86.2% 和 85.8%，因此修复阶段对所登记结果的贡献约为七分之一。 这个少数份额同时也是方差较高的那一个。 当复审没有产生任何评论时，修复阶段完全不会运行——deepseek-v4-flash 的 PR 中有 6.4%、qwen3-6 的 PR 中有 17.8%、sonnet-5 的 PR 中有 18.5% 属于这种情况——此时其规模取决于提出了多少条评论，而不是代码推理难度有多大。 对三个 LLM 中的两个而言，修复阶段 token 上的 CodeHealth 系数是两者中较弱的一个，而且它是表 12 中被校正降级的那一行，因为 deepseek-v4-flash 的修复阶段系数从 p = .041 变为 q_BH = .064，而 qwen3-6 的系数本来就不显著。 对第三个 LLM sonnet-5 来说，两个阶段无法区分：其复审系数和修复系数，即 −0.039 [−0.073, −0.006] 与 −0.054 [−0.094, −0.015]，二者的区间在其大部分范围内相互重叠。

paragraphs.en: To rule out that this comparison is an artifact of the larger sample behind the review-stage fit, we refit both stages on the subsample of PRs where the fix stage ran, so that review and fix stages are estimated on an identical sample. The ordering is unchanged for deepseek-v4-flash ( − 0.066 -0.066 for review against − 0.034 -0.034 for fix, n = 424 n=424 ) and qwen3-6 ( − 0.062 -0.062 against − 0.030 -0.030 , n = 379 n=379 ), and sonnet-5 remains indeterminate ( − 0.044 -0.044 against − 0.054 -0.054 , n = 369 n=369 , again with overlapping intervals). The stage ordering therefore holds for two LLMs and is undetermined, but not contradicted, for the third.
paragraphs.zh: 为了排除这种比较是审阅阶段拟合背后更大样本量所导致的假象，我们在修复阶段实际运行过的 PR 子样本上重新拟合了两个阶段，使审阅阶段与修复阶段在完全相同的样本上进行估计。 对于 deepseek-v4-flash（审阅阶段为 -0.066，修复阶段为 -0.034，n=424）和 qwen3-6（-0.062 对 -0.030，n=379），阶段排序保持不变；而 sonnet-5 仍然无法确定（-0.044 对 -0.054，n=369，同样存在区间重叠）。 因此，阶段排序在两个 LLM 上成立，在第三个 LLM 上则无法确定，但也并未被推翻。

paragraphs.en: Table 13 decomposes the review stage along two axes: the number of agent iterations against the tokens consumed per iteration, and the input side against the output side. Lower CodeHealth is associated with more agent iterations for every LLM, with all three intervals excluding zero. It is also associated with more tokens inside each iteration, significantly so for two LLMs and at q BH = .104 q_{\mathrm{BH}}=.104 for sonnet-5 . The two effects are additive on the logarithmic scale and together reconstruct the review-token coefficient to within 0.001 in log units, the identity being exact in the data but not across separately fitted mixed models with their own variance components. On unhealthy code, the agents take more turns and spend more tokens in each turn. The effect appears on the input side for all three LLMs, whereas on the output side it reaches significance for only two. We therefore interpret the input-side result as the more reliable of the two. We report input excluding cached tokens because it isolates the new input tokens in each iteration, whereas the full input token count would include a multiplication by the number of iterations. The registered cache-neutral sum of the two sides follows the input side: its interval excludes zero for all three LLMs, and it survives the correction for deepseek-v4-flash and qwen3-6 . For sonnet-5 it does not, at q BH = .053 q_{\mathrm{BH}}=.053 .
paragraphs.zh: 表 13 从两个维度对审查阶段进行分解：智能体迭代次数与每次迭代消耗的 token 数，以及输入侧与输出侧。 对所有大语言模型而言，更低的 CodeHealth 都与更多的智能体迭代次数相关，且三个区间均不包含零。 它还与每次迭代内更多的 token 相关，对两个大语言模型达到显著，对 sonnet-5 在 q_{\mathrm{BH}}=.104 时显著。 这两种效应在对数尺度上具有可加性，二者合起来可在 0.001 个对数单位内重构审查 token 的系数；该恒等关系在数据中是精确成立的，但在各自带有方差成分的单独拟合的混合模型之间并不精确成立。 在不健康代码上，智能体会进行更多轮次，并在每一轮中花费更多 token。 该效应在输入侧对三个大语言模型都出现，而在输出侧仅对两个达到显著。 因此，我们将输入侧的结果解读为两者中更可靠的一个。 我们报告排除缓存 token 的输入量，因为它隔离了每次迭代中的新输入 token，而完整的输入 token 计数会包含一个乘以迭代次数的倍增。 预注册的对缓存中性的两侧之和跟随输入侧：其对三个大语言模型的区间均不包含零，并且对 deepseek-v4-flash 和 qwen3-6 在校正后依然成立。 对 sonnet-5 则不然，其 q_{\mathrm{BH}}=.053。

The agents report a comparable number of findings on unhealthy and healthy code, but reaching those findings takes more work on unhealthy code.

paragraphs.en: Since the work rises but the findings do not, the two can be composed into a single quantity: the review tokens spent per review comment produced. paragraphs.en: To test an objection to the comment-count null, we separate the CodeHealth score from the smell count behind it. The objection is that CH is low precisely because CodeScene identified code smells in the files under review, so if the agents react to the same properties, the number of findings should increase in unhealthy code. That they do not could have two explanations: either the agents attend to something largely unrelated to what the metric measures, or the metric is the wrong operationalization of what they attend to.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试对“评论数为零”这一情况的一种反驳意见，我们将代码健康度（CodeHealth）分数与其背后的坏味道计数分离开来。 该反驳意见认为，代码健康度之所以偏低，正是因为 CodeScene 在被审查的文件中识别出了代码坏味道，因此如果智能体对同样的属性作出反应，那么在不健康的代码中，发现问题的数量理应增加。 而发现问题的数量并没有增加，这可能有两种解释：要么智能体所关注的内容与该指标所度量的内容基本无关，要么该指标是对智能体所关注内容的错误操作化。

sents.zh: 而发现问题的数量并没有增加，这可能有两种解释：要么智能体所关注的内容与该指标所度量的内容基本无关，要么该指标是对智能体所关注内容的错误操作化。

paragraphs.en: The distinction that separates these explanations is between the score and the count behind it. CodeHealth is a bounded and saturating index on a 1 to 10 scale, whereas the number of smell instances CodeScene reports is an unbounded count. The two are related but far from interchangeable in our sample, correlating at Spearman ρ = − .72 \rho=-.72 . Within the unhealthy tier alone, where the score is close to its floor for every PR, the smell count still ranges from 4 to 70 with a median of 9. A file can therefore accumulate a great many additional smells without the score moving, which means that a lack of correlation between review comments and the CH score does not by itself rule out a correlation with code smells.
paragraphs.zh: 区分这些解释的关键在于分数与其背后的计数。 CodeHealth 是一个 1 到 10 分制上有界且会饱和的指数，而 CodeScene 报告的坏味道实例数量则是一个无界的计数。 两者相关但远不能互换，在我们的样本中其 Spearman ρ = − .72 \rho=-.72 。 仅在不健康档位内部——其中每个 PR 的分数都接近其下限——坏味道数量仍然从 4 到 70 不等，中位数为 9。 因此，一个文件可以累积大量额外的坏味道而分数不动，这意味着评审评论与 CH 分数之间缺乏相关性，本身并不能排除其与代码坏味道之间的相关性。

paragraphs.en: Table 14 fits both predictors on the same rows, so that neither can stand in for the other. The smell count predicts the number of review comments for all three LLMs, with every interval excluding zero and every coefficient surviving the correction, while the CodeHealth correlation remains null in the same fits at q BH ≥ .22 q_{\mathrm{BH}}\geq.22 . In interpretable terms, doubling the number of smells in the files under review is associated with 15.7 % 15.7\% , 18.8 % 18.8\% , and 10.3 % 10.3\% more review findings for the three LLMs, whereas a full point of CH is associated with at most 2.7 % 2.7\% and never reaches significance. One specification choice favors the smell result: the coefficient is about half as large when the size of the scored files is left out of the model, because larger files contain more smells while drawing fewer comments per file, so file size acts as a suppressor here. We keep file size in the model because the smell count is a count over those files, and without it the fit cannot separate more smells from more code.
paragraphs.zh: 表14在相同的行上对两个预测变量进行拟合，因此二者不能互相替代。 代码异味的数量能预测所有三个LLM的评审评论数，每个区间都不包含零，每个系数都通过了校正，而CodeHealth的相关性在同样的拟合中始终为零（q_{\mathrm{BH}}\geq.22）。 用可解释的术语来说，被评审文件中代码异味数量翻倍，与三个LLM的评审发现分别增加15.7\%、18.8\%和10.3\%相关，而CH每提高一整分最多关联2.7\%的变化，且从未达到显著性。 有一个模型设定上的选择有利于代码异味的结果：当被评分文件的规模不纳入模型时，系数大约缩小一半，因为较大的文件包含更多异味，同时每个文件吸引的评论更少，因此文件规模在这里起到了抑制变量的作用。 我们在模型中保留文件规模，因为代码异味数量是对这些文件计数的，如果没有它，拟合就无法将更多的异味与更多的代码区分开。

paragraphs.en: The registered model adjusts for the number of changed lines but not for the size of the files those lines belong to, and the CodeHealth tiers differ greatly in that size: the median scored file has 2,146 lines in the unhealthy tier against 128 in the healthy tier. We therefore refit the registered model with one added covariate, the logarithm of the total lines of the files CH scored for the PR, per LLM and on the same rows as Table 8 . We use total lines rather than source lines of code because the agents’ file-reading tool pages through a file by line, so comments and blank lines cost tokens just as code does. If the CH coefficient kept its sign with an interval excluding zero, the association would not be reducible to the size of the files the agents read. If it attenuated, we would interpret the effect as mediated by file size, because the size-related smells, such as Large Method, Low Cohesion, and Bumpy Road, are part of what CodeHealth measures (Section 6.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 注册模型对变更行数进行了调整，但未对这些行所属文件的大小进行调整，而不同 CodeHealth 等级的文件大小差异很大：被打分文件的中位数在不健康等级中为 2,146 行，而在健康等级中仅为 128 行。 因此，我们为注册模型新增一个协变量重新拟合，该协变量是每个 LLM 针对该 PR 打分的文件总行数的对数，且使用与表 8 相同的行。 我们使用总行数而非源代码行数，因为智能体的文件读取工具是按行分页读取文件的，所以注释和空行与代码一样会消耗 token。 如果 CH 系数保持其符号且区间不包含零，则该关联就不能被归结为智能体所读取文件的大小。 如果该系数衰减，我们会将这一效应解释为由文件大小所中介，因为与大小相关的代码坏味道，例如 Large Method（过大方法）、Low Cohesion（低内聚）和 Bumpy Road（颠簸之路），本身就是 CodeHealth 所度量内容的一部分（第 6.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: ‡ The confirmatory fits of Table 8 , reproduced for comparison; they are not FDR-adjusted.
paragraphs.zh: ‡ 表 8 的验证性拟合结果，为便于比较而重新列出；这些结果未经 FDR 校正。

paragraphs.en: Table 15 reports the result: the association attenuated, the second of the two outcomes described above. Adjusting for file size absorbs the CodeHealth association for every LLM. The coefficient moves from − 0.062 -0.062 to − 0.009 -0.009 for deepseek-v4-flash , from − 0.049 -0.049 to − 0.023 -0.023 for qwen3-6 , and from − 0.036 -0.036 to + 0.018 +0.018 for sonnet-5 , and none of the three adjusted intervals excludes zero ( q BH ≥ .44 q_{\mathrm{BH}}\geq.44 ). File size itself has a positive coefficient for all three LLMs, with intervals excluding zero for two of them: doubling the scored lines is associated with approximately 13% more tokens for deepseek-v4-flash and sonnet-5 , and 6% for qwen3-6 . The two predictors overlap strongly, with Spearman ρ \rho between CH and log file size of − .71 -.71 to − .73 -.73 across the three LLMs’ samples, about as strongly as CH correlates with the smell count ( ρ = − .72 \rho=-.72 , Section 4.6.3 ), so that little variation in CH remains at constant file size, and the adjusted standard errors are 27% to 37% wider than the registered ones. The refit shows that this sample cannot separate an association with CH from an association with the size of the files CodeHealth is computed over. It does not by itself show the registered association to be spurious; we analyze this further in Section 5.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 表15报告了结果：关联减弱了，即上述两种结果中的第二种。 对文件大小进行调整后，所有LLM的代码健康度关联均被吸收。 deepseek-v4-flash 的系数从 −0.062 变为 −0.009，qwen3-6 的系数从 −0.049 变为 −0.023，sonnet-5 的系数从 −0.036 变为 +0.018，且三个调整后的区间均不排除零（q_BH ≥ .44）。 文件大小本身在所有三个LLM中都具有正系数，其中两个的区间不包含零：评分行数翻倍时，deepseek-v4-flash 和 sonnet-5 的 token 数约增加13%，qwen3-6 约增加6%。 两个预测变量高度重叠，在三个LLM的样本中，CH 与对数文件大小之间的 Spearman ρ 为 −.71 到 −.73，与 CH 和坏味道数量之间的相关性强度相当（ρ = −.72，第4.6.3节），因此在文件大小恒定时 CH 几乎没有剩余变异，且调整后的标准误差比注册时宽27%至37%。 重新拟合表明，该样本无法将 CH 的关联与代码健康度所计算文件大小的关联区分开来。 这本身并不能证明注册的关联是虚假的；我们在第5.2节中对此作进一步分析。

sents.en: Table 15 reports the result: the association attenuated, the second of the two outcomes described above.
sents.zh: 表15报告了结果：关联减弱了，即上述两种结果中的第二种。

sents.en: Adjusting for file size absorbs the CodeHealth association for every LLM.
sents.zh: 对文件大小进行调整后，所有LLM的代码健康度关联均被吸收。

sents.en: The coefficient moves from − 0.062 -0.062 to − 0.009 -0.009 for deepseek-v4-flash , from − 0.049 -0.049 to − 0.023 -0.023 for qwen3-6 , and from − 0.036 -0.036 to + 0.018 +0.018 for sonnet-5 , and none of the three adjusted intervals excludes zero ( q BH ≥ .44 q_{\mathrm{BH}}\geq.44 ).
sents.zh: deepseek-v4-flash 的系数从 −0.062 变为 −0.009，qwen3-6 的系数从 −0.049 变为 −0.023，sonnet-5 的系数从 −0.036 变为 +0.018，且三个调整后的区间均不排除零（q_BH ≥ .44）。

sents.en: File size itself has a positive coefficient for all three LLMs, with intervals excluding zero for two of them: doubling the scored lines is associated with approximately 13% more tokens for deepseek-v4-flash and sonnet-5 , and 6% for qwen3-6 .
sents.zh: 文件大小本身在所有三个LLM中都具有正系数，其中两个的区间不包含零：评分行数翻倍时，deepseek-v4-flash 和 sonnet-5 的 token 数约增加13%，qwen3-6 约增加6%。

sents.en: The two predictors overlap strongly, with Spearman ρ \rho between CH and log file size of − .71 -.71 to − .73 -.73 across the three LLMs’ samples, about as strongly as CH correlates with the smell count ( ρ = − .72 \rho=-.72 , Section 4.6.3 ), so that little variation in CH remains at constant file size, and the adjusted standard errors are 27% to 37% wider than the registered ones.
sents.zh: 两个预测变量高度重叠，在三个LLM的样本中，CH 与对数文件大小之间的 Spearman ρ 为 −.71 到 −.73，与 CH 和坏味道数量之间的相关性强度相当（ρ = −.72，第4.6.3节），因此在文件大小恒定时 CH 几乎没有剩余变异，且调整后的标准误差比注册时宽27%至37%。

sents.en: The refit shows that this sample cannot separate an association with CH from an association with the size of the files CodeHealth is computed over.
sents.zh: 重新拟合表明，该样本无法将 CH 的关联与代码健康度所计算文件大小的关联区分开来。

sents.en: It does not by itself show the registered association to be spurious; we analyze this further in Section 5.2 .
sents.zh: 这本身并不能证明注册的关联是虚假的；我们在第5.2节中对此作进一步分析。

paragraphs.en: A quality metric calibrated against human maintainability predicts what LLM agents spend on reviewing code. The spend arises when the agents read the code and not when they change it, and in our sample it is associated with the size of the files in which unhealthy code occurs. The token cost per finding also increases with decreasing CodeHealth, since the agents write the same number of comments for healthy and unhealthy code while spending more tokens on the unhealthy code. However, in absolute terms the token cost effect is modest. Applied to the 6.9-point median-to-median CH difference from Section 4.2 , the contrast corresponds to about 91,000 tokens per PR for sonnet-5 , 134,000 for qwen3-6 , and 360,000 for deepseek-v4-flash , for a single review-and-fix pass. The saving recurs with volume: every PR that an organization reviews incurs the same percentage again.
paragraphs.zh: 一个以人类可维护性为基准校准的质量指标，可以预测 LLM 智能体在代码审查上的开销。 这种开销产生于智能体阅读代码时，而非修改代码时；并且在我们的样本中，它与包含不健康代码的文件的大小相关。 每个发现的问题的 token 成本也随 CodeHealth 的降低而上升，因为智能体对健康代码和不健康代码写同样数量的注释，却在后者上花费更多 token。 不过，从绝对数量来看，token 成本的影响并不大。 应用于 4.2 节中中位数之间 6.9 分的 CH 差距，这一差异对应于单次审查加修复过程中，sonnet-5 每个 PR 约 91,000 个 token，qwen3-6 约 134,000 个，deepseek-v4-flash 约 360,000 个。 这种节省随代码量而反复出现：组织审查的每一个 PR 都会再次产生相同比例的开销。

paragraphs.en: A more capable LLM might be insensitive to code quality, which would make the association a property of current LLMs and not of the code. Our data does not indicate this. The most capable LLM we ran, sonnet-5 , still showed a negative coefficient with an interval excluding zero (Table 8 ), and the ordering of the per-LLM coefficients reversed between pilot 3 and the main collection, with sonnet-5 steepest at − 0.071 -0.071 in the pilot (Table 7 ) and shallowest at − 0.036 -0.036 in the main collection, so the ordering cannot be taken as a hint about capability. The registered analysis excludes a health-by-LLM interaction term because three LLMs cannot separate capability from the other ways in which they differ (Section 3.9 ), as a test of capability would have required a design testing orders of magnitude more LLMs and selecting LLMs with similar architectures differing in size and capability. All three LLMs are current-generation, but none is its provider’s flagship tier. Whether the largest and most capable LLMs, at the time of writing, LLMs such as Opus 5.5 or GPT-6 Astra, show the same association remains open.
paragraphs.zh: 更强的LLM可能对代码质量不敏感，这会使该关联成为当前LLM的属性而非代码的属性。 我们的数据并不支持这一点。 我们运行的能力最强的LLM sonnet-5 仍显示出负系数且其区间不包含零（表8），且各LLM系数的排序在试点3与正式采集之间发生了反转——sonnet-5 在试点中最陡，为 −0.071 -0.071（表7），而在正式采集中最平缓，为 −0.036 -0.036，因此该排序不能作为能力高低的提示。 注册的分析排除了健康与LLM的交互项，因为三个LLM无法将能力与它们其他方面的差异区分开（第3.9节）；要检验能力，本需要一项测试数量级更多的LLM、并选取架构相似而在规模和能力上不同的LLM的设计。 这三个LLM都是当前一代的，但都不是其提供商的旗舰级产品。 截至撰写本文时最大、能力最强的LLM，例如Opus 5.5或GPT-6 Astra，是否表现出同样的关联，仍有待研究。

paragraphs.en: The exploratory decompositions in Section 4.6.1 and Section 4.6.2 locate the association in the review stage. Removing the fix stage steepens the association for every LLM. The association is stronger in the review stage than in the fix stage for two of the three, and the two stages cannot be separated for sonnet-5 (Table 12 ). We interpret the fix stage as diluting the effect: it runs only when the reviewers produced comments, and its size then follows the number of comments raised rather than the difficulty of the code, so folding it into the registered outcome adds variance that CodeHealth does not explain. The registered 𝑡𝑜𝑘𝑒𝑛𝑠 ​ _ ​ 𝑡𝑜𝑡𝑎𝑙 \mathit{tokens\_total} is therefore, if anything, a conservative statement of the association for the part of the pipeline that reads the code, since every LLM’s review-only coefficient is steeper than its total-token coefficient. Because the association lies in the review stage, we believe that every additional agent pass that reads the same code, whether a triage step, an explanation, or agent work outside review, could incur a similar token cost association.
paragraphs.zh: 第4.6.1节和第4.6.2节中的探索性分解将该关联定位于评审阶段。 移除修复阶段会使每个LLM的关联变陡。 三者中有两个在评审阶段的关联强于修复阶段，而sonnet-5的两个阶段无法区分（表12）。 我们将修复阶段解释为稀释了该效应：它仅在评审者产生了评论时才会运行，其规模随后取决于提出的评论数量而非代码的难度，因此将其合并入注册的结果会引入CodeHealth无法解释的方差。 因此，注册的 \mathit{tokens\_total} 对于流水线中读取代码的那部分而言，即便有偏离，也是对关联的保守陈述，因为每个LLM的仅评审系数都比其总token系数更陡。 由于该关联位于评审阶段，我们相信每一个读取相同代码的额外智能体处理步骤，无论是分诊步骤、解释，还是评审之外的智能体工作，都可能引发类似的token成本关联。

paragraphs.en: The file-size refit in Section 4.6.4 changes how the registered result should be interpreted, though not whether it holds. Adjusting for the total lines of the scored files absorbs the CodeHealth coefficient for all three LLMs, and in this sample CH and file size are close to interchangeable descriptions of the same PRs (Spearman ρ \rho between − .71 -.71 and − .73 -.73 ). We interpret this as the association between CH and cost being mediated by file size, not as a spurious association. For one thing, CH directly uses source lines of code (SLOC) as one of its metrics. We also believe that a large source file is mostly a consequence of many other design choices that lower CodeHealth. Breaking a long file into cohesive functions and classes removes, for example, the Large Method, Low Cohesion, and Bumpy Road smells that the metric penalizes, and once code is split into separate units there is rarely a reason to keep them in one file. Adjusting for file size therefore removes at least one direct factor that the metric measures and several indirect ones, which is why we read the size-adjusted fit as a decomposition of the association and not as a correction of it.
paragraphs.zh: 第4.6.4节中的文件大小重拟合改变了已注册结果应当如何解读，但并不改变该结果是否成立。 对被评分文件的总行数进行调整后，三个大语言模型的 CodeHealth 系数均被吸收，且在本样本中 CH 与文件大小几乎是对同一批 PR 的可互换描述（Spearman ρ \rho 介于 − .71 -.71 到 − .73 -.73 之间）。 我们将其解读为 CH 与成本之间的关联是由文件大小中介的，而非虚假关联。 一方面，CH 直接将源代码行数（SLOC）作为其指标之一。 我们还认为，大型源文件主要是许多其他降低 CodeHealth 的设计选择所导致的结果。 例如，将一个长文件拆分为内聚的函数和类，可以消除该指标所惩罚的 Large Method、Low Cohesion 和 Bumpy Road 等代码坏味道，而且一旦代码被拆分为独立单元，通常就没有理由再把它们保留在一个文件中。 因此，对文件大小进行调整至少去除了该指标所度量的一个直接因素以及若干间接因素，这就是为什么我们将调整大小后的拟合结果视为对该关联的分解，而非对其的修正。

paragraphs.en: The mediation account is consistent with the review-stage decomposition. An agent reading a long file through a tool that returns at most 500 lines per call (Section 3.6 ) needs more calls, and therefore more turns, to locate the context a PR depends on, and each turn adds more retrieved code to its context, which is the pattern of more iterations and more uncached input in Table 13 . The saving that the estimate in Section 4.2 describes is the one associated with moving from a typical unhealthy-tier PR to a typical healthy-tier one, and such PRs differ in the size of the files they touch as much as in their score, so the estimate does not say what raising CodeHealth while leaving file size unchanged would save. The refactoring that would deliver the saving is the kind that also shrinks files, splitting long methods and low-cohesion modules into smaller units, rather than a change that raises the score without altering the structure an agent has to read through. This interpretation has a limit that we cannot remove with this sample: files that are long for reasons unrelated to design, such as generated code, data tables, or test files with many small cases, would add cost through size without the defects the metric penalizes, and our data cannot separate them from long, low-cohesion files. We return to this question in Section 5.6 .

sents.en: An agent reading a long file through a tool that returns at most 500 lines per call (Section 3.6 ) needs more calls, and therefore more turns, to locate the context a PR depends on, and each turn adds more retrieved code to its context, which is the pattern of more iterations and more uncached input in Table 13 .

paragraphs.en: The file-size result also qualifies how our results converge with Wirdemann et al. (2026) , who reported that lower-CodeHealth files require more input tokens in single-shot unit-test generation, for Java and C++ even after controlling for SLOC. Unlike theirs, our association does not survive an adjustment for the size of the files read, although the adjustments differ slightly: they controlled for SLOC, and we controlled for the total lines of all files scored for a PR. That study and ours differ in task, corpus, unit of analysis, and outcome, yet both locate the cost on the input side of the LLM, which we believe indicates that the association originates in the code and not in either pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 文件大小方面的结果也限定了我们的结果与 Wirdemann 等人结论的收敛程度。 (2026)，他们报告称，在对 SLOC 进行控制之后，在 Java 和 C++ 的单次单元测试生成中，CodeHealth 较低的文件仍需要更多的输入 token。 与他们的结果不同，我们的关联在对所读文件大小进行调整后不再成立，尽管二者的调整略有差异：他们控制的是 SLOC，而我们控制的是针对某个 PR 进行评分的所有文件的总行数。 该研究与我们的研究在任务、语料库、分析单元和结果上均有所不同，但二者都将成本定位在 LLM 的输入侧，我们认为这表明该关联源于代码本身，而非任何一方的流程。

paragraphs.en: Inside the review stage, lower CodeHealth is associated with more turns taken, more context retrieved into those turns, and more tokens generated within them, while the number of findings the agents report does not change, so the cost per finding rises as CH falls (Section 4.6.2 ). The intuitive interpretation of this pattern is that unhealthy code is harder for the agents to understand. We do not adopt this interpretation, because it attributes a human comprehension process to the agent. An LLM agent does not comprehend a diff in the sense a human reviewer does, with a mental model assembled over time, prior familiarity with the module, and recognition-primed pattern matching ( Gullstrand Heander et al. 2026 ) . It computes over tokens and infers, and both the computing and the inferring are metered. We therefore define what we report by what the instrument measures, namely the turns, retrieved context, and generated tokens listed above, and make no claim about an internal state of understanding.
paragraphs.zh: 在评审阶段内，较低的代码健康度（CodeHealth）与更多的轮次、每轮检索到更多上下文、以及在这些轮次中生成更多 token 相关，而智能体报告的问题数量并未变化，因此每个问题的成本随着 CH 下降而上升（第 4.6.2 节）。 对这一模式的直观解读是：不健康的代码对智能体来说更难理解。 我们不采纳这一解读，因为它将人类的理解过程归于智能体。 大语言模型（LLM）智能体并不像人类评审者那样理解一个差异（diff），即不通过逐步建立的心智模型、对该模块的既有熟悉度、以及识别优先的模式匹配来完成理解（Gullstrand Heander et al. 2026）。 它只是对 token 进行计算并进行推断，而计算和推断都是被计量的。 因此，我们根据工具所测量的内容，即上文列出的轮次、检索到的上下文和生成的 token，来界定我们所报告的内容，并且不对某种内在的理解状态作出任何断言。

paragraphs.en: Cognitive load theory offers a vocabulary and a documented set of symptoms for the human side of this comparison. Sweller (1988) showed that conventional problem solving consumes limited cognitive processing capacity, leaving little for acquiring the domain-specific knowledge that distinguishes experts from novices, and Sweller et al. (1998) separated that load into load intrinsic to the material, load imposed by how it is presented, and load spent building durable understanding of it. In code review specifically, Gonçalves et al. (2022) treated cognitive load as the mechanism behind review cost and tested whether explicit strategies could lower it, while Siegmund et al. (2014) located the working-memory and attentional demands of program comprehension in measurable brain activity, which is evidence that the load is a measurable property of the comprehension process. The behavioral signature of that load is well documented. Reviewers re-read a change, navigate to definitions, tests, and history that the diff does not show them, ask clarifying questions when a change fails to make sense, and take longer overall, with Pascarella et al. (2018) cataloging the information needs that drive the navigation and Ebert et al. (2021) the confusion that drives the questions.
paragraphs.zh: 认知负荷理论为这种对比中人的那一面提供了一套术语和一组有据可查的症状。 Sweller（1988）表明，常规的问题解决会消耗有限的认知加工容量，几乎不剩什么用于获取区分专家与新手的领域特定知识，而 Sweller 等人 （1998）将这种负荷分为材料本身固有的负荷、由呈现方式造成的负荷，以及用于建立对材料的持久理解的负荷。 具体到代码评审，Gonçalves 等人 （2022）把认知负荷视为评审成本背后的机制，并检验显式策略能否降低它，而 Siegmund 等人 （2014）则把程序理解对工作记忆和注意力的需求定位于可测量的大脑活动，这证明该负荷是理解过程的一个可测量的属性。 这种负荷的行为特征已有充分记录。 评审者会反复阅读一个变更，导航到 diff 中没有展示给他们的定义、测试和历史记录，在变更令人费解时提出澄清性问题，并且整体耗时更长，其中 Pascarella 等人 （2018）编录了驱动这些导航的信息需求，Ebert 等人 （2021）编录了驱动这些提问的困惑。

paragraphs.en: Our analysis finds a corresponding signature in an agent: additional iterations correspond to re-reading and revisiting, additional context retrieved into those turns to a reviewer’s navigation, and additional tokens spent within a turn to the effort of working through a passage. We nonetheless decline to reuse the label cognitive load for agents. Shang et al. (2026) make that move, mapping cognitive load theory’s bounded working memory onto an LLM’s context budget by direct analogy, and the analogy commits to a claim our instrument cannot support: that the difficulty arises from an exhausted resource standing between an unprocessed representation and a stable schema. Nothing we measure speaks to whether such a resource exists or is exhausted. For most PRs, our pipeline uses only a fraction of the LLM’s context limit. We therefore report the expenditure itself and leave open whether it placed load on any limited resource of the agent, since that is not something we can observe.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的分析在智能体中找到了对应的特征：额外的迭代对应于反复阅读和回顾，被检索到这些轮次中的额外上下文对应于审阅者的导航，而在一个轮次内花费的额外token则对应于研读一段文字所付出的努力。 尽管如此，我们不愿在智能体上沿用「认知负荷」这一标签。Shang 等人 （2026）做了这种处理，通过直接类比将认知负荷理论中受限的工作记忆映射到 LLM 的上下文预算上，而这一类比暗含了一个我们的测量工具无法支持的主张：即困难来自于一个耗尽的资源，它横亘在未处理的表征与稳定的图式之间。 我们所测量的任何东西都无法说明这样的资源是否存在或是否已被耗尽。 对于大多数 PR，我们的流程只使用了 LLM 上下文上限的一小部分。 因此，我们只报告这一支出本身，而不对它是否给智能体的任何有限资源造成了负荷下结论，因为这不是我们能够观测到的事情。

paragraphs.en: Instead of a comprehension account, we propose that interleaved conditional logic, long methods, and low cohesion each force an agent to pull in more context and to trace more paths before a finding can be stated with confidence, without changing how many findings there are to state.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出另一种解释（而非理解成本解释）：交错的条件逻辑、过长的方法以及低内聚，各自都会迫使智能体拉取更多上下文、追踪更多路径，才能有把握地给出一个发现，而这并不会改变需要给出的发现数量。

paragraphs.en: Section 4.6.3 answers the objection that the comment-count null invites: the number of review findings follows the count of smells in the files under review for all three LLMs, while the CodeHealth score in the same fits does not predict it (Table 14 ). The most plausible interpretation, we believe, is that the agents respond to the number of distinct problem sites in front of them, not to how far those problems have moved a summary score. A count and a saturating index diverge when the count grows large, which is where our unhealthy tier sits, and a review agent producing one comment per site it judges worth reporting would produce a comment distribution that follows the count. This interpretation aligns with what we observe in Section 5.3 . Cost per finding rises as the score falls, and finding count rises as the smell count grows, so the two results describe different predictors acting on different outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4.6.3 节回应了评论数为空值可能引发的反驳：对于全部三个大语言模型，评审发现的数量随被评审文件中代码坏味道的数量而变化，而同一拟合中的 CodeHealth 分数并不能预测该数量（表 14）。 我们认为最合理的解释是，智能体响应的是它们面前不同问题位置的数量，而不是这些问题在多大程度上改变了某个汇总分数。 当计数增长到很大时，计数与饱和指数就会出现分歧，而我们的不健康层级恰好处于这个区间；一个评审智能体若对每个它认为值得报告的位置都产出一条评论，那么其评论分布就会跟随该计数。 这一解释与我们在第 5.3 节中观察到的情况相符。 单个发现的成本随分数下降而上升，发现数量随坏味道数量的增长而上升，因此这两项结果描述的是作用于不同结果的不同预测因子。

sents.zh: 这一解释与我们在第 5.3 节中观察到的情况相符。

sents.en: Cost per finding rises as the score falls, and finding count rises as the smell count grows, so the two results describe different predictors acting on different outcomes.
sents.zh: 单个发现的成本随分数下降而上升，发现数量随坏味道数量的增长而上升，因此这两项结果描述的是作用于不同结果的不同预测因子。

paragraphs.en: The review agents are instructed to flag only issues introduced or exposed by the PR under review and explicitly not to flag the unchanged code (Section 3.6 ). Unchanged code makes up most of the input files (see provenance shares in Section 6.3 ), especially in the unhealthy tier. The agents are consequently instructed not to comment on most of the code responsible for a low score, yet their finding counts still track the count of smells in those files. We interpret this as an indication that the changed code in the PR inherits the smell density of its file, since it needs to interface with the surrounding file and follow similar conventions, although our design cannot confirm that explanation.
paragraphs.zh: 评审智能体被指示只标记由被评审 PR 引入或暴露的问题，并明确不标记未改动的代码（见 3.6 节）。 未改动代码占输入文件的大部分（见 6.3 节中的来源占比），在不健康层级中尤其如此。 因此，智能体被指示不对导致低分的代码中的大部分发表评论，但它们的发现数量仍与这些文件中的坏味道数量相关。 我们将其解读为一个迹象，表明 PR 中被改动的代码继承了其所在文件的坏味道密度，因为它需要与文件中的周围代码交互并遵循类似的约定，尽管我们的设计无法证实这一解释。

paragraphs.en: The registered smell results (Section 4.4 ) are consistent with the structural account of Section 5.3 for two of the three smells. Complex Method and Complex Conditional multiply the execution paths a fix agent must trace before it can safely edit, whereas the smell count in aggregate measures how many places invite a comment at all. The Code Duplication prediction failed, and we report it as a failed prediction without reinterpreting its mechanism after the fact.
paragraphs.zh: 所登记的坏味道结果（第 4.4 节）与第 5.3 节的结构性论述在三种坏味道中的两种上是一致的。 复杂方法和复杂条件会使修复智能体在安全编辑之前必须追踪的执行路径成倍增加，而坏味道数量总体上衡量的只是有多少地方可能引来注释。 代码重复的预测失败了，我们将其作为一次失败的预测如实报告，而不事后重新解释其机制。

paragraphs.en: For practitioners who hold refactoring and maintenance budgets, the result is an association, not a forecast. Code that CodeHealth rates as unhealthy also costs more for an agent to review, on every pass an agent makes over it, and in our sample that cost travels with the large, low-cohesion files that such code tends to come in. We believe the case that human maintainability already makes for refactoring can be extended to agent-reviewed code, provided that the refactoring changes the structure of the code and not only its score. Two practices can raise and maintain CH, and a third was considered and rejected for this study.
paragraphs.zh: 对于拥有重构和维护预算的从业者而言，这一结果是一种关联，而非预测。 被代码健康度（CodeHealth）评为不健康的代码，也会让智能体在每一次审查时付出更高的成本，而在我们的样本中，这种成本往往伴随着此类代码通常所属的大体量、低内聚的文件。 我们认为，人类可维护性已经为重构提供的理由，可以扩展到智能体审查的代码，前提是重构真正改变了代码的结构，而不仅仅是其分数。 有两种实践可以提升并维持代码健康度（CH），第三种实践在本研究中被考虑过但被否决了。

sents.zh: 有两种实践可以提升并维持代码健康度（CH），第三种实践在本研究中被考虑过但被否决了。

paragraphs.en: Metric-guided refactoring improves existing code in passes targeted by the metric instead of by intuition, whether the work is performed manually by a developer, delegated to an agent, or done collaboratively with a developer deciding what to change and an agent proposing and drafting the edits. We favor the collaborative form, for two reasons. The metric shows where improvements can be made but the team that maintains the code should make the final decision on which functions to refactor. Furthermore, Borg et al. (2026a) report that LLMs preserve program semantics less reliably when working with low-CodeHealth code, with break rates rising as health falls, so an agent operating unsupervised is least dependable in the files that need refactoring the most. We believe metric-guided refactoring should be paired with human review of the resulting change and with test coverage sufficient to detect regressions, rather than run as an unattended batch job.
paragraphs.zh: 度量引导的重构是按度量指标而非直觉来分轮改进现有代码，无论这项工作是由开发者手动完成、委派给智能体，还是以协作方式进行——由开发者决定改什么，由智能体提出并起草修改。 我们倾向于协作方式，原因有二。 度量指标能显示可以在哪里改进，但维护代码的团队应当对重构哪些函数做出最终决定。此外，Borg 等人 （2026a）报告称，大语言模型在处理低 CodeHealth 代码时对程序语义的保留较不可靠，且随着健康度下降，破坏率上升，因此无人监督运行的智能体在最需要重构的文件中最不可靠。 我们认为，度量引导的重构应当与对最终改动的人工评审以及足以检测回归的测试覆盖相结合，而不是作为无人值守的批处理任务运行。

paragraphs.en: Another strategy is a quality gate on incoming changes, similar to test coverage and regression gates that many projects already run in continuous integration: a change that lowers the aggregate CodeHealth of the files it touches, or that leaves those files below an agreed target, cannot merge until its score is brought up. This is relatively easy to implement, since the metric is deterministic static analysis and is cheap and fast to compute automatically for every changed file. Because the returns on maintainability appear to increase toward the healthy end of the scale ( Borg et al. 2024b ) , a gate set at a target, and not merely at no-regression, has a defensible economic argument behind it. Combining this with metric-guided refactoring would give a strategy where the gate holds a line while refactoring moves it. Using only the gate has the advantage of amortizing the cost over the average life cycle of a file in the project, instead of refactoring files that otherwise might not have been touched or reviewed for a long time. The drawback is that some parts of the codebase might be left in an unhealthy state for a long time, eventually putting limits on how good the rest of the codebase can become since it still has to interface with the low-quality remnants.
paragraphs.zh: 另一种策略是对传入变更设置质量门禁，类似于许多项目在持续集成中已经运行测试覆盖率和回归门禁的做法：如果一个变更降低了它所触碰文件的整体 CodeHealth，或使这些文件低于约定目标，那么在分数提升之前无法合并。 这种做法相对容易实现，因为该指标是确定性的静态分析，对每个变更文件自动计算既低成本又快速。 由于可维护性的回报似乎在量表的健康端呈递增趋势（Borg et al. 2024b），将门禁设为一个目标值，而不仅仅是无退化，背后有站得住脚的经济论证。 将此与指标引导的重构相结合，可以形成一种门坚守阵线而重构不断推进阵线的策略。 仅使用门禁的好处是将成本分摊到项目中文件的平均生命周期上，而不是重构那些原本可能长期不被触碰或审查的文件。 缺点在于代码库的某些部分可能长期处于不健康状态，最终会限制代码库其余部分所能达到的质量上限，因为它们仍然必须与低质量的残留代码进行交互。

paragraphs.en: A third option, giving the fix agent a CodeHealth target, was a candidate for this study, and we decided against it (Section 3.3 ). The fix agent in our implementation receives only review comments and no CH target or retry loop (Section 3.6 ). We considered providing it with the CodeHealth tool and instructing it to raise the score of the files that it touches. That instruction would guard against code review fixes degrading the health of the project, which the batch fix in our pipeline does to some PRs while improving others (Section 4.5 ), and would make each new PR raise the CH score as far as it could. However, we concluded that doing so would risk degrading the change. A small, well-defined bug fix or feature could easily come bundled with dozens of unrelated refactorings, and the reviewer of that pull request would then be asked to evaluate two changes at once, of which only one was requested.
paragraphs.zh: 第三种选择——给修复智能体设定一个 CodeHealth 目标——曾是本研究的一个候选方案，但我们决定不采用（第 3.3 节）。 我们实现中的修复智能体只接收评审意见，没有 CH 目标或重试循环（第 3.6 节）。 我们曾考虑为其提供 CodeHealth 工具，并指示它提升其所触及文件的分数。 该指示可以防止代码评审修复降低项目的健康度——我们流水线中的批量修复对某些 PR 就造成了这种情况，同时对另一些 PR 则有所改善（第 4.5 节）——并且会使每个新 PR 都尽可能提高 CH 分数。 然而，我们得出结论：这样做会有损害变更质量的风险。 一个小而明确的缺陷修复或功能，很容易会捆绑进数十项无关的重构，而该拉取请求的评审者届时将不得不同时评估两个变更，其中只有一个是被要求的。

paragraphs.en: Keeping the two concerns apart also matters after the change has merged. If either the requested change or the refactoring that came with it introduces a defect, the team needs to revert one without losing the other, and a single commit that contains both offers no clean way to do so. A separate commit whose stated purpose is to raise CodeHealth can be reviewed and reverted on its own, and it keeps the commit history an accurate record of why each change was made. We believe that quality-improving refactoring is better delivered as its own documented change than as a side effect of another.
paragraphs.zh: 在变更合并之后，将这两个关注点分开也同样重要。 如果所请求的变更或随其引入的重构引入了缺陷，团队需要在不丢失另一个的情况下回滚其中一个，而包含两者的单个提交无法提供干净的方式来做到这一点。 一个单独的提交，其声明的目的就是提升代码健康度，可以独立进行评审和回滚，并且它使提交历史成为每项变更为何做出的准确记录。 我们相信，提升质量的重构作为其自身有记录的变更交付，比作为另一项变更的副作用交付要更好。

paragraphs.en: Whichever road is taken, we do not interpret the result as an argument for optimizing code for agents. CodeHealth is calibrated against human maintainability ( Tornhill and Borg 2022 ; Borg et al. 2024b ) , and the finding here is that a metric built for human reviewers also predicts agent inference cost. That alignment makes refactoring a shared investment for human and agent readers, and we believe it should be preserved deliberately. If future quality metrics were tuned to minimize agent token cost directly, they could drift away from what makes code tractable for the humans who still own it and are responsible for it. In such a scenario, the interpersonal and knowledge-transfer benefits of review that we have argued for elsewhere ( Heander et al. 2025 ) would be at risk.
paragraphs.zh: 无论选择哪条道路，我们都不将这一结果解读为应当针对智能体优化代码的论据。 CodeHealth 是以人类可维护性为基准进行校准的（Tornhill and Borg 2022；Borg et al. 2024b），而本文的发现是，一个为人类评审者构建的指标同样能够预测智能体的推理成本。 这种一致性使得重构成为面向人类读者和智能体读者的共同投资，我们认为应当有意识地保持这一点。 如果未来的质量指标被调整为直接最小化智能体的 token 成本，它们可能会偏离使代码对仍然拥有并对其负责的人类易于处理的因素。 在这种情况下，我们在其他文章中论证过的评审在人际交往与知识传递方面的收益（Heander et al. 2025）将面临风险。

sents.en: Whichever road is taken, we do not interpret the result as an argument for optimizing code for agents.
sents.zh: 无论选择哪条道路，我们都不将这一结果解读为应当针对智能体优化代码的论据。

sents.en: CodeHealth is calibrated against human maintainability ( Tornhill and Borg 2022 ; Borg et al. 2024b ) , and the finding here is that a metric built for human reviewers also predicts agent inference cost.
sents.zh: CodeHealth 是以人类可维护性为基准进行校准的（Tornhill and Borg 2022；Borg et al. 2024b），而本文的发现是，一个为人类评审者构建的指标同样能够预测智能体的推理成本。

sents.en: That alignment makes refactoring a shared investment for human and agent readers, and we believe it should be preserved deliberately.
sents.zh: 这种一致性使得重构成为面向人类读者和智能体读者的共同投资，我们认为应当有意识地保持这一点。

sents.en: If future quality metrics were tuned to minimize agent token cost directly, they could drift away from what makes code tractable for the humans who still own it and are responsible for it.
sents.zh: 如果未来的质量指标被调整为直接最小化智能体的 token 成本，它们可能会偏离使代码对仍然拥有并对其负责的人类易于处理的因素。

sents.en: In such a scenario, the interpersonal and knowledge-transfer benefits of review that we have argued for elsewhere ( Heander et al. 2025 ) would be at risk.
sents.zh: 在这种情况下，我们在其他文章中论证过的评审在人际交往与知识传递方面的收益（Heander et al. 2025）将面临风险。

paragraphs.en: The first open question is a qualitative review of multi-agent review comments, in comparison to the quality of the code under review. This study counted review comments but did not grade them. Section 4.6.2 shows that agents on unhealthy code take more turns without raising more comments, but not whether the comments they do raise are equally correct and equally severe. Grading each agentic review comment against its diff, for correctness and for whether it identifies a problem worth fixing, would turn tokens per comment into tokens per useful finding. It would also test whether unhealthy code draws the same number of comments but different ones, for instance, higher-severity comments pointing to architectural issues.
paragraphs.zh: 第一个开放性问题是对多智能体评审意见的定性分析，并与被评审代码的质量进行对比。 这项研究统计了评审意见的数量，但并未对其质量进行评级。 第 4.6.2 节表明，智能体在处理不健康代码时会进行更多轮次却没有提出更多意见，但没有说明它们提出的意见是否同样正确、同样严重。 将每条智能体评审意见对照其代码差异进行评级，判断其正确性以及是否指出了值得修复的问题，就能把每条意见的 token 数转化为每个有用发现的 token 数。 这还能检验不健康代码是否引来了数量相同但内容不同的意见，例如指向架构问题的更严重级别的意见。

paragraphs.en: Future work could also reverse the direction of the smell analysis. CodeHealth and its smells were calibrated against human maintenance effort, and nothing guarantees that every smell costs an agent what it costs a human; some constructs penalized for human readers might be neutral or even better for an agent that retrieves context through tools instead of holding it in working memory. A design that isolates individual smells, for example by varying one smell at a time in otherwise matched code and measuring inference cost per finding, would separate the smells that drive the agent cost from those that only co-occur with them, and would say whether a quality metric calibrated for agents would weight the smells differently from one calibrated for humans.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的工作还可以反转代码异味分析的方向。 代码健康度及其异味是针对人类维护成本进行校准的，没有任何保证说明每种异味给智能体带来的成本与给人类带来的成本相同；某些因不利于人类阅读而被扣分的代码结构，对于通过工具而非工作记忆来获取上下文的智能体而言，可能是中性的，甚至是有益的。 一种将单个异味隔离的设计——例如在其他方面匹配的代码中每次只改变一种异味，并测量每个发现结果的推理成本——能够区分出哪些异味真正驱动智能体成本，哪些只是与它们共同出现，并且能够说明为智能体校准的质量指标是否会与为人类校准的指标以不同方式权衡这些异味。

paragraphs.en: Another direction for a future study is to explore the connection between CodeHealth, file size, and inference cost in more detail. By building a dataset stratified on file size, it could be possible to isolate the effect of larger files from the effect of lower code quality within those files. Exploring different implementation and parameter choices for the tools given to the LLMs could also have large effects on how they explore their context and on how severely larger files increase token cost.
paragraphs.zh: 未来研究的另一个方向是更详细地探索代码健康度、文件大小与推理成本之间的联系。 通过构建一个按文件大小分层的数据集，有可能将较大文件的影响与这些文件中较低代码质量的影响分离开来。 探索提供给大语言模型的工具的不同实现和参数选择，也可能对智能体如何探索其上下文以及较大文件在多大程度上增加 token 成本产生重大影响。

paragraphs.en: Finally, RQ 3 was registered on the fix stage, where the agent edits the code. We did not test the smells against review-stage or total cost, which is a natural follow-up, although it would require more data to reach significance over so many input variables.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，RQ 3 注册在修复阶段，该阶段由智能体编辑代码。 我们没有针对评审阶段或总成本对代码异味进行测试，这是一个自然的后续工作，尽管在如此多的输入变量下要达到显著性需要更多的数据。

paragraphs.en: We organize the threats to validity by Cook and Campbell’s four categories as presented by Wohlin et al. (2024) : internal, external, construct, and conclusion validity. Following Lago et al. (2024) , most countermeasures below are sampling, instrumentation, or registration decisions already described in Section 3 ; we describe below what they address and what they leave standing. Cook and Campbell’s labels refer to a treatment; in this observational study the role of the treatment is played by the CodeHealth tier, and labels such as selection by treatment are to be understood in that sense.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按照 Wohlin 等人（2024）呈现的 Cook 和 Campbell 四类效度来组织效度威胁：内部效度、外部效度、构念效度和结论效度。参照 Lago 等人（2024）的做法，下文的大多数对策都是第 3 节中已描述的抽样、测量工具或登记决策；我们在下文说明它们解决了什么问题、又留下了什么未解决。 (2024) ：内部效度、外部效度、构念效度和结论效度。参照 Lago 等人（2024）的做法。 (2024) ，下文的大多数对策都是第 3 节中已描述的抽样、测量工具或登记决策；我们在下文说明它们解决了什么问题、又留下了什么未解决。 Cook 和 Campbell 的标签针对的是处理；在这项观察性研究中，处理的角色由 CodeHealth 等级承担，诸如“按处理选择”之类的标签应在这个意义上理解。

paragraphs.en: PRs from the same repository share conventions, architecture, language, and authorship, so whatever is peculiar to a dominant repository can masquerade as an effect of CodeHealth; the AIDev pool is 39.3% one repository, and this confound invalidated the second of our pilot samples (Section 3.3 ). The repository caps limit any repository to two PRs per cell and nine overall, and the random intercept discounts within-repository replication. The within-repository effect is, however, estimable only from the 55 repositories (22%) that span at least two tiers.
paragraphs.zh: 来自同一仓库的 PR 共享惯例、架构、语言与作者，因此某个主导仓库特有的东西可能被伪装成 CodeHealth 的效应；AIDev 池中有 39.3% 来自单一仓库，这一混杂因素使我们第二轮试点样本失效（见 3.3 节）。 仓库上限将任何仓库限制为每个单元格最多两个 PR、总体最多九个，且随机截距对仓库内的重复进行了折扣。 然而，仓库内效应仅能从横跨至少两个层级的 55 个仓库（22%）中估计。

paragraphs.en: Adjusting for the size of the PR is necessary, because token cost scales mechanically with diff size, and dangerous, because if unhealthy code forces larger PRs then adjusting footprint away would remove part of the effect of interest. We therefore treat footprint as a mediator candidate and report the full three-path decomposition for RQ 2 . The residual threat is inferential, not statistical: tasks are not matched across CodeHealth levels, so the CH-to-footprint path does not support a causal interpretation.
paragraphs.zh: 必须按 PR 规模进行调整，因为 token 成本随 diff 大小机械地增加；但这样做也有风险，因为如果糟糕的代码迫使 PR 变大，那么将规模因素调整掉就会消除部分感兴趣的效果。 因此，我们将规模视为一个中介候选变量，并在 RQ 2 中报告完整的三路径分解。 残余的威胁是推断层面的，而非统计层面的：任务未在不同 CodeHealth 水平之间进行匹配，因此 CH 到规模的路径不支持因果解释。

paragraphs.en: The proprietary CodeHealth tool’s scoring algorithm could change during a multi-week collection; we pinned the tool and verified that all 465 manifest entries record a single version, 1.4.0. The harness changed three times. Before the freeze, the locally served LLM moved to a new serving stack and two defects that could record an infrastructure failure as a success were fixed; all 45 pilot PRs were re-run, so only the pooling and interaction analyses that motivated parts of the design (Section 3.9 ), neither a registered outcome, depend on the superseded stack. After the freeze, unbounded tool output was found to let one oversized result inflate a session’s token count without marking its record (Section 3.12 ). Collection was stopped, the fix was filed as an amendment before collection resumed, and all 67 affected PRs were collected again from scratch, so no reported estimate comes from a defective instrument. The residual threat is an undetected defect of the same class, which the termination reason published for every agent session (Table 6 ) would make visible.
paragraphs.zh: 专有的 CodeHealth 工具的评分算法可能在长达数周的采集期间发生变化；我们锁定了工具版本，并验证全部 465 条 manifest 记录均为单一版本 1.4.0。 测试框架（harness）变更了三次。 冻结之前，本地部署的 LLM 迁移到了新的服务栈，并修复了两个可能将基础设施故障记录为成功的缺陷；全部 45 个试验性 PR 均已重新运行，因此只有作为设计动机之一（而非注册结果）的合并分析与交互分析（第 3.9 节）依赖于已被替换的旧服务栈。 冻结之后，发现无上限的工具输出会导致一个超大的结果在不标记其记录的情况下虚增会话的 token 计数（第 3.12 节）。 采集随即停止，该修复在恢复采集前作为修正案提交，全部 67 个受影响的 PR 均从头重新采集，因此任何报告的估计值都不来自有缺陷的仪器。 残余威胁是同一类别中未被发现的缺陷，而为每个智能体会话公布的终止原因（表 6）将使此类缺陷显现出来。

paragraphs.en: PRs entering the pipeline with low baseline CodeHealth have more room to improve, which would inflate Δ \Delta CodeHealth in the unhealthy tier under any treatment. We do not correct for this, because RQ 4 is registered as a description, not a hypothesis test, and we report Δ \Delta CodeHealth by tier so that the asymmetry in headroom is visible.
paragraphs.zh: 以较低基线代码健康度（CodeHealth）进入流程的 PR 有更大的改进空间，这会在任何处理条件下都推高不健康层级中的 Δ \Delta CodeHealth。 我们对此不作校正，因为 RQ 4 注册为描述性研究而非假设检验，并且我们按层级报告 Δ \Delta CodeHealth，以便这种改进余量的不对称性清晰可见。

paragraphs.en: The sample is drawn from merged, agent-authored PRs in repositories with at least 100 stars, in five languages, dominated by one originating agent (OpenAI Codex, 49%). The findings speak to agentic review of agent-authored PRs in popular open-source projects, the setting where such review is already routine ( He et al. 2026 ) , and we do not claim they transfer to human-authored PRs, to private or legacy codebases, or to other languages.
paragraphs.zh: 样本来自星数不低于 100、涵盖五种语言的代码库中由智能体创建并已合并的 PR，其中单一来源智能体占主导（OpenAI Codex，49%）。 本研究的结论适用于热门开源项目中对智能体创建的 PR 进行智能体审查的场景，即这种审查已成为常态的场景（He et al. 2026）；我们并不声称这些结论可推广到人类创建的 PR、私有或遗留代码库，或其他编程语言。

paragraphs.en: The two cells that fell short of target are both in the unhealthy tier (Table 2 ). The cells where a CodeHealth effect on cost would be most visible are also the thinnest: any claim about medium and large unhealthy PRs rests on 73 PRs instead of 112.
paragraphs.zh: 未达到目标的两个单元均处于不健康层级（表 2）。 代码健康度（CodeHealth）对成本的影响最明显的单元恰恰也是样本最薄的：关于中大型不健康 PR 的任何论断都仅基于 73 个 PR，而非 112 个。

paragraphs.en: The instrument is our own four-agent pipeline, not a deployed product, and production systems differ in ways that could change the cost profile, for example by pairing a rule-based detector with an LLM filter stage ( Sun et al. 2025 ) . Pipeline design can also moderate how code metrics relate to agent outcomes: Ramirez and Ekler (2025) found the Maintainability Index correlating with issue resolution at r = .103 r=.103 and r = .436 r=.436 for the same LLM, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, under two different scaffolds. We ground the agent partition in ISO/IEC 25010 ( ISO/IEC 2023 ) and publish the prompts in full, but the results characterize this pipeline and generalize to others only by argument.
paragraphs.zh: 该工具是我们自己的四智能体流水线，而非已部署的产品，生产系统在可能改变成本特征的方式上会有所不同，例如将基于规则的检测器与LLM过滤阶段配对使用（Sun et al. 2025）。 流水线设计还可以调节代码指标与智能体结果之间的关系：Ramirez和Ekler（2025）发现，在两种不同的脚手架下，同一个LLM（Claude 3.5 Sonnet）的可维护性指数与问题解决率的相关系数分别为 r = .103 r=.103 和 r = .436 r=.436。 我们将智能体划分建立在ISO/IEC 25010（ISO/IEC 2023）的基础上，并完整发布了提示词，但这些结果刻画的是本流水线，只有通过论证才能推广到其他流水线。

paragraphs.en: LLM capability, pricing, and serving efficiency move quickly, and a cost relationship measured with three 2026 LLMs may not hold for their successors. No design choice removes this threat; we pin and publish every LLM identifier, revision, and serving parameter, frame the study as a snapshot of current-generation LLMs, and keep the instrument reproducible, so that replication with later LLMs requires only re-running a frozen pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型的能力、定价与服务效率变化迅速，用三个 2026 年的大语言模型测得的成本关系未必适用于它们的后继模型。 没有任何设计选择能消除这一威胁；我们固定并公布每个大语言模型的标识符、修订版本与服务参数，将本研究定位为对当前一代大语言模型的快照，并保持该工具可复现，从而使得用后续大语言模型进行复现只需重新运行一个冻结的流程。

paragraphs.en: CodeHealth is one proprietary composite, and using it alone risks measuring what that tool quantifies rather than code quality as such. The metric has been validated against organizational outcomes ( Tornhill and Borg 2022 ; Borg et al. 2024b ; Borg et al. 2023 ) and benchmarked against human maintainability assessments ( Borg et al. 2024a ) . Every one of these validation studies, and every study connecting CH to AI-assisted development that we cite ( Borg et al. 2026b ; Borg et al. 2026a ; Wirdemann et al. 2026 ) , includes authors affiliated with CodeScene, the vendor of the metric, as does the present study. Our countermeasure was temporal: the metric, its tier boundaries, and the tool version were fixed when the sample was drawn, before any review agent had run, and recorded in the registration. Evidence from outside CodeScene is thinner but points the same way, as Ramirez and Ekler (2025) related a different composite, the Maintainability Index, to a different outcome, issue resolution on SWE-bench Lite, and found correlations with agent success whose strength varied across LLMs. A replication using an independent maintainability instrument would strengthen the construct.
paragraphs.zh: CodeHealth 是一种专有的复合指标，仅凭它进行度量，风险在于所测量的只是该工具所量化的内容，而非代码质量本身。 该指标已针对组织层面的结果进行了验证（ Tornhill and Borg 2022 ; Borg et al. 2024b ; Borg et al. 2023 ），并与人类可维护性评估结果进行了基准对比（ Borg et al. 2024a ）。 我们引用的每一项验证研究，以及每一项将 CH 与 AI 辅助开发相联系的研究（ Borg et al. 2026b ; Borg et al. 2026a ; Wirdemann et al. 2026 ），其作者中都有供职于 CodeScene（该指标的供应商）的人员，本研究也不例外。 我们的对策是时间上的：在抽取样本时，即在任何审查智能体运行之前，该指标、其层级边界以及工具版本均已被固定，并记录在注册文件中。 来自 CodeScene 之外的证据较为薄弱，但指向相同的方向：Ramirez 和 Ekler（2025）将另一种复合指标——可维护性指数——与另一种结果——SWE-bench Lite 上的问题解决——相关联，并发现其与智能体成功率存在相关性，但相关性的强度在不同 LLM 之间有所差异。 使用独立的可维护性工具进行复现研究将增强该构念的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Baseline CodeHealth is measured at the PR’s head commit, before any agent runs, so the score includes what the PR itself contributed and not only the untouched repository. Because the tool scores whole files, we quantified both contributions in an exploratory measurement made after the outcomes were known. The median PR wrote 4.2% of the content its score is computed over (an upper bound, since an edited line counts as written), 0.9% in the unhealthy tier against 13.0% in the healthy one, a gradient that follows file size; 18 PRs consist only of new files. Rescoring the same files at each PR’s base commit, for the 446 PRs scorable at both commits, gives head and base scores correlating at r = .995 r=.995 , with 94.6% of PRs keeping their tier. Both checks favor clean up your existing codebase over submit healthier patches as the operative interpretation for most PRs.
paragraphs.zh: 基线 CodeHealth 是在智能体运行之前的 PR 头部提交处测量的，因此该分数包含 PR 本身所做的贡献，而不仅仅是未被改动的仓库。 由于该工具是对整个文件进行评分，我们在结果已知之后进行了一次探索性测量，对两者的贡献进行了量化。 PR 的中位数只写了其分数所覆盖内容的 4.2%（这是一个上限，因为被编辑过的行也算作所写内容），在不健康层级中为 0.9%，而在健康层级中为 13.0%，这一梯度随文件大小而变化；有 18 个 PR 仅包含新文件。 在每个 PR 的基线提交处对相同的文件重新评分，针对可在两个提交处评分的 446 个 PR，得到头部与基线分数的相关系数 r = .995，其中 94.6% 的 PR 保持了原有层级。 这两项检查都支持「清理你现有的代码库」而非「提交更健康的补丁」作为对大多数 PR 的有效解读。
