paragraphs.en: Unhealthy files are much larger than healthy ones (Section 4.6.4 ), and the registered model adjusts for the lines a PR changes, not for the size of the files around them. The agents do not ingest whole files: their prompt contains only the diff and the file-reading tools page through a file (Section 3.6 ), so a large file costs additional reads only when the context a change needs lies further inside it. Size-related smells, such as Large Method, Low Cohesion, and Bumpy Road, are components of the score, so adjusting for file size risks the overcontrol we avoid for footprint; Ramirez and Ekler (2025) similarly found a composite maintainability index tracking agent issue resolution more closely than its component metrics, SLOC among them. A size-adjusted refit absorbed the association for all three LLMs (Section 4.6.4 ), which we interpret as mediation by file size (Section 5.2 ). The residual threat is that the design cannot tell long, low-cohesion files apart from files that are long for other reasons, for which the mediation interpretation does not hold.
paragraphs.zh: 不健康文件比健康文件大得多（见 4.6.4 节），且注册模型针对 PR 修改的行数进行调整，而非针对这些行所在文件的大小。 智能体并不摄取整个文件：它们的提示词只包含 diff，且文件读取工具按页翻阅文件（见 3.6 节），因此只有当更改所需的上下文位于文件更靠后的位置时，大文件才会带来额外的读取开销。 与大小相关的代码坏味，如过大方法、低内聚和颠簸之路，都是评分的组成部分，因此针对文件大小进行调整可能会带来我们在足迹方面所避免的过度控制；Ramirez 和 Ekler（2025）同样发现，一个复合可维护性指数比其组成部分指标（其中包括 SLOC）更能跟踪智能体的问题解决情况。 经过大小调整的重新拟合吸收了全部三个 LLM 的关联（见 4.6.4 节），我们将其解释为受文件大小中介（见 5.2 节）。 残余的威胁在于，该设计无法区分低内聚的长文件与因其他原因而冗长的文件，而对于后者，中介解释并不成立。

paragraphs.en: Total tokens is one operationalization of a construct that also includes monetary spend, wall-clock latency, and downstream human attention, and these do not move together: cached input tokens are billed at a fraction of uncached ones, and a locally served LLM costs wall-clock time, hardware, and energy, not dollars per token. We pre-specify cache-neutral secondary outcomes and report the token composition alongside the total, but the token total is not a complete account of what agentic review costs an organization.
paragraphs.zh: 总 token 数只是对某一构念的一种操作化，该构念还包括金钱支出、实际耗时（wall-clock latency）以及下游的人类注意力，而这些因素并不同步变化：缓存输入 token 的计费仅为未缓存 token 的一小部分，而本地部署的大语言模型消耗的是时间、硬件和能源，而非按 token 计价的美元。 我们预先设定了对缓存不敏感的次要结局指标，并在报告总数的同时给出 token 的构成，但 token 总量并不能完整反映智能体式评审给一个组织带来的成本。

paragraphs.en: The three LLMs’ prefix-cache regimes differ substantially, making token totals incomparable across LLMs (Section 3.7 ). No cross-LLM inferential comparison is registered and the three fits are never pooled, so the threat bears on comparing magnitudes across LLMs, not on the within-LLM slopes that H1 tests.
paragraphs.zh: 三个大语言模型的前缀缓存机制差异很大，导致各模型之间的 token 总量不可比（见 3.7 节）。 分析中未登记任何跨模型推断性比较，三个拟合也从未被合并，因此该威胁只影响跨模型比较量级大小，而不影响 H1 所检验的模型内斜率。

sents.en: The three LLMs’ prefix-cache regimes differ substantially, making token totals incomparable across LLMs (Section 3.7 ).
sents.zh: 三个大语言模型的前缀缓存机制差异很大，导致各模型之间的 token 总量不可比（见 3.7 节）。

sents.en: No cross-LLM inferential comparison is registered and the three fits are never pooled, so the threat bears on comparing magnitudes across LLMs, not on the within-LLM slopes that H1 tests.
sents.zh: 分析中未登记任何跨模型推断性比较，三个拟合也从未被合并，因此该威胁只影响跨模型比较量级大小，而不影响 H1 所检验的模型内斜率。

paragraphs.en: If the agents could observe the metric they are measured against, any relationship between the two would be suspect. No review or fix agent receives the baseline CodeHealth score, the tier label, or any smell annotation, so the predictor cannot influence the instrument that produces the outcome. An earlier design that instructed the fix agent to raise CH to a target was dropped before registration for the reasons given in Section 3.3 ; keeping the metric out of the instrument also removes this threat.
paragraphs.zh: 如果智能体能够观察到它们所依据的评估指标，那么两者之间的任何关系都值得怀疑。 任何审查或修复智能体都不会收到基线 CodeHealth 分数、层级标签或任何代码异味标注，因此预测器无法影响产生结果的测量工具。 一个更早的设计曾指示修复智能体将 CH 提升到目标值，但出于 3.3 节所述的原因，该设计在预注册前被放弃；将指标排除在测量工具之外也消除了这一威胁。

paragraphs.en: Every PR was merged between 2024-12-27 and 2025-07-30, before the one published training cutoff (January 2026, for sonnet-5 ), so the agents likely encountered sampled repositories, and possibly the merged patches, during pretraining. Contamination of this kind is documented in benchmarks built the same way ( Aleithan et al. 2024 ) . Recognized code could cost fewer tokens to re-derive, which would bias β ℎ𝑒𝑎𝑙𝑡ℎ \beta_{\mathit{health}} toward zero only if memorization is uncorrelated with CodeHealth, which we cannot establish, and contamination effects in code language models are not uniformly attenuating ( Cao et al. 2024 ) . No agent sees the static analyzer’s output, so contamination can reach the predictor only through a code property that drives both memorization and CH, and any such property at the repository level is absorbed by the random intercept. Agreement across three separately served LLMs is weak evidence against a shared artifact, since their training corpora overlap, and a membership probe remains the way to settle it.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 PR 均在 2024-12-27 至 2025-07-30 之间合并，早于唯一公开的训练截止日期（2026 年 1 月，针对 sonnet-5），因此智能体在预训练期间很可能接触过这些采样的代码仓库，也可能接触过已合并的补丁。 以相同方式构建的基准测试中已有此类污染的记录（Aleithan et al. 2024）。 被识别的代码重新推导所需的 token 可能更少，这只有在记忆化与 CodeHealth 不相关时才会使 β_health 向零偏移，而这一点我们无法确立，且代码语言模型中的污染效应并非一律呈衰减性（Cao et al. 2024）。 没有任何智能体看到静态分析器的输出，因此污染只能通过某个同时驱动记忆化和 CH 的代码属性到达预测器，而任何此类仓库层面的属性都会被随机截距所吸收。 三个分别独立部署的 LLM 之间的一致性是反对共同伪影的弱证据，因为它们的训练语料存在重叠，而成员推断探测仍是解决此问题的方法。

paragraphs.en: Every measurement in this study is automated. We do not assess whether the review comments are correct, whether the applied fixes are good, or whether a human reviewer would agree with either, so the study prices an activity whose value it does not establish. Assessing the correctness and value of the comments is outside the scope of this study: the pipeline stands in for the multi-agent review setups now in use, and is the instrument through which cost is measured, not the object of evaluation. Grading the comments is the first question we propose for future work (Section 5.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 本研究中所有测量均为自动化完成。 我们不评估评审意见是否正确、所应用的修复是否良好，也不评估人类评审者是否会认同其中任何一项，因此该研究为一种其价值尚未得到证实的活动定价。 评估这些意见的正确性和价值超出了本研究的范围：该流水线代表的是当前使用中的多智能体评审设置，它是测量成本的工具，而非评估的对象。 对这些意见进行评级是我们为未来工作提出的第一个问题（第 5.6 节）。

paragraphs.en: All agent prompts were designed by the authors, and prompt phrasing could in principle advantage some part of the design. The structural protection is that there are no conditions: the same prompts, tools, and loop run for every PR, CodeHealth tier, and LLM, so the prompts cannot favor one CH tier or LLM over another. The prompts were additionally hashed and published in full in the registration, filed before any review record had been read and before any fix session had run (Section 3.12 ).
paragraphs.zh: 所有智能体提示词均由作者设计，提示词的措辞在原则上可能对设计的某些部分有利。 结构上的保障在于不存在任何条件分支：相同的提示词、工具和循环对每个 PR、每个 CodeHealth 层级和每个 LLM 都完全一致地运行，因此提示词不会偏向某个 CH 层级或某个 LLM。 此外，提示词经过哈希处理并在注册文件中全文公布，该注册文件在阅读任何评审记录之前、在任何修复会话运行之前均已提交存档（见第 3.12 节）。

sents.zh: 所有智能体提示词均由作者设计，提示词的措辞在原则上可能对设计的某些部分有利。

paragraphs.en: This is the study’s principal conclusion threat. Every LLM’s required sample size, extrapolated from its own pilot point estimate, exceeds the achieved 465 PRs, and the minimum detectable effect lies above the smallest pilot estimate (Table 7 ), which is why H1 is a direction-consistency criterion across three instruments and not a significance test (Section 3.12 ). All three intervals excluded zero (Section 4.2 ), which the power analysis could not guarantee, and a true effect smaller than the achieved estimates would still have been missed.
paragraphs.zh: 这是本研究的主要结论威胁（结论效度威胁）。 每个大语言模型根据自身试点估计值外推所需的样本量都超过了实际达到的 465 个 PR，且最小可检测效应高于最小的试点估计值（表 7），这就是为什么 H1 是跨三个工具的方向一致性判据，而不是显著性检验（第 3.12 节）。 所有三个区间均不包含零（第 4.2 节），这是功效分析无法保证的，而小于已达到估计值的真实效应仍可能被漏检。

paragraphs.en: Token, comment, and iteration distributions are heavy-tailed; in pilot data a single PR accounted for approximately 45% of a stratum’s mean token total. We log-transform the cost and footprint variables in the mixed model, summarize distributions with medians and box plots instead of means, and use rank-based statistics for the smell correlations.
paragraphs.zh: Token、注释和迭代分布均呈重尾特征；在试点数据中，单个 PR 约占某一层平均 Token 总量的 45%。 我们对混合模型中的成本和占用空间变量进行对数变换，用中位数和箱线图而非均值来概括分布，并对坏味道相关性使用基于秩的统计方法。

paragraphs.en: With four research questions, three LLMs, five languages, and 19 smell categories observed in the sample, uncorrected exploration would almost certainly produce something significant. The registration fixed the confirmatory set before any review record had been read, the smell family is Holm-corrected, and everything labeled exploratory is controlled under Benjamini-Hochberg. We regard the registration as the main protection, in line with arguments about replication and researcher degrees of freedom in empirical computer science ( Cockburn et al. 2020 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 鉴于研究问题有四个、大语言模型有三个、语言有五种、样本中观察到的坏味道类别有 19 类，未经校正的探索性分析几乎必然会发现某种显著结果。 预注册在任何审阅记录被阅读之前就固定了验证性集合，坏味道类别族采用 Holm 校正，而所有标注为探索性的内容均在 Benjamini-Hochberg 方法下加以控制。 我们将预注册视为主要保护措施，这与实证计算机科学中关于可复现性和研究者自由度的论述一致（Cockburn 等，2020）。

paragraphs.en: Pooling the three LLMs’ rows would triple the apparent sample while adding far less information, because the same diff is intrinsically easy or hard to review whichever LLM reviews it. On pilot data, naive pooling returned an apparently significant CodeHealth effect ( p = .044 p=.044 ) that moved to p = .19 p=.19 under PR-clustered and p = .25 p=.25 under repository-clustered standard errors. The registered analysis never pools, and we report this trap explicitly so that a reader attempting a re-analysis encounters it before repeating it.
paragraphs.zh: 将三个LLM的行合并会使表面样本量增至三倍，而新增的信息却少得多，因为同一段diff无论由哪个LLM来评审，其本身评审难度就是相同的。 在试点数据上，朴素合并得到了一个表面显著的CodeHealth效应（p = .044），但在按PR聚类的标准误下p值变为.19，在按仓库聚类的标准误下变为.25。 注册的分析从不合并数据，并且我们明确报告这一陷阱，以便尝试重新分析的读者在重复该错误之前就能遇到它。

paragraphs.en: LLM outputs are not deterministic even at temperature 0, and an agentic tool loop amplifies the variation, so one run per PR inflates the residual variance against which the CodeHealth effect is estimated. The replication subsample quantifies this variance (Table 16 ). For deepseek-v4-flash and sonnet-5 it is small, so the narrow margin of sonnet-5 ’s interval reflects a small effect estimate, not run-to-run instability. For qwen3-6 it is not, and that LLM’s reported standard error does not include this run-level noise, so its true uncertainty is plausibly larger than Table 8 reports, without the sign or magnitude being biased. The subsample is small at 27 PRs, so the variance estimate is itself imprecise.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 的输出即使在温度为 0 时也不具有确定性，而智能体式的工具调用循环会放大这种差异，因此每个 PR 只运行一次会夸大残差方差，而 CodeHealth 的效应正是相对于该残差方差来估计的。 复包子样本量化了这种方差（表 16）。 对于 deepseek-v4-flash 和 sonnet-5 而言，这种方差很小，因此 sonnet-5 区间较窄反映的是效应估计值本身较小，而非运行之间的不稳定性。 对于 qwen3-6 而言则不然，且该 LLM 所报告的标准误并未包含这种运行层面的噪声，因此其真实的不确定性很可能大于表 8 所报告的数值，但符号和量级并未因此产生偏差。 该子样本规模较小，仅有 27 个 PR，因此方差估计本身并不精确。

paragraphs.en: If pipeline failures were concentrated among the lowest-CodeHealth PRs, the surviving sample would differ systematically from the drawn one. Guard-stopped review sessions are retained as cost, not filtered (Section 3.10 ), and for qwen3-6 they are not random: they concentrate in lower-CH, higher-cost PRs, and that LLM’s own interval excludes zero only with them retained (Section 4.2 ). H1 does not depend on them, since the two other intervals still exclude zero; the residual threat is that qwen3-6 ’s individual result rests on the registered decision to count a spiraling review as cost.
paragraphs.zh: 如果流水线失败集中在 CodeHealth 最低的 PR 上，那么幸存的样本将与抽取的样本存在系统性差异。 被护栏中止的评审会话被保留为成本，而不是被过滤掉（见 3.10 节），并且对 qwen3-6 而言它们并非随机的：它们集中在 CH 较低、成本较高的 PR 上，而且只有保留它们时，该 LLM 自身的置信区间才不包含零（见 4.2 节）。 H1 并不依赖于它们，因为另外两个区间仍然不包含零；剩余的威胁在于，qwen3-6 的个体结果依赖于这项预注册的决定，即将一场螺旋式失控的评审计为成本。

paragraphs.en: A quality metric calibrated against human maintainability also predicts what a multi-agent LLM pipeline spends on reviewing and fixing code. In a pre-registered observational study of 465 agent-authored PRs from 246 repositories, processed by a frozen review-and-fix pipeline with three separately served LLMs, the CodeHealth coefficient was negative with a 95% confidence interval excluding zero for all three LLMs, satisfying the registered criterion for RQ 1 : one CH point was associated with 3.5% to 6.1% fewer tokens at constant footprint, language, and repository. Concerning RQ 2 , the association is direct with respect to PR footprint, since unhealthy code did not arrive in larger PRs. Concerning RQ 3 , Complex Method and Complex Conditional predicted fix-stage cost for every LLM, while Code Duplication, contrary to its registered prediction, did not. Concerning RQ 4 , a single batch fix pass left median CH unchanged for every LLM and tier.
paragraphs.zh: 以人类可维护性为基准校准的质量指标，也能预测多智能体 LLM 流水线在审查和修复代码上的开销。 在一项预注册的观察性研究中，我们对来自 246 个仓库的 465 个由智能体创建的 PR 进行了分析，这些 PR 由一条冻结的审查与修复流水线处理，其中使用三个独立部署的 LLM；结果发现 CodeHealth 系数为负，且三个 LLM 的 95% 置信区间均不包含零，满足了 RQ 1 的注册标准：在足迹、语言和仓库保持不变的情况下，CH 每提高 1 分，token 消耗减少 3.5% 至 6.1%。 关于 RQ 2，该关联在 PR 足迹方面是直接的，因为不健康的代码并未出现在更大的 PR 中。 关于 RQ 3，Complex Method 和 Complex Conditional 对每个 LLM 都能预测修复阶段的成本，而 Code Duplication 与其注册预测相反，并不能预测。 关于 RQ 4，单次批量修复处理后，每个 LLM 和层级的 CH 中位数均保持不变。

sents.en: A quality metric calibrated against human maintainability also predicts what a multi-agent LLM pipeline spends on reviewing and fixing code.
sents.zh: 以人类可维护性为基准校准的质量指标，也能预测多智能体 LLM 流水线在审查和修复代码上的开销。

paragraphs.en: The exploratory analyses locate the association in the review stage. On unhealthy code the review agents take more turns and retrieve more context without raising more comments, so that review cost per finding is an estimated 30% to 42% lower for a typical healthy-tier PR than for an equivalently sized unhealthy one. The number of comments follows the count of code smells in the files under review, not the CodeHealth score. Adjusting for the size of the scored files absorbs the association for all three LLMs; CH and file size are too entangled in this sample to separate, and we interpret the association as mediated by file size. In absolute terms the effect is modest: the contrast between a typical unhealthy-tier and a typical healthy-tier PR corresponds to about 91,000 to 360,000 tokens for a single review-and-fix pass, depending on the LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 探索性分析将这种关联定位于评审阶段。 在不健康代码上，评审智能体会进行更多轮次并检索更多上下文，但并未提出更多评论，因此对于典型的健康级 PR，每次发现问题的评审成本估计比同等规模的不健康 PR 低 30% 到 42%。 评论的数量遵循被评审文件中代码坏味道的数量，而非 CodeHealth 评分。 对评分文件的规模进行调整后，这种关联在全部三个 LLM 上均被吸收；CH 与文件规模在此样本中纠缠过深而无法分离，我们将该关联解释为经由文件规模中介。 就绝对量而言，该效应并不大：典型的非健康级 PR 与典型的健康级 PR 之间的差异，对应于单次评审与修复流程中约 91,000 到 360,000 个 token，具体取决于所用的 LLM。

sents.zh: 探索性分析将这种关联定位于评审阶段。

paragraphs.en: Of the two outcomes the study was designed to distinguish (Section 1 ), the data supports the first, in a qualified form. Cost was not carried by PR footprint, so keeping PRs small does not substitute for code quality. The case for refactoring extends to agent-reviewed code, but the refactoring it supports is the kind that changes the structure an agent reads through, splitting long methods and low-cohesion modules into smaller units, and not changes that raise the score while leaving that structure in place (Section 5.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该研究旨在区分的两种结果中（第 1 节），数据以有限定条件的形式支持第一种。 成本并非由 PR 规模承载，因此保持 PR 较小并不能替代代码质量。 重构的理由同样适用于智能体审阅的代码，但它所支持的重构是那种改变智能体所通读结构的重构，即将长方法和低内聚模块拆分为更小的单元，而不是在保留该结构不变的情况下提升分数的改动（第 5.5 节）。

sents.zh: 该研究旨在区分的两种结果中（第 1 节），数据以有限定条件的形式支持第一种。

sents.en: Cost was not carried by PR footprint, so keeping PRs small does not substitute for code quality.

sents.en: The case for refactoring extends to agent-reviewed code, but the refactoring it supports is the kind that changes the structure an agent reads through, splitting long methods and low-cohesion modules into smaller units, and not changes that raise the score while leaving that structure in place (Section 5.5 ).
sents.zh: 重构的理由同样适用于智能体审阅的代码，但它所支持的重构是那种改变智能体所通读结构的重构，即将长方法和低内聚模块拆分为更小的单元，而不是在保留该结构不变的情况下提升分数的改动（第 5.5 节）。

paragraphs.en: These conclusions are bounded by one quality metric, one cost construct, one pipeline, three LLMs at one point in their development, and merged agent-authored PRs in popular open-source repositories (Section 6 ). The published pipeline and replication package allow the association to be re-tested on later LLMs and with other code quality or maintainability metrics.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结论受到以下条件限制：仅使用一个质量指标、一个成本构建方式、一条流水线、三个处于特定发展阶段的 LLM，以及热门开源仓库中由智能体编写并合并的 PR（第 6 节）。 已公开的流水线和复现包使得该关联可以在后续的 LLM 上以及使用其他代码质量或可维护性指标时得到重新检验。
